feedback_throttled_global.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: reason, filled into the status-bar message, shown when a feedback upload hit a rate limit because sqlly.app has received the most feedback it accepts from everyone per day; the report is kept and sent automatically later.

feedback_throttled_request_rate.value: 短期間に sqlly.app へのリクエストが多すぎます
feedback_throttled_request_rate.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: reason, filled into the status-bar message, shown when a feedback upload hit a rate limit because the app sent too many requests to sqlly.app within a minute; the report is kept and sent automatically later.

feedback_unsigned.value: このビルドはフィードバックに署名できない (フィードバック署名キーなしでビルドされている) ため、sqlly.app はフィードバックを受け入れません。
feedback_unsigned.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: error shown when a feedback report cannot be sent because this build was compiled without the feedback signing key.

standalone_build.value: このスタンドアロン ビルドは sqlly.app に接続しないため、アカウント、フィードバック、更新チェック、およびクラウド リレーがオフになります。
standalone_build.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel, Cloud Relay connection setup and feedback upload status: error shown when any request to sqlly.app is attempted. Shown only in standalone builds (compiled with the standalone option), which never contact sqlly.app.

browser_unsupported.value: ストアのサインインはブラウザーのプレビューでは使用できません。デスクトップ アプリを使用します。
browser_unsupported.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when a store sign-in or account request is attempted from the browser preview, which cannot reach the store; tells the user to use the desktop app.

http_status.value: ストアはリクエストを拒否しました (HTTP {status})。
http_status.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when the SQLLY store rejects a request without an explanation; {status} is the numeric HTTP status code, e.g. 500.

machine_id_unavailable.value: このコンピュータ上で安定したマシン識別子を読み取ることができませんでした。
machine_id_unavailable.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when the app cannot read a stable identifier for this computer, which the store needs to register the device.

network.value: SQLLY ストアにアクセスできませんでした。インターネット接続を確認してください。
network.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when a request to the SQLLY store never completes (offline, DNS, TLS or timeout).

unexpected_response.value: ストアはアプリが理解できない応答を送信しました。
unexpected_response.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when the SQLLY store answers successfully but the response body cannot be read by this version of the app.

access_until.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status for a plan that will not renew; {date} is the date access ends (e.g. “Mar 4, 2027”).

active.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: green status label beside the plan name meaning the subscription currently grants paid access. Adjective describing the subscription.

comped.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status when the account was granted free paid access by SQLLY and no reason was recorded.

comped_with_reason.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status when SQLLY granted free paid access; {reason} is the note explaining why (e.g. a partner or promotion).

free_tier.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: bold heading shown when the signed-in account has no subscription at all, naming the free plan the user is on.

inactive.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: amber status label beside the plan name when the subscription exists but no longer grants access (e.g. cancelled or expired).

load_failed.value: サブスクリプションを読み込めませんでした: {error}
load_failed.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: red error shown with a “Try again” button when the store server returned an error loading the subscription; {error} is that server message.

loading.value: サブスクリプションを読み込んでいます…
loading.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed progress text shown while the subscription details are being fetched from the SQLLY store after the dialog opens.

macos_only.value: Mac 上でのみ SQLLY をライセンスします。
macos_only.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed note under the renewal line when the plan (such as a Mac App Store purchase) only licenses SQLLY on macOS computers.

no_active.value: まだアクティブなサブスクリプションがありません。
no_active.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: explanatory sentence under the “Free tier” heading, above the upgrade button, telling the user they have not subscribed yet.

past_due.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: red status label beside the plan name when the latest subscription payment failed and is overdue. Short status adjective.

platforms_only.value: {platforms} でのみ SQLLY をライセンスします。
platforms_only.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed note when the plan is limited to certain operating systems; {platforms} is a comma-separated list such as “Windows, Linux”.

renews.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status for an auto-renewing plan when no price is shown (e.g. App Store edition); {date} is the next renewal date.

renews_with_price.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line for an auto-renewing web-store plan; {date} is the next renewal date and {amount} the charge in dollars, e.g. “$7.00”.

retry.value: もう一度試してください
retry.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: button beside the red load-error message that fetches the subscription details again from the SQLLY store.

task_failed.value: サブスクリプションを読み込めませんでした: {error}
task_failed.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: red error shown when the subscription request could not complete at all (internal task failure, not a server reply); {error} is the technical cause.

signed_in.value: サインインしました — サブスクリプションを表示します
signed_in.location: Query toolbar → Account icon at the far right: tooltip when signed in but the account has no email on file; clicking the icon opens the Account dialog.

signed_in_as.value: {email} としてサインイン — サブスクリプションを表示
signed_in_as.location: Query toolbar → Account icon at the far right: tooltip when signed in; {email} is the account email address, and clicking the icon opens the Account dialog.

signed_out.value: サインインしていません — クリックしてサインインしてください
signed_out.location: Query toolbar → Account icon at the far right: tooltip when nobody is signed in; clicking the icon opens the SQLLY store sign-in window.

age_days.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age after the mode name for conversations updated a day or more ago; {count} is the number of days. Very short abbreviation.

age_hours.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age for conversations updated 1 to 23 hours ago; {count} is the number of hours. Very short abbreviation.

age_just_now.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age shown after the mode name when the conversation was updated less than a minute ago. Lowercase fragment.

age_minutes.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age for conversations updated 1 to 59 minutes ago; {count} is the number of minutes. Very short abbreviation.

export_assistant_heading.location: AI panel → History list → Export to Markdown: section heading written in the exported Markdown file and clipboard copy above each reply from the AI assistant.

export_header.value:
# {title}

サーバー: {server} · データベース: {database} · レーン: {lane} · 更新: {updated_at}
export_header.location: AI → Conversation History → Markdown export: heading containing the conversation title, server, database, lane, and update timestamp, including its trailing newline.

export_pinned_context.value: 固定されたコンテキスト: {context}
export_pinned_context.location: AI → Conversation History → Markdown export: optional pinned-context paragraph, including its leading and trailing newlines.

export_tool_heading.location: AI panel → History list → Export to Markdown: section heading written in the exported Markdown above each tool call or tool result the AI made during the conversation.

export_user_heading.location: AI panel → History list → Export to Markdown: section heading written in the exported Markdown above each message the user typed. Noun for the human participant.

history_relative.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: format joining {lane} (the mode, e.g. “Generate”) and {age} (relative time such as “3h ago”) with a middle dot.

history_timestamp.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: fallback format used when the saved time cannot be parsed; {lane} is the mode name and {updated_at} the raw saved timestamp.

lane_ask.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Ask mode (questions about the schema) in which the saved conversation took place. Short noun-like label.

lane_generate.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Generate mode (writing SQL from a description) in which the saved conversation took place.

lane_joins.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Joins mode (finding join paths between tables) in which the saved conversation took place.

lane_search.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Search mode (finding schema objects) in which the saved conversation took place. Short label.

new_chat_title.location: AI panel → History list: default title given to a saved conversation whose first user message is empty or not yet written; later replaced by that message’s first line.

cancel_button.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block under a SQL reply: small button beside “Running…” that stops the query started with “Run here”.

footer_cancelled.value: {row_count} 行後にキャンセルされました
footer_cancelled.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer status after the user cancelled the inline query; {row_count} is the number of rows received before stopping.

footer_capped.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer when more rows existed than the inline limit; {row_cap} is the row limit shown (e.g. 200), {elapsed} the run time (e.g. “1.2 s”).

footer_done.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer after the inline query finished; {row_count} is the number of rows returned and {elapsed} the run time (e.g. “34 ms”).

footer_error.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer status line beside the “Open in results tab” button when the inline query failed; {message} is the database or timeout error.

footer_production.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer suffix added when the connection is marked as production; {footer} is the normal footer status, e.g. “12 rows · 34 ms”.

history_cancelled.value: インライン実行: {row_count} 行後にキャンセルされました
history_cancelled.location: AI panel → Chat: note added to the conversation below a SQL reply after its inline run was cancelled; {row_count} is the number of rows received before stopping.

history_done.value: インラインで実行: {elapsed} の {row_count} 行
history_done.location: AI panel → Chat: note added to the conversation below a SQL reply after its inline run finished; {row_count} is the rows returned and {elapsed} the run time.

history_failed.value: インライン実行: 失敗しました — {message}
history_failed.location: AI panel → Chat: note added to the conversation below a SQL reply when its inline run failed; {message} is the error, such as a timeout or database error.

no_rows.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: empty-state text in place of the grid when the inline query returned or has so far received no rows.

not_select.location: AI panel → Chat → SQL reply actions: fallback tooltip on the disabled “Run here” button explaining the SQL is not a read-only SELECT, so it cannot run inline. Lowercase fragment.

open_results_button.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: small button at the right of the footer that opens the full inline query result in a regular Results tab of the workbench.

result_error.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: body text shown in place of the grid when the inline query failed; {message} is the database or timeout error.

running_status.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: progress text shown beside the Cancel button while the inline query runs, and as the footer during the run.

timeout.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: error reason shown when the inline query was cancelled because it ran longer than 30 seconds. Lowercase fragment shown after “Error:”.

browser_unavailable.value: ローカル コーディング エージェント CLI は使用できません
browser_unavailable.location: AI panel → Chat (browser edition): error message when agent mode tries to start a local coding-agent CLI, which the web version of SQLLY cannot run.

executable_not_found.value: {path} では見つかりませんでした
executable_not_found.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: red result line after clicking Check when no program exists at the configured path; {path} is the executable path checked.

health_found.value: CLI が見つかりました
health_found.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: result line after clicking Check when the CLI program exists but neither its version nor its MCP connection could be determined.

health_mcp_failed.value: CLI が見つかりました、MCP が失敗しました: SQL サーバーが接続しませんでした
health_mcp_failed.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: red result line after Check when the CLI exists, its version is unknown, and SQLLY’s MCP server failed to connect to it.

health_mcp_ok.value: CLI が見つかりました、MCP は OK
health_mcp_ok.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: green result line after Check when the CLI exists, its version is unknown, and SQLLY’s MCP server connected successfully.

health_version_mcp_failed.value: CLI が見つかりました、バージョン {version}、MCP が失敗しました: SQL サーバーが接続しませんでした
health_version_mcp_failed.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: red result line after Check when the CLI reports {version} (its version string) but SQLLY’s MCP server failed to connect to it.

health_version_mcp_ok.value: CLI が見つかりました、バージョン {version}、MCP OK
health_version_mcp_ok.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: green result line after Check when the CLI reports {version} (its version string) and SQLLY’s MCP server connected successfully.

health_version_mcp_unknown.value: CLI が見つかりました、バージョン {version}、MCP ステータスは不明です
health_version_mcp_unknown.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: result line after Check when the CLI reports {version} (its version string) but whether SQLLY’s MCP server connected could not be determined.

invalid_stream_json.value: CLI は stream-json を話していません。 `--output-format` はこのバージョンでサポートされていますか?
invalid_stream_json.location: AI panel → Chat → Agent mode: error output shown after the run is stopped because the coding-agent CLI kept printing output that is not the expected stream-json format. Keep `--output-format` verbatim.

mcp_config_failed.value: エージェント CLI の MCP 構成ファイルを書き込めませんでした: {detail}
mcp_config_failed.location: AI panel → Local coding-agent CLI run: note shown in the chat when the temporary MCP server configuration file for the agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex) cannot be written, so the run never starts; {detail} is the operating system's own error text.

output_truncated_marker.location: AI panel → Agent mode output: marker appended to an overly long line of coding-agent CLI output after it is cut short. Ends with a line break; keep the leading ellipsis.

sandbox_action.value: ローカル AI エージェント CLI の実行
sandbox_action.location: AI → Local Coding Agent: feature description inserted into the sandbox restriction message when launching the CLI is blocked.

start_failed.value: {path}: {error} を開始できませんでした
start_failed.location: AI panel → Chat → Agent mode: error detail when the coding-agent CLI program could not be launched; {path} is the executable path and {error} the operating-system error.

agent_cancelled.value: キャンセルされました
agent_cancelled.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: short note added to the conversation when the user stops an agent run with the Stop button; past participle meaning the run was cancelled.

agent_egress_cli.value: エージェント モードは、{vendor} のクラウドと通信するローカルの {provider} CLI を実行します。テーブル名、列リスト、サンプル行、および SELECT 結果が通過します。
agent_egress_cli.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Agent mode: egress explanation for a local coding-agent CLI, naming both the CLI provider and the vendor cloud that receives schema excerpts and SELECT results.

agent_egress_local.value: エージェント モードは、テーブル名、列リスト、サンプル行、および SELECT 結果をローカル ランタイムに送信します。
agent_egress_local.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: small privacy note below the Agent mode checkbox, shown when the selected model runs on this device (Ollama or MLX), saying what database data the agent sends to it.

agent_egress_provider.value: エージェント モードは、テーブル名、列リスト、サンプル行、および SELECT 結果を {provider} に送信します。
agent_egress_provider.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: small privacy note below the Agent mode checkbox for a cloud AI provider, listing what database data the agent sends; {provider} is the provider name, such as openai.

agent_mcp_not_connected.value: SQLLY MCP サーバーが接続しませんでした。停止
agent_mcp_not_connected.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Agent mode: note shown in the chat when the local coding-agent CLI reports that the SQLLY MCP server did not connect, so SQLLY stops the run.

agent_mode.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt options: checkbox label that switches the assistant into agent mode, where the model can call database tools over several turns.

agent_output_limit.value: 出力制限 (1 MB) に達しました
agent_output_limit.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: note added to the conversation when a local coding-agent CLI run is stopped because its output exceeded the 1 MB cap.

agent_start_failed.value: {path}: {error} を開始できませんでした
agent_start_failed.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: error note added when a local coding-agent CLI cannot be launched; {path} is the executable path and {error} is the operating-system error text.

agent_stderr.value: 標準エラー (最後の 8 KB): {output}
agent_stderr.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: note after a failed local coding-agent CLI run showing the last 8 KB of its error output; “stderr” is the technical stream name and {output} is that raw text.

agent_timed_out.value: {minutes} 分後にタイムアウトになりました
agent_timed_out.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: note added to the conversation when a local coding-agent CLI run is stopped for exceeding its time limit; {minutes} is the configured timeout in minutes.

agent_turn_limit.value: 停止中: ターン制限に達しました ({limit})。 [設定] ▸ [AI] で制限を上げるか、リクエストを調整します。
agent_turn_limit.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: note added when the agent stops after reaching the maximum number of turns; {limit} is that maximum, which can be raised in Settings ▸ AI.

agent_turn_status.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: progress note added to the conversation as a local coding-agent CLI starts each turn; {current} is the turn number and {total} is the maximum turns.

agent_working.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: small dimmed status below the prompt while a request is running and no turn count is known yet.

agent_working_turn.value: 作業中… {current}/{total} を回します
agent_working_turn.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: small dimmed status below the prompt while the agent runs, beside the Stop button; {current} is the current turn and {total} the turn limit.

ask_about_object_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search → Result row: button on a found table, column or procedure that switches to the Ask tab with the prompt prefilled to ask about that object.

ask_tab.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Navigation: tab that opens the Ask lane, where the user asks questions about the connected database schema in a chat.

assistant_message_label.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation: small caption at the top of each reply bubble identifying the AI assistant as its author; pairs with the “You” caption on user messages.

attachment_count_limit.value: 添付ファイルは{limit} ファイルに限定されます。
attachment_count_limit.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: red notice below the prompt when the user pastes or drops another file after reaching the attachment maximum; {limit} is the maximum number of files.

attachment_size_limit.value: 添付ファイルは 64 KB に制限されています
attachment_size_limit.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: red notice below the prompt when a dropped text file is skipped because it is larger than the 64 KB attachment limit.

clear_chat_menu.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Overflow menu: item that clears the current conversation.

compacted_tool_exchanges.value: 圧縮された {count} 以前のツール交換
compacted_tool_exchanges.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: centered dimmed marker in the conversation where older tool calls and results were removed to save context; {count} is how many call-and-result pairs were removed.

context_disabled_description.value: 会話コンテキストはオフです。このプロンプトとピン留めされたオブジェクトのみが送信されます。
context_disabled_description.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt options: dimmed explanation under the “Use recent conversation” checkbox while it is cleared, saying earlier messages will not be sent.

context_enabled_description.value: {count} 最近の完全な交換が含まれます。一時的なコンテキストは、{exchange_limit} 交換と {character_limit} 文字に制限されます。
context_enabled_description.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt options: dimmed explanation under the “Use recent conversation” checkbox while it is checked; {count} is exchanges to be sent, {exchange_limit} and {character_limit} the caps.

conversation_exported.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History: notice shown after a saved conversation is copied as Markdown and also saved to a file; {path} is the full path of that Markdown file.

copy_generated_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button under an AI-generated SQL block that copies the SQL to the clipboard.

copy_join_sql_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: button that copies the candidate JOIN SQL to the clipboard.

copy_markdown_tooltip.value: マークダウンとしてコピー
copy_markdown_tooltip.location: AI → Conversation History → Row actions: tooltip for the button that copies a conversation as Markdown.

copy_object_name_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search → Result row: button that copies the found object's qualified name to the clipboard.

delete_conversation_description.value: これを元に戻すことはできません。
delete_conversation_description.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History → Delete confirmation: body text of the confirmation dialog, warning that deleting a saved conversation is permanent.

delete_conversation_title.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History → Delete confirmation: title of the confirmation dialog shown after clicking the delete button on a saved conversation.

delete_conversation_tooltip.location: AI → Conversation History → Row actions: tooltip for the button that deletes a conversation.

disconnected.value: AI 機能を使用するには、データベースに接続します。
disconnected.location: AI → Assistant Panel: centered empty-state message filling the panel while no database connection is active; the AI features need a connection.

edit_templates_menu.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Templates menu: last item, below a separator, that shows where the prompt templates file is so the user can edit it.

finding_join_path.value: 結合パスを検索しています…
finding_join_path.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: status shown while candidate join paths are being calculated.

generate_tab.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Navigation: tab that opens the Generate lane, where the user describes what they need and the AI writes SQL.

generated_sql_too_large.value: 生成された SQL は安全なレビューの制限を超えたため、破棄されました。リクエストを絞り込んで再試行してください。
generated_sql_too_large.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation: error shown in place of a reply when the generated SQL is longer than the safe review limit and was discarded; tells the user to ask for less.

grounded_in.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: dimmed footer listing the database objects the generated SQL was based on; the label is followed by a line break, then {objects}, one indented line per object.

history_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Toolbar: toggle button with a clock icon that shows or hides the list of saved conversations.

history_search_placeholder.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History: placeholder in the search box at the top of the saved-conversations list, filtering it by text.

insert_for_review_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button that inserts the generated SQL at the editor cursor, shown instead of “Insert” when validation did not clear the SQL to run directly.

insert_generated_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button that inserts the generated SQL at the cursor in the active query editor, shown when validation cleared the SQL to run.

insert_join_sql_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: button that inserts the candidate JOIN SQL at the editor caret.

insert_object_name_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search → Result row: button that inserts the found object's qualified name at the cursor in the active query editor.

join_from_label.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path: label to the left of the source-table input.

join_from_object_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Schema Search: object-row button that opens Join Path with that object as the source.

join_incomplete_mapping.value: この関係には完全な列マッピングが欠落しているため、SQLLY は ON 句を推測しません。
join_incomplete_mapping.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: warning shown when a relationship lacks a complete column mapping for the ON clause.

join_not_contiguous.value: 関係のパスは、安全に足場を築くのに十分なほど連続していません。
join_not_contiguous.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: warning shown when the relationship path is not contiguous enough to generate JOIN SQL safely.

join_path_heading.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: heading above one candidate path, showing its position and score.

join_paths_empty.value: パスが見つかりません。ソーステーブルとターゲットテーブルの名前を入力します。
join_paths_empty.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: empty state prompting for source and target table names.

join_same_object.value: ソースとターゲットは同じオブジェクトです。 JOIN は必要ありません。
join_same_object.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: warning shown when source and target are the same object, so no JOIN is needed.

join_scaffold_too_large.value: JOIN スキャフォールドが安全な表示制限を超えました。
join_scaffold_too_large.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: warning shown when generated JOIN SQL exceeds the safe display limit.

join_source_placeholder.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path: placeholder in the source-table input.

join_step_declared.value:
{from_object} ({from_columns}) → {to_object} ({to_columns})
宣言された外部キー · 100% の信頼性
join_step_declared.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: relationship detail below a path step, identifying a declared foreign key and its confidence.

join_step_inferred.value:
{from_object} ({from_columns}) → {to_object} ({to_columns})
推定された名前の一致 · {confidence}% の信頼度
join_step_inferred.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: relationship detail below a path step, identifying an inferred name match and its confidence.

join_target_placeholder.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path: placeholder in the target-table input.

join_to_label.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path: label to the left of the target-table input.

joins_tab.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Navigation: tab that opens the Join Path workflow.

markdown_copied.value: Markdown をクリップボードにコピーしました。
markdown_copied.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History: notice in the browser version after a saved conversation is copied to the clipboard as Markdown (no file is saved there).

new_chat_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Toolbar: compact button with a plus icon that starts a new, empty conversation; very short label meaning “new conversation”.

new_generated_query_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button that opens the generated SQL in a new query editor tab.

new_join_query_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Join Path → Results: button that opens the candidate JOIN SQL in a new query tab.

no_saved_conversations.value: 保存された会話はありません。
no_saved_conversations.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History: empty-state text in the saved-conversations list when nothing has been saved yet.

no_sql_generated.value: SQLは生成されませんでした。
no_sql_generated.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation: text shown in a reply bubble when the model answered a Generate request without producing any SQL.

open_definition_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search → Result row: button, shown for tables, views, procedures, functions and types (not columns), that opens the object's definition script in the editor.

options_tooltip.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Toolbar: tooltip for the button that opens the AI options menu.

pin_object_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search → Result row: button that pins the found object as context, so later prompts are grounded on it; verb.

prompt_placeholder.value: 必要な SQL について説明するか、質問してください
prompt_placeholder.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: placeholder in the main prompt input, inviting the user to describe the SQL they need or ask a question.

prompt_too_long.value: プロンプトは {limit} 文字に制限されています。
prompt_too_long.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: red notice below the prompt when the user submits a prompt longer than the maximum; {limit} is the maximum number of characters.

replace_failing_statement_button.value: 失敗したステートメントを置き換える
replace_failing_statement_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button shown after asking the AI to explain a failed query; replaces the failing statement in the original query tab with the suggested SQL.

response_truncated_marker.value: [応答はメモリ内の制限まで切り詰められました。]
response_truncated_marker.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation: marker added on a new line at the end of a very long text reply that was cut to the in-memory size limit; keep the square brackets.

resume_read_only.value: 別の接続で保存されました。読み取り専用を再開
resume_read_only.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Conversation History: notice shown after reopening a conversation that was saved on a different connection; it is displayed read-only.

revalidate_button.value: 実行するには再検証してください
revalidate_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button shown when the SQL has not been checked yet; runs validation again so the Run actions become available.

reveal_object_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search → Result row: button that selects the found object in the Object Explorer sidebar, opening the sidebar if hidden.

review_run_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button for generated SQL that changes data; opens it in a new query tab and runs it through the data-change confirmation review.

run_generated_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: primary button, shown only when validation cleared a read-only query, that puts the SQL in the active query tab and runs it.

run_inline_button.value: ここに逃げてください
run_inline_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL: button that runs the generated read-only query and shows its results right inside the conversation; disabled with a tooltip reason when not allowed.

schema_search_placeholder.value: テーブル、列、プロシージャを検索する
schema_search_placeholder.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search: placeholder in the search box for finding tables, columns and stored procedures (“procs”) in the connected database; short space.

search_empty.value: 結果はありません。クエリを入力して Enter キーを押します。
search_empty.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search: empty-state message in the results area when there are no matches or no search has run yet; tells the user to type and press Enter.

search_tab.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Navigation: tab that opens the Search lane for finding tables, columns and procedures in the connected database's schema.

searching_status.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Search: dimmed progress text in the results area while a schema search is running.

stop_agent_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: button beside the working status below the prompt, shown while an agent run is in progress; cancels the run.

templates_browser_builtin.value: ブラウザーの SQLLY は組み込みテンプレートを使用します。
templates_browser_builtin.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Templates menu: notice in a hosted browser version (relay or Embedded) after choosing “Edit templates…”, explaining only built-in templates are available.

templates_browser_desktop.value: デスクトップ アプリでテンプレートを編集します。ブラウザのプレビューでは組み込みのテンプレートが使用されます。
templates_browser_desktop.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Templates menu: notice in the standalone browser preview after choosing “Edit templates…”, explaining templates can only be edited in the desktop app.

templates_button.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: small clickable text to the right of the prompt input that opens the menu of saved prompt templates.

templates_file_path.value: テンプレートファイル: {path}
templates_file_path.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Templates menu: notice shown after choosing “Edit templates…”, telling the user where the editable templates file lives; {path} is its full file path.

templates_file_unavailable.value: テンプレート ファイルは使用できません。
templates_file_unavailable.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Templates menu: notice shown after choosing “Edit templates…” when the location of the prompt templates file cannot be determined.

thinking_status.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation: dimmed placeholder inside the assistant's reply bubble while waiting for the model's answer.

tool_result.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: compact monospace row after an agent tool call summarizing the tool's result; the arrow means returned data and {count} is its length in characters.

tool_result_error.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: compact monospace row after an agent tool call that failed, summarizing the error result; {count} is its length in characters; keep it as short as “◂ 120 chars”.

turn_header.value: ターン {current}/{total} · ツール呼び出し {tool_call_count} 件
turn_header.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Agent mode: clickable, collapsible header above each agent turn; {current} is the turn number, {total} the turn limit and {tool_call_count} the number of tool calls in that turn.

unresolved_mentions.value: Couldn't resolve @{names};プレーンテキストとして送信される
unresolved_mentions.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt area: red notice after sending a prompt whose @-mentions matched no database object or file; {names} is the list of unmatched names joined by “, @”.

use_recent_conversation.value: 最近の会話を使用する
use_recent_conversation.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Prompt options: checkbox label that, when checked, sends recent earlier exchanges along with the new prompt as context.

user_message_label.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation: small caption at the top of each message bubble the user wrote, identifying the user as its author; pairs with “Assistant”.

validation_blocked_detail.value: Direct Run is unavailable. SQL をコピーまたは挿入し、実行する前にバリデーターの結果を解決します。
validation_blocked_detail.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: explanation under the red “Validation blocked execution” heading, saying the SQL cannot be run from the panel until the validator findings are fixed.

validation_blocked_title.value: 検証により実行がブロックされました
validation_blocked_title.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: red heading in the validation box under generated SQL that failed validation, so the panel will not run it.

validation_issue.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: one finding line in the validation box; {severity} is a level such as Error, Warning or Info and {message} is the validator's description.

validation_issue_clickable.value: {severity}: {message} — フラグの付いた場所をクリックして開きます
validation_issue_clickable.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: clickable finding line for an issue with a known position; clicking opens the SQL in a new tab at that spot; {severity} is the level, {message} the description.

validation_ready_detail.value: バリデーターでは、妨げとなる問題や確認要件は見つかりませんでした。
validation_ready_detail.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: explanation under the “Validated” heading, saying the validator found nothing that blocks the SQL or needs confirmation.

validation_ready_title.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: heading in the validation box under generated SQL that passed validation and can be run directly; adjective meaning “checked and approved”.

validation_review_detail.value: Direct Run is unavailable. SQL をコピーまたは挿入し、フラグが設定された操作を検査し、意図的であればエディターから明示的に実行します。
validation_review_detail.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: explanation under the “Review required” heading, saying the SQL contains an operation that must be checked and run explicitly from the editor.

validation_review_title.location: AI → Assistant Panel → Generate and Ask → Conversation → Generated SQL → Validation: amber heading in the validation box when the generated SQL contains an operation, such as a data change, that needs the user's review before running.

api_key_read_failed.value: プロバイダーキーを読み取れませんでした: {error}
api_key_read_failed.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown after clicking Run when the saved API key of the selected cloud provider cannot be read from secure storage; {error} is the system error.

api_key_required.value: まず、クラウド ペインで {provider} API キーを保存します。
api_key_required.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown after clicking Run when the selected cloud provider has no saved API key; {provider} is the provider profile name; “Cloud pane” is Settings → AI → Cloud.

browser_unavailable.value: AI Playground は利用できません
browser_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: feature name inserted into the browser version's “not available” message after clicking Run, since the Playground needs the desktop app.

cancel_button.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run controls: button beside Run, shown only while a prompt is running, that stops the response stream.

cloud_disclosure.value: Cloud prompts leave your device.まず、クラウド ペインでキーを設定し、モデル リストを取得します。
cloud_disclosure.location: Settings → AI → Playground: dimmed privacy note below the provider and model dropdowns, warning that prompts sent to cloud models leave the device; “Cloud pane” is Settings → AI → Cloud.

copy_response_button.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run controls: button, shown once the response area has text, that copies the full response to the clipboard.

introduction.value: 選択したローカルまたはクラウド モデルに 1 つの一時プロンプトを送信します。このペインには何もクエリ履歴に追加されず、設定を閉じても保存されません。
introduction.location: Settings → AI → Playground: introductory paragraph at the top of the pane explaining it sends one throwaway prompt to a model and that nothing here is kept.

metrics.value: 推定プロンプト: {prompt_tokens} トークン · 応答: {response_tokens} トークン · レイテンシ: {latency_ms} ミリ秒 · 応答の上限: {response_cap} 文字
metrics.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Response: dimmed statistics line below the response; token counts are estimates, {latency_ms} is time in milliseconds, {response_cap} the response character limit.

model_required.value: プロンプトを実行する前に、利用可能なモデルを選択してください。
model_required.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown when a prompt is run while no model is selected in the model dropdown.

no_models_available.value: 利用可能なモデルはありません
no_models_available.location: Settings → AI → Playground: placeholder in the model dropdown when the selected provider has no installed or fetched models.

profile_missing.value: 選択したクラウドプロファイルはもう存在しません。
profile_missing.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown after clicking Run when the selected cloud provider profile has been deleted on the Cloud pane.

prompt_character_count.location: AI → AI Playground → User prompt: counter below the prompt editor showing the current and maximum character counts.

prompt_placeholder.value: プロンプトを入力してください
prompt_placeholder.location: Settings → AI → Playground → User prompt: placeholder in the multi-line user prompt box.

prompt_required.value: モデルを実行する前にプロンプトを入力してください。
prompt_required.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown when Run is attempted while the user prompt box is empty.

prompt_too_long.value: プロンプトは {limit} 文字に制限されています。
prompt_too_long.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown when the user prompt is longer than allowed; {limit} is the maximum number of characters.

provider_key_missing.value: 選択したプロバイダーには保存された API キーがありません。
provider_key_missing.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown when a run with a cloud provider starts without any API key available for it.

provider_missing_profile.location: Settings → AI → Playground: provider dropdown option for a cloud profile that can no longer be found; {id} is that profile's internal identifier.

provider_mlx.location: Settings → AI → Playground: provider dropdown option for Apple MLX models running locally; the parenthetical means data stays on this computer.

provider_ollama.location: Settings → AI → Playground: provider dropdown option for Ollama models running locally; the parenthetical means data stays on this computer.

provider_profile.location: Settings → AI → Playground: provider dropdown option for a saved cloud provider profile; {name} is the profile name and {egress} a short word saying whether requests stay local or go to the cloud.

provider_unsupported.value: サポートされていないプレイグラウンド プロバイダーです。
provider_unsupported.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown when the chosen provider cannot be used by the Playground.

response_label.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Response: bold heading above the area where the model's answer streams in.

response_placeholder.value: 応答は文字制限までここにストリーミングされます。
response_placeholder.location: AI → AI Playground → Response: empty-state placeholder explaining that the bounded response streams into this area.

run_button.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run controls: button that sends the system instructions and user prompt to the selected model; disabled until a prompt and model are set.

status_cancelled.value: キャンセルされました。出力の一部がメモリに保持されました。
status_cancelled.location: AI → AI Playground → Run status: message shown after cancellation, explaining that partial response output remains available in memory.

status_complete.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: status line shown after the model's response has finished streaming.

status_idle.value: 準備完了 — プロンプトと応答は保存されません。
status_idle.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: status line shown before anything has run, reminding that prompts and responses are not saved.

status_running.value: 実行中… 出力が到着すると表示されます。
status_running.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: status line shown while a prompt is running, saying the response text appears as it arrives.

system_character_count.location: AI → AI Playground → System instructions: counter below the instructions editor showing the current and maximum character counts.

system_prompt_label.location: Settings → AI → Playground → System instructions: bold heading above the optional multi-line box for system instructions sent before the user prompt.

system_prompt_placeholder.value: オプションのシステム命令
system_prompt_placeholder.location: Settings → AI → Playground → System instructions: placeholder in the multi-line system instructions box, noting the field is optional.

system_prompt_too_long.value: システム命令は {limit} 文字に制限されています。
system_prompt_too_long.location: Settings → AI → Playground → Run status: error shown when the system instructions are longer than allowed; {limit} is the maximum number of characters.

token_limit_option.location: Settings → AI → Playground: option in the maximum response length dropdown beside the model picker; {count} is a token count such as 512.

user_prompt_label.location: Settings → AI → Playground → User prompt: bold heading above the multi-line box where the user types the prompt to send.

browser_unavailable.value: AIレビューは利用できません
browser_unavailable.location: Query editor → Data-change review → AI review: feature name inserted into the browser version's “not available” message when a connection requires an AI review before data changes run.

empty_review.value: モデルは空のレビューを返しました
empty_review.location: Query editor → Data-change review → AI review: lowercase reason inserted after “AI Review Unavailable — query not run:” in the status bar when the local model returned a blank review.

no_model_configured.value: AI モデルが構成されていません
no_model_configured.location: Query editor → Data-change review → AI review: lowercase reason inserted after “AI Review Unavailable — query not run:” in the status bar when no local AI model is selected for reviews.

runtime_http_error.value: ローカル AI ランタイムが HTTP {status} に応答しました
runtime_http_error.location: Query editor → Data-change review → AI review: lowercase reason inserted after “AI Review Unavailable — query not run:” when the local AI runtime returned an HTTP error; {status} is the HTTP status.

runtime_unreachable.value: ローカル AI ランタイムに到達できませんでした: {error}
runtime_unreachable.location: Query editor → Data-change review → AI review: lowercase reason inserted after “AI Review Unavailable — query not run:” when the local AI runtime (Ollama) cannot be contacted; {error} is the network error.

unexpected_response.location: Query editor → Data-change review → AI review: lowercase reason inserted after “AI Review Unavailable — query not run:” when the local AI runtime's reply cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error.

comment_selection_body.value:
この SQL の動作を変更せずに、明確なコメントを追加します。
${selection}
comment_selection_body.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: prompt text inserted when “Add comments to selection” is chosen, asking the AI to comment the SQL without changing what it does; ${selection} (after a line break) is the selected SQL and stays untranslated.

comment_selection_name.value: 選択範囲にコメントを追加する
comment_selection_name.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: built-in menu item that fills the prompt with a request to add explanatory comments to the selected SQL and switches the panel to the Generate tab; short imperative command name.

describe_table_body.value: ${database} で ${table} を説明します: 重要な列、キー、およびその使用方法。
describe_table_body.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: prompt text inserted when “Describe table” is chosen, asking for its important columns, keys and usage; ${table} is the last pinned table, ${database} the connected database. Keep placeholders untranslated.

describe_table_name.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: built-in menu item that fills the prompt with a request to describe a table and switches the panel to the Ask tab; ${table} is the most recently pinned table name. Short command name.

explain_selection_body.value:
この SQL を説明し、問題があれば指摘してください。
${selection}
explain_selection_body.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: prompt text inserted into the AI prompt box when “Explain selection” is chosen; ends with a line break followed by ${selection}, the SQL currently selected in the editor. Keep ${selection} untranslated.

explain_selection_name.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: built-in menu item that fills the prompt with a request to explain the SQL selected in the editor and switches the panel to the Ask tab; short imperative command name.

optimize_selection_body.value:
${database} の ${dialect} で、この SQL の高速バージョンを提案します。
${selection}
optimize_selection_body.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: prompt text inserted when “Optimize selection” is chosen; ${dialect} is the database engine family (e.g. postgres), ${database} the connected database name, ${selection} the selected SQL after a line break. Keep placeholders untranslated.

optimize_selection_name.location: AI assistant panel → Prompt box → Templates menu: built-in menu item that fills the prompt with a request for a faster rewrite of the selected SQL and switches the panel to the Generate tab; short imperative command name.

ok.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog: primary button at the bottom right that acknowledges the list of limitations and closes the dialog.

read_guide.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog: secondary button at the bottom left that opens the macOS documentation page on the SQLLY website in the web browser.

title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog: dialog title; the dialog opens once on first launch of the Mac App Store edition and later from the Help menu or Command Palette, listing what the sandboxed edition cannot do. “Mac App Store” is Apple’s store name.

inline_notice.value: {feature} 異なる点については、「ヘルプ」▸「Mac App Store エディション」を参照してください。
inline_notice.location: Settings and MCP panes in the Mac App Store edition → Unavailable feature notice: warning box shown in place of a feature the sandboxed edition can’t offer; {feature} is a sentence naming what is unavailable, followed by a pointer to the Help menu dialog.

intro.value: これは SQLLY の Mac App Store 版です。 Apple の App Sandbox は、Mac 上で他のプログラムを起動したり、選択していないファイルを読み取ったりすることを防ぐため、いくつかの点で動作が異なります。
intro.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog: introductory paragraph at the top explaining that Apple’s App Sandbox blocks launching other programs and reading unchosen files; ends with a colon because the list of limitations follows.

limitation_item.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold heading line for each limitation, a bullet followed by {title}, the limitation’s short title; a short explanation is shown indented below it.

detail.value: クラウド AI プロバイダーとローカルの Ollama サーバーは引き続き動作します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented note under the local AI agent tools heading saying cloud AI providers and a local Ollama server still work.

title.value: ローカル AI エージェント コマンドライン ツールを起動できない
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying local AI coding-agent command-line tools (agent CLIs installed on the Mac) cannot be started by SQLLY.

detail.value: 各エディションには独自のキーチェーン エントリがあるため、どちらのエディションも、もう一方のエディションを読み取るために Mac パスワードを要求することはありません。接続とそのパスワードを移動するには、一方のエディションでは [ファイル] ▸ [資格情報のエクスポート] を選択し、もう一方のエディションでは [ファイル] ▸ [接続のインポート] を選択して、エクスポートされたファイルを削除します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented guidance under the separate-data heading explaining each edition has its own keychain entries and how to move connections with File ▸ Export Credentials and File ▸ Import Connections.

title.value: 設定、保存された接続、パスワードは個別に保管されます
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying the App Store edition and the direct-download edition keep settings, saved connections and passwords separately.

detail.value: DuckDB の組み込み機能は引き続き機能します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented note under the DuckDB extensions heading saying DuckDB’s built-in features still work.

title.value: DuckDB 拡張機能がダウンロードまたはインストールされていない
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying DuckDB extensions are not downloaded or installed in this edition.

detail.value: Mac アプリのエディターはまだ開いています。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented note under the external editors heading saying editors that are regular Mac applications still open.

title.value: コマンドラインおよびターミナルエディタを開けない
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying external text editors that run in the command line or a terminal cannot be opened from SQLLY.

detail.value: SQLLY が隣に書き込む必要がある場合は、接続エディターで SSH キーと証明書を選択し、SQLite ファイルのフォルダー ([ファイル] ▸ [フォルダーを開く]) を開きます。 ~/.ssh/config、~/.pgpass、および ~/.kube は自動的に読み取られません。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented guidance under the file-access heading: pick SSH keys and certificates in the connection editor, open a SQLite file’s folder via File ▸ Open Folder, and note that ~/.ssh/config, ~/.pgpass and ~/.kube aren’t read automatically.

title.value: SQLLY は選択したファイルとフォルダーのみを読み取ります
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying the sandboxed app can only read files and folders the user has explicitly picked.

detail.value: SQL ライブラリとクエリ履歴は git なしでも機能します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented note under the git heading saying the SQL Library and query history keep working without git.

title.value: Git 統合は利用できません
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying SQLLY’s git version-control integration is unavailable in this edition.

detail.value: 接続エディターに転送されたホストとポートを入力します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented workaround under the Kubernetes heading telling the user to type the port-forwarded host and port into the connection editor manually.

title.value: Kubernetes ディスカバリー (kubectl) が使用できない
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying automatic discovery of Kubernetes databases via the kubectl tool is not available; “kubectl” is a command name.

detail.value: HTTP 経由でアクセスする MCP サーバーは引き続き機能します。 SQLLY は、他のアプリの MCP サーバーとして機能することはできません。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented note under the MCP heading saying MCP servers reached over HTTP still work, but SQLLY cannot itself serve as an MCP server for other apps.

title.value: ローカル (stdio) MCP サーバーを起動できない
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that run as local processes over standard input/output cannot be launched.

detail.value: ターミナルからコマンドライン クライアントを自分で実行します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented workaround under the Open in Terminal heading telling the user to start their command-line database clients from Terminal themselves.

title.value: ターミナルで開くことはできません
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying the “Open in Terminal” action (launching a database command-line client in Terminal) is not available in this edition.

detail.value: SQLLY 自体は更新をチェックしません。 App Store がそれらをインストールします。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented explanation under the updates heading saying SQLLY does not check for updates itself because the App Store installs them.

title.value: アップデートは Mac App Store から提供されます
title.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying this edition is updated through the Mac App Store rather than SQLLY’s own updater.
Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: bold limitation heading saying iCloud sync of connections and settings is not available in the App Store edition.

detail.value: 接続を別の Mac にコピーするには、他の Mac で [ファイル] ▸ [接続のエクスポート] を選択し、次に [ファイル] ▸ [接続のインポート] を選択します。
detail.location: Help menu → Mac App Store Edition dialog → Limitations list: indented guidance under the iCloud sync heading explaining how to copy connections to another Mac with export and import.

cancel.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: small button on a running task’s row that stops that export, dump or transfer.

clear_finished.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: clickable text in the popover footer that removes completed, failed and cancelled tasks from the list.

reveal.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: small button on a finished task’s row that shows the written output file in Finder or the system file manager.

chip_fallback.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip: fallback label on the status-bar chip, shown while the task list popover is open but no export, dump or transfer is running; very short noun.

empty.value: バックグラウンドタスクはまだありません。
empty.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: empty-state message shown in the popover body when no export, dump or transfer has been started in this session.

title.value: バックグラウンドタスク
title.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: header at the top of the popover that opens above the status-bar chip, listing exports, dumps and transfers with their progress.

with_total.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: progress line under a task’s name when the total is known; {rows} is rows processed so far, {total_rows} the total row count, {bytes} the data size written (e.g. “5.6 MB”).

without_total.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: progress line under a task’s name when the total row count is unknown; {rows} is rows processed so far, {bytes} the data size written (e.g. “5.6 MB”).

cancelled.value: キャンセルされました
cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: status line under a task’s progress after the user stopped the export, dump or transfer with its Cancel button; short state word.

finished.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: status line under a task’s progress once the export, dump or transfer completed successfully; short state word.

running.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: status line under a task’s progress while the export, dump or transfer is still in progress; short state word.

tooltip.value: バックグラウンドタスク
tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip: hover tooltip on the status-bar chip that toggles the list of exports, database dumps and data transfers running in the background.

connecting.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Loading overlay → Connection status: text shown while the hosted application connects to its configured server.

console_hint.value: 詳細については、ブラウザのコンソールを参照してください。
console_hint.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Fatal initialization error: guidance beneath the error detail directing the user to browser-console diagnostics.

download_failed.value: ダウンロードに失敗しました: HTTP {status}
download_failed.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Initialization error: HTTP status included when the application WASM or bundled sample database cannot be downloaded.

downloading.value: {received_mb} MB をダウンロード中…
downloading.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Download status: received megabytes shown when the server does not provide a content length.

downloading_progress.value: {received_mb} / {total_mb} MB をダウンロード中
downloading_progress.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Download status: received and total megabytes shown when the server provides a content length.

fact_cpu.value: その同じ秒間に、CPU はコアごとに数十億の命令を実行します。
fact_cpu.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: CPU-instruction fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_earth.value: その同じ秒間に、地球はあなたをその軌道に沿って約 30 km 運びます。
fact_earth.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: Earth orbital-distance fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_formula_one.value: その同じ秒間に、F1 カーは最高速度で約 100 メートル移動します。
fact_formula_one.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: Formula 1 distance fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_honeybee.value: その同じ秒間に、ミツバチは約 230 回羽ばたきます。
fact_honeybee.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: honeybee-wingbeat fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_hummingbird.value: その同じ秒間に、ハチドリは約 50 回羽ばたきます。
fact_hummingbird.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: hummingbird-wingbeat fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_light.value: その同じ秒間に、光は月までの道のほとんどを進みます。
fact_light.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: light-travel fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_sound.value: その同じ秒間に、音は部屋の中を約 343 メートル伝わります。
fact_sound.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: sound-travel fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_space_station.value: その同じ秒間に、国際宇宙ステーションはほぼ 8 km をカバーします。
fact_space_station.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: International Space Station distance fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_ssd.value: 同じ秒間で、SSD は数ギガバイトを読み取ることができます。
fact_ssd.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: SSD read-speed fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_tokenizer.value: その同じ秒間で、SQLLY のトークナイザーは数百万行の SQL を処理します。
fact_tokenizer.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: SQLLY tokenizer-throughput fact displayed while the application downloads.

go_button.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Reveal button: button that dismisses the completed loading overlay and opens the workbench.

load_failed_title.value: SQLLYのロードに失敗しました
load_failed_title.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Fatal initialization error: heading shown when SQLLY cannot start.

loading_application.value: アプリケーションをロード中…
loading_application.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Application module status: text shown while the JavaScript and WASM application modules load.

loading_chinook.value: Chinook サンプル データベースをロードしています…
loading_chinook.location: Standalone browser preview → Loading overlay → Sample status: text shown while the Chinook PostgreSQL sample finishes loading into PGlite.

preparing.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Initial status: text beneath the progress bar before the application WASM download begins.

preview_lead.value: SQLLY ブラウザーのプレビュー (タブ内デモ)。サーバーに到達できません。 SQLLY をマシンにインストールすると、1 秒以内に準備が整います。
preview_lead.location: Standalone browser preview → Loading overlay → Introductory paragraph: demo limitations and installed-application startup comparison shown during download.

preview_ready_title.value: SQLLY ブラウザ プレビュー (タブ内デモ) — 準備完了
preview_ready_title.location: Standalone browser preview → Document title: browser-tab title after the in-tab demo is ready.

preview_title.value: SQLLY ブラウザーのプレビュー (タブ内デモ)
preview_title.location: Standalone browser preview → Document title: browser-tab title while the in-tab demo loads.

ready.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Completion status: text shown when the application and sample data are ready to reveal.

served_lead.value: SQLLY は、管理者が設定したデータベースに接続しています。パスワードはサーバー上に残ります。
served_lead.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Loading overlay → Introductory paragraph: connection and server-side password explanation shown during startup.

served_ready_title.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Document title: browser-tab title after the hosted application is ready.

served_title.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Document title: browser-tab title while the hosted application loads.

starting.location: Standalone browser preview → Loading overlay → Startup status: text shown while SQLLY initializes the in-tab application.

build_failed.value: {filename}をダウンロードできませんでした: ファイルをビルドできませんでした ({error})
build_failed.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when the browser could not build the in-memory file (blob) holding the exported data; short failure phrase.

file_refused.value: {filename}をダウンロードできませんでした: ブラウザがファイルを拒否しました ({error})
file_refused.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when the browser refused to create a temporary download address for the exported file; short failure phrase.

link_failed.value: {filename}をダウンロードできませんでした: ダウンロードリンクを作成できませんでした ({error})
link_failed.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when the browser could not create the hidden download link used to save the exported file; short failure phrase.

no_document.value: {filename} をダウンロードできませんでした: 利用可能な DOM ドキュメントがありません
no_document.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when an export file can’t be downloaded because the browser page document is unavailable; the export file name is available as {filename}.

no_window.value: {filename} をダウンロードできませんでした: 使用可能な DOM ウィンドウがありません
no_window.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when an export file (results.csv etc.) can’t be downloaded because the browser page window object is unavailable; the export file name is available as {filename}.

launch_failed.value: ブラウザの起動に失敗しました: {error}
launch_failed.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown in the desktop app when the system command that opens the default web browser could not be started; {error} is the operating system’s error text.

no_dom_window.value: 使用可能な DOM ウィンドウがありません
no_dom_window.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: reason inserted into the browser version’s new-tab failure message when the page’s window object is unavailable; short phrase.

not_web_url.value: ブラウザで開くことができるのは http(s) リンクのみです
not_web_url.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown when a link SQLLY was asked to open is not an http or https web address, so it is refused for safety.

popup_blocked.value: ブラウザが新しいタブをブロックしました (ポップアップ ブロッカー) - このサイトのポップアップを許可します
popup_blocked.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: reason inserted into the browser version’s new-tab failure message when the browser’s popup blocker prevented the new tab from opening; short phrase.

tab_failed.value: ブラウザタブを開けませんでした: {error}
tab_failed.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown in the browser version when a link could not be opened in a new browser tab; {error} is the specific reason (no page window, popup blocked, or open failed).

unsupported_os.value: 現在の OS にはブラウザー オープナー コマンドが組み込まれていません
unsupported_os.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown when the desktop app runs on an operating system it doesn’t know how to open the default web browser on.

window_open_failed.value: ウィンドウオープンに失敗しました
window_open_failed.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: reason inserted into the browser version’s new-tab failure message when the browser threw an error while opening the new tab; short phrase.

badge.location: Browser version → Dialogs that can’t do real work in a browser (connection editor, Entra accounts, security) → Preview banner: short colored badge at the left of the info strip across the top, marking the dialog as illustrative only.

unavailable_served.value: {feature} SQLLY がブラウザーで実行される場合
unavailable_served.location: Browser version served by a relay proxy or SQLLY Embedded bridge → Unavailable feature message: completes a sentence about a feature the browser page can’t offer, explaining why without pointing to the desktop app.

unavailable_standalone.value: ブラウザーのプレビューで {feature} — デスクトップ アプリを使用します
unavailable_standalone.location: Browser preview (standalone, not served by a bridge) → Unavailable feature message: sentence shown when a desktop-only feature is used; {feature} names what is not available, and the text points the user to the desktop app.

edit.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for editing commands such as Find, Replace, Minify or toggle Vim mode; matches the Edit menu name.

file.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for file commands such as New Query, Open Notebook or Save Workspace; matches the File menu name.

help.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for help commands such as SQLLY Help, Tip of the Day, Send Feedback or Check for Updates; matches the Help menu name.

query.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for query commands such as Execute, Run notebook cell or Execute without rollback; matches the Query menu name.

quick_actions.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of rows for the user’s numbered quick-action SQL snippets (slots 1–9) defined in Settings.

tools.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for tool commands such as Query Builder, Relationship Graph or Connection Health; matches the Tools menu name.

view.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for layout commands such as toggling the sidebar, history or AI panel and splitting the editor; matches the View menu name.

window.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for tab navigation commands such as next or previous editor tab; matches the Window menu name.

analyze_last_run.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the AI panel seeded with the active tab’s most recent query run, including any error text and plan digest, and asks the AI to analyze it.

build_catalog.value: AI キャッシュと埋め込みを構築する
build_catalog.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that precomputes the AI cache and vector embeddings for the active connection’s schema catalog; long-running, needs a connected server, and reports embedding counts when done.

invalidate_data.value: AIカタログデータのクリア
invalidate_data.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that wipes AI-derived catalog data (object summaries and embeddings) for the active connection while keeping the structural schema catalog; needs a connected server.

mcp_server_settings.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Settings window directly on the AI → MCP pane, where the built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is configured.

toggle_agent_mode.value: エージェントモードの切り替え
toggle_agent_mode.location: Command Palette → View commands: command title that switches the AI panel’s agent mode on or off, letting the AI call database tools on the connected server; does nothing without an active connection.

add.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens the new-connection editor dialog for creating and saving a database connection profile.

connect.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title (verb, ending in an ellipsis because a window follows) that opens the Connection Management window to choose a saved connection and connect to it.

disconnect.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that disconnects the focused window’s active connection; a status-bar message appears if nothing is connected.

object_properties.value: オブジェクトのプロパティ…
object_properties.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Properties dialog for the active connection’s server (the same pages as the server node’s context menu); requires a connected server.

open_in_terminal.value: ターミナルで接続を開く
open_in_terminal.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that launches the active connection’s native command-line client (psql, mysql, sqlcmd, redis-cli, etc.) in a system terminal window.

refresh_explorer.value: オブジェクト エクスプローラーを更新する
refresh_explorer.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that reloads the Object Explorer sidebar tree, the active server’s schema nodes, and the IntelliSense catalog for that connection.

tunnel_profiles.value: トンネルプロファイルを管理…
tunnel_profiles.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the dialog for managing reusable tunnel profiles (proxy and/or SSH bastion hops) that connections can reference.

find.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that opens the find bar in the active query editor tab (search only, without the replace field).

replace.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that opens the editor’s find bar with the replace field shown, for find-and-replace in the active query tab.

format_document.value: ドキュメントのフォーマット
format_document.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that reformats the entire SQL buffer of the active editor with the current formatting settings, ignoring any selection; distinct from “Format SQL”, which formats only a selection when there is one.

minify.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that collapses SQL onto one compact line — the selection, or the statement under the caret — as a single undoable edit.

refresh_dates.value: 自然言語の日付を更新する
refresh_dates.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that re-evaluates every natural-language date marker (sqlly date comments such as “today”) in the active editor and rewrites the literal dates; the status bar reports how many changed.

toggle_vim_mode.value: Vim キーバインドの切り替え
toggle_vim_mode.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that turns Vim-style modal keybindings in the query editor on or off and saves the choice to editor settings.

close_tab.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that closes the active editor tab (prompting to save when it has unsaved changes).

export_connections.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a server and database picker and writes the chosen saved connections to a SQLLY connection file without any passwords.

export_credentials.value: 認証付きの接続をエクスポート…
export_credentials.location: Command Palette → File commands: abbreviated command title (“Conn w/ Creds” = connections with credentials; keep it short) that exports chosen saved connections to a connection file including passwords in clear text.

import_connections.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a SQLLY connection file and adds its connections to the saved list, moving any included passwords into the OS keychain.

import_connections_from_tools.value: 他のツールからインポート…
import_connections_from_tools.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a connection export from another database tool (for example TablePlus or Redis Insight) and imports the connections it recognizes.

export_for_pg_admin.value: pgAdmin (servers.json) 用にエクスポート…
export_for_pg_admin.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved PostgreSQL connections and saves them as a pgAdmin servers.json file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_azure_data_studio.value: Azure Data Studio / VS Code 用のエクスポート (settings.json)…
export_for_azure_data_studio.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as an Azure Data Studio / VS Code settings.json file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_pg_service.value: PostgreSQL サービス ファイル (pg_service.conf) としてエクスポート…
export_for_pg_service.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved PostgreSQL connections and saves them as a PostgreSQL connection service file (pg_service.conf) without passwords; keep the file name unchanged.

export_for_dbeaver.value: DBeaver 用にエクスポート (data-sources.json)…
export_for_dbeaver.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as a DBeaver data-sources.json file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_data_grip.value: DataGrip 用にエクスポート (dataSources.xml)…
export_for_data_grip.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as a DataGrip / JetBrains dataSources.xml file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_db_gate.value: DbGate 用にエクスポート (.env)…
export_for_db_gate.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as a DbGate connection environment (.env) file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

manage_workspaces.value: ワークスペースの管理
manage_workspaces.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens the workspace manager to rename, duplicate, or delete saved workspaces (named sets of open tabs and layout).

new_notebook.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a new, empty notebook tab mixing runnable SQL cells and Markdown cells.
