clickhouse_native_port_label.value: ネイティブ ポート (ターミナルで開きます: clickhouse-client はネイティブ プロトコルを話します。空白 = 9000、または TLS の 9440)
clickhouse_native_port_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Connection options → ClickHouse: label of the optional native-protocol port field (ClickHouse only), explaining it is used by Open in Terminal’s clickhouse-client and what a blank value defaults to.

clickhouse_native_port_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Connection options → ClickHouse: placeholder inside the empty Native port field, saying the port is chosen automatically (9000, or 9440 when TLS is on).

client_certificate_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Encryption → TLS settings: label of the path input (with a Browse… button) for the client certificate file presented to the server for certificate-based TLS authentication.

client_key_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Encryption → TLS settings: label of the path input (with a Browse… button) for the private key file that belongs to the client certificate.

client_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Organization row: label of the free-text Client field at the bottom of the form, beside Project; it groups connections by customer and autocompletes from client names already saved.

compatibility_cockroachdb.value: PostgreSQL プロトコル経由で接続します。カタログの詳細は異なる場合があります (ルーチン定義では CockroachDB 固有のクエリが使用されます)。プロシージャ モード、デザイナー、セキュリティ エディタは使用できません。
compatibility_cockroachdb.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when CockroachDB is the selected engine, explaining it connects over the PostgreSQL protocol and which SQLLY features are unavailable.

compatibility_elasticache.value: Redis プロトコル用の Amazon ElastiCache または Redis プロトコル上の Valkey。転送中の暗号化は、TLS Require または Verify full を意味します。クラスター モードがサポートされています。構成エンドポイントで接続をポイントし、SQLLY でスロットを所有するノードに各コマンドをルーティングします (1 つの論理データベース、クロススロットのマルチキー コマンドは拒否されました)。セキュリティエディターは利用できません (Amazon は AWS コンソールでユーザーを管理します)。 Redis スタック モジュールは ElastiCache では使用できないため、Indexes フォルダーとモジュールの形状は適用されません。
compatibility_elasticache.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when Amazon ElastiCache is the selected engine, explaining TLS settings, cluster-mode routing and which Redis features do not apply.

compatibility_memorydb.value: Redis プロトコル上の Amazon MemoryDB。 TLS が必須であり、ACL ユーザー名が「ユーザー名」フィールドに入力されます。 MemoryDB は常にクラスターです。SQLLY は各コマンドをそのスロットを所有するシャードにルーティングし (1 つの論理データベース、スロット間のマルチキー コマンドは拒否されます)、クラスター トポロジ ビューにシャードがリストされます。セキュリティエディターは利用できません (Amazon は AWS コンソールでユーザーを管理します)。 MemoryDB は、マネージド機能として JSON およびベクトル検索を提供します。 JSON.* および FT.* の応答が整形され、FT._LIST が応答すると Indexes フォルダーが表示されます。
compatibility_memorydb.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when Amazon MemoryDB is the selected engine, explaining required TLS, the ACL user name, cluster routing and supported JSON/search features.

compatibility_mysql.value: 標準の MySQL。デザイナーは利用できません。
compatibility_mysql.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options for managed MySQL services (Amazon Aurora, Amazon RDS, Cloud SQL for MySQL), stating it behaves as plain MySQL without the designers.

compatibility_mysql_tls.value: TLS が必要な接続で標準の MySQL を使用します。デザイナーは利用できません。
compatibility_mysql_tls.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server is selected, stating it is plain MySQL that requires TLS, without the designers.

compatibility_planetscale.value: MySQL プロトコル経由で接続します。 TLS が必要です。外部キーは、データベースに対して有効になっている場合にのみ表示されます。デザイナーとセキュリティ エディターは使用できません。
compatibility_planetscale.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when PlanetScale is the selected engine, explaining it uses the MySQL protocol with required TLS and which features are unavailable.

compatibility_postgres.value: 標準の PostgreSQL。デザイナーは利用できません。
compatibility_postgres.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options for managed PostgreSQL services (Aurora, RDS, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Supabase), stating it behaves as plain PostgreSQL without the designers.

compatibility_postgres_tls.value: TLS が必要な接続で標準の PostgreSQL を使用します。デザイナーは利用できません。
compatibility_postgres_tls.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server or Neon is selected, stating it is plain PostgreSQL that requires TLS, without the designers.

compatibility_redis_protocol.value: Redis プロトコルを話します。コマンド エディター、キー ブラウザー、サーバー ダッシュボード、アクティビティ モニター、ディスク使用率、およびセキュリティ ツールの ACL ページは Redis 上と同様に機能します。一部のコマンドは異なります (KeyDB と DragonflyDB には FUNCTION LIST がありません。DragonflyDB には CLIENT LIST の user= が省略されます)。 Redis スタック モジュールの応答 (JSON、Search、TimeSeries、Bloom) は、サーバーが応答するたびに形成されます。Valkey と KeyDB はモジュールがロードされた場合のみ、DragonflyDB は組み込みの JSON と Search を使用します。
compatibility_redis_protocol.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when Valkey, KeyDB or DragonflyDB is selected, listing which Redis tools work and which commands or modules differ.

compatibility_tidb.value: MySQL プロトコル (ポート 4000) 経由で接続します。 TiDB にはストアド プロシージャがないため、ルーチン フォルダーは空です。デザイナーとセキュリティ エディターは使用できません。
compatibility_tidb.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when TiDB is the selected engine, explaining it uses the MySQL protocol on port 4000, has no stored procedures, and lacks designers.

compatibility_yugabytedb.value: PostgreSQL プロトコル (YSQL、ポート 5433) 経由で接続します。カタログの詳細は異なる場合があります。デザイナーとセキュリティ エディターは使用できません。
compatibility_yugabytedb.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim note shown above the encryption options when YugabyteDB is the selected engine, explaining it uses the PostgreSQL protocol (YSQL, port 5433) and which features are unavailable.

confirm_changes_label.value: 実行前にデータの変更を確認する
confirm_changes_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Connection options: checkbox label among the safety checkboxes; when ticked, statements that change data must be confirmed by the user before they run on this connection.

connection_name_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Name: placeholder text inside the empty Name input at the top of the form, where the user types the display name of the saved connection.

connection_string_filled.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Footer status: green status text left of the Test/Save buttons after a pasted connection string (Paste URL…) was read and used to fill in the form.

connection_string_filled_ignored.value: 接続文字列から入力 — {ignored_count} オプションは無視されます
connection_string_filled_ignored.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Footer status: green status text after a pasted connection string filled in the form but some of its options were not recognized; {ignored_count} is the number of options skipped.

connection_string_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Paste URL…: label of the input revealed by the Paste URL… button below the engine dropdown, where the user pastes a database URL or connection string to fill in the form.

connection_string_read_failed.value: 接続文字列を読み取れませんでした: {error}
connection_string_read_failed.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form errors: red error shown at the bottom of the form when a pasted connection string could not be parsed; {error} is the reason from the parser.

connection_test_stopped.value: 接続テストが停止しました: {error}
connection_test_stopped.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Footer status: failed Test result shown when the step-by-step Redis connection check stopped unexpectedly before finishing; {error} is the technical reason.

database_all_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Database: short checkbox label to the right of the Database input; when ticked, the connection is not limited to one database and the Database input is cleared and disabled. Keep very short.

database_engine_label.value: データベースエンジン
database_engine_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: label of the dropdown below Name where the user chooses the database engine or managed service type for the connection.

database_file_label.value: データベースファイル
database_file_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: label that replaces “Server” above the main path input when SQLite or DuckDB is the engine; the field holds the path of the database file.

database_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: label above the Database input (with its dropdown arrow and “all” checkbox) where the user sets the default database to open.

database_user_label.value: データベースユーザー
database_user_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → AWS RDS IAM: label of the input for the database user name that signs in with an AWS IAM token instead of a password.

databases_empty.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Database dropdown: empty-state line inside the list opened from the Database field’s arrow when the server returned no databases.

databases_loading.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Database dropdown: progress text inside the list opened from the Database field’s arrow while the database names are being fetched from the server.

derived_connection_name.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Name: fallback name filled into an empty Name field after pasting a connection string that names neither a database nor a server. A generic noun.

direct_tls_label.value: ダイレクト TLS (PostgreSQL 17 以降)
direct_tls_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Encryption → TLS settings: checkbox label for PostgreSQL-protocol engines when TLS is on; starts the TLS handshake immediately (needs PostgreSQL 17 or later), as required by proxies that route by host name.

display_zone_app_setting.value: アプリ設定を使用する
display_zone_app_setting.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options → Display time zone dropdown: first option, the default, that uses the time zone from Settings → Results → Date.

display_zone_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options: label of the searchable dropdown that picks the time zone result grids from this connection show dates and epoch timestamps in; sits below Startup SQL.

display_zone_local.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options → Display time zone dropdown: option that shows this connection's dates in the computer's local time zone.

display_zone_utc.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options → Display time zone dropdown: option that shows this connection's dates in UTC.

duckdb_credentials_note.value: DuckDB は選択されたファイルを直接開きます (スクラッチ データベースの場合は :memory: )。資格情報は必要ありません。
duckdb_credentials_note.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Authentication: note shown instead of the sign-in choices when DuckDB is the engine, explaining it opens the chosen file (or an in-memory database) with no credentials.

duplicate_missing_password.location: Duplicate Connection dialog → Missing-secret notice: lowercase noun inserted into the duplicate warning notice, naming the database password that could not be copied from the keychain.

duplicate_missing_proxy_password.location: Duplicate Connection dialog → Missing-secret notice: lowercase noun inserted into the duplicate warning notice, naming the proxy server password that could not be copied from the keychain.

duplicate_missing_ssh_secret.value: SSH パスワードまたはキーのパスフレーズ
duplicate_missing_ssh_secret.location: Duplicate Connection dialog → Missing-secret notice: lowercase noun phrase inserted into the duplicate warning notice, naming the SSH password or key passphrase that could not be copied from the keychain.

duplicate_notice_one.value: このコピーは、保存された {first} なしで開始されます。オリジナルはシステム キーチェーンから読み取ることができませんでした。保存する前に入力してください。そうしないと、コピーはサインインできなくなります。
duplicate_notice_one.location: Duplicate Connection dialog → Name: warning text under the Name field when one secret of the original could not be read from the keychain; {first} is that secret’s name, such as “password”.

duplicate_notice_three.value: このコピーは、保存された {first}、{second}、および {third} なしで開始されます。オリジナルはシステム キーチェーンから読み取ることができませんでした。保存する前にこれらを入力してください。そうしないと、コピーはサインインできなくなります。
duplicate_notice_three.location: Duplicate Connection dialog → Name: warning text under the Name field when three secrets of the original could not be read from the keychain; {first}, {second} and {third} are the secret names.

duplicate_notice_two.value: このコピーは、保存された {first} および {second} なしで開始されます。オリジナルはシステム キーチェーンから読み取ることができませんでした。保存する前にこれらを入力してください。そうしないと、コピーはサインインできなくなります。
duplicate_notice_two.location: Duplicate Connection dialog → Name: warning text under the Name field when two secrets of the original could not be read from the keychain; {first} and {second} are the secret names.

encrypt_connection_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Connection options → Encryption: checkbox label for engines without the TLS mode dropdown (such as SQL Server); encrypts traffic to the server. Forced on and disabled when the engine or IAM sign-in requires it.

encryption_required.value: このエンジンには暗号化された接続が必要です
encryption_required.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form errors: red error shown on Save or Test when the selected engine only accepts encrypted connections but “Encrypt connection” is off.

engine_auto_detect_hint.value: 接続時に Redis、Valkey、KeyDB、DragonflyDB のいずれかを検出します
engine_auto_detect_hint.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine: dim line under the engine dropdown while the Redis-compatible Auto-detect entry is chosen; shown before anything is detected. The product is read from the server when you connect.

engine_auto_detected.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine: dim line under the engine dropdown while the Redis-compatible Auto-detect entry is chosen; {engine_name} is the detected product, such as Valkey or Amazon ElastiCache.

engine_auto_detected_tls.value: 検出されました: {engine_name} · TLS が必要です
engine_auto_detected_tls.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine: dim line under the engine dropdown while the Redis-compatible Auto-detect entry is chosen; {engine_name} is a detected managed service, such as Amazon MemoryDB, that only accepts encrypted connections.

engine_mysql_compatible.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine dropdown: option label for a service that speaks the MySQL protocol; {engine_name} is the product, such as TiDB or PlanetScale.

engine_note_oracle.value: このマシンには Oracle Instant Client (Basic または Basic Light) がインストールされている必要があります。接続時に SQLLY によってロードされます。データベースはサービス名です。接頭辞として SID を付けます。SID で接続するには、管理セッションのユーザー名の後に「AS SYSDBA」を追加するか、TCPS またはウォレットのサーバーに完全な接続記述子を追加します。 SSH トンネル、プロキシ、ポートフォワードはプレーンなホストとポートを再ルーティングします。接続記述子または tnsnames エイリアスは、リスナーに直接ダイヤルします。バックアップはサーバー上の RMAN または Data Pump を通じて実行されます。 SQL エージェント、ガイド付きデザイナー、および拡張イベントは SQL Server の機能です。
engine_note_oracle.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Engine note: dim setup note shown above the encryption options when Oracle is the engine, covering the required Instant Client, service name vs SID, SYSDBA, connect descriptors, tunnels and unsupported tools.

engine_postgresql_compatible.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine dropdown: option label for a service that speaks the PostgreSQL protocol; {engine_name} is the product, such as CockroachDB or Neon.

engine_redis_auto_detect.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine dropdown: option label that detects which Redis-protocol product the server is (Redis, Valkey, KeyDB, DragonflyDB, Amazon ElastiCache or MemoryDB) from the host name and on connect.

engine_redis_compatible.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Database engine dropdown: option label for a service that speaks the Redis protocol; {engine_name} is the product, such as Valkey or Amazon MemoryDB.

entra_auth_hint.value: 資格情報は Entra (ブラウザ) トークン キャッシュから解決されます。以下から、または [ツール] ▸ [Azure SQL 接続…] からサインインしたアカウントを選択します。
entra_auth_hint.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Entra (browser): help text under the sign-in buttons explaining credentials come from the Entra browser sign-in cache and pointing to the account list below or the Tools menu’s Azure SQL Connection command.

entra_tenant_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Entra account list: dim second line under each signed-in Entra account name, showing which Azure tenant it belongs to; {tenant_id} is the tenant’s ID.

environment_section.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: section heading above the environment selector buttons (such as Development, Staging, Production), below the connection options checkboxes.

file_engine_credentials_note.value: {engine_name} は選択したファイルを直接開きます。資格情報は必要ありません。
file_engine_credentials_note.location: New/Edit Connection dialog and Connections & Settings → Authentication: note shown instead of the sign-in choices for a file-based engine such as SQLite; {engine_name} is the engine name. No credentials are needed.

gcp_adc_check_again.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: small button under the credentials status line that re-checks whether Google Application Default Credentials are available on this machine.

gcp_adc_check_failed.value: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報を確認できませんでした
gcp_adc_check_failed.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: status line shown when the background check for Google Application Default Credentials could not complete at all.

gcp_adc_checking.value: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報を確認しています…
gcp_adc_checking.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: status line shown while SQLLY checks whether Google Application Default Credentials are available on this machine.

gcp_adc_error.value: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報を確認できませんでした: {error}
gcp_adc_error.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: status line shown when Google Application Default Credentials were not usable; {error} is the reason reported by the Google credentials check.

gcp_adc_found.value: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報が見つかりました
gcp_adc_found.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: status line confirming Google Application Default Credentials were found, so the IAM sign-in token can be generated on connect.

gcp_iam_hint.value: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報 (`gcloud auth application-default login`) が必要です。トークンは接続時に作成されます。
gcp_iam_hint.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: help text at the end of the Google Cloud IAM fields, saying Application Default Credentials (gcloud login) are required and the token is generated when connecting.

gcp_iam_user_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Cloud SQL IAM: label of the input for the IAM database user (Google account or service account) that signs in to Cloud SQL with an IAM token.

host_validation_invalid_host.value: 有効な IP、ホスト名、または *.domain ワイルドカードではありません。
host_validation_invalid_host.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Server field validation: red inline error under the Server and Port fields (and Save/Test error) when the server text is not a valid IP address, host name or *.domain wildcard.

host_validation_invalid_instance.value: 無効なインスタンス名です。
host_validation_invalid_instance.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Server field validation: red inline error under the Server and Port fields (and Save/Test error) when the SQL Server instance name after the backslash in the server text is invalid.

iam_tls_hint.value: IAM サインインは常に TLS を使用します
iam_tls_hint.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Connection options → Encryption: dim note under the encryption options when AWS RDS IAM or Cloud SQL IAM sign-in is selected, explaining that encryption is always on for IAM sign-in.

integrated_auth_hint.value: 資格情報は、システムの Windows トークン キャッシュから解決されます。
integrated_auth_hint.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Windows integrated: help text shown in place of username and password fields, explaining that the signed-in Windows account’s credentials are used.

invalid_ssh_secret_id.value: 内部: 無効な SSH シークレット ID
invalid_ssh_secret_id.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form errors: internal error shown on Save if the stored reference for the SSH password or key passphrase is malformed, so the secret cannot be saved to the keychain. Rare; technical wording is fine.

jump_host_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Tunnel / Proxy → SSH tunnel → Jump host: label of the host name input for the intermediate SSH server the tunnel hops through, shown after ticking “Use a jump host”.

jump_host_shared_auth_note.value: ジャンプ ホストは、ターゲット ホップと同じ認証とシークレットを使用します。
jump_host_shared_auth_note.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Tunnel / Proxy → SSH tunnel → Jump host: small note above the jump host fields explaining the jump server uses the same SSH authentication method and secret as the main SSH server.

jump_port_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Tunnel / Proxy → SSH tunnel → Jump host: label of the narrow port input beside the Jump host field, for the intermediate SSH server’s port (not the main SSH host’s Port field).

jump_username_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Tunnel / Proxy → SSH tunnel → Jump host: label of the input for the user name to sign in to the intermediate SSH jump server.

keepalive_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Tunnel / Proxy → SSH tunnel: label of the small input for how many seconds between SSH keepalive messages that keep an idle tunnel open.

kube_browser_unavailable.value: SQLLY がブラウザーで実行されている場合、Kubernetes ポート転送は使用できません
kube_browser_unavailable.location: Browser version (served by a relay or embedded server) → New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: note shown under the section heading instead of the port-forward fields, saying the feature is not available in a browser.

kube_context_empty.value: Kubernetes コンテキストを設定するときに空にすることはできません
kube_context_empty.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when a Kubernetes context was set but is blank.

kube_context_invalid.value: Kubernetes コンテキストに無効な文字が含まれています
kube_context_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the chosen Kubernetes context name contains characters that are not allowed.

kube_context_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: label of the dropdown choosing the kubeconfig context (cluster and user) to forward through, with a Refresh button beside it.

kube_deployment.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Target kind dropdown: option for forwarding to a Kubernetes Deployment (a pod of that deployment is used). Kubernetes resource name; often left untranslated.

kube_desktop_required.value: Kubernetes ポートフォワードにはデスクトップ アプリが必要です
kube_desktop_required.location: Browser version (web preview) → New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: note shown under the section heading instead of the port-forward fields, saying the feature requires the desktop app.

kube_duckdb_unavailable.value: DuckDB はローカル ファイルを開きます。転送元のクラスターがありません
kube_duckdb_unavailable.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: note shown under the section heading instead of the port-forward fields when DuckDB is the engine, since it opens a local file.

kube_engine_unavailable.value: Kubernetes ポートフォワードはこのエンジンではまだ利用できません
kube_engine_unavailable.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: note shown under the section heading instead of the port-forward fields when the selected engine does not support port-forwarding yet.

kube_namespace_invalid.value: Kubernetes 名前空間に無効な文字が含まれています
kube_namespace_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the Kubernetes namespace contains characters that are not allowed.

kube_namespace_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: label of the dropdown choosing the Kubernetes namespace that holds the target, with a Refresh button beside it.

kube_namespace_required.value: Kubernetes 名前空間が必要です
kube_namespace_required.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when port-forwarding is on but no Kubernetes namespace is given.

kube_pod.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Target kind dropdown: option (the default) for forwarding directly to a single Kubernetes Pod. Kubernetes resource name; often left untranslated.

kube_refresh_contexts.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Context: Refresh button to the right of the Context dropdown that reloads the context list from the kubeconfig file; its text also fills the “Refreshing …” status.

kube_refresh_namespaces.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Namespace: Refresh button to the right of the Namespace dropdown that reloads namespaces from the cluster; its text also fills the “Refreshing …” status.

kube_refresh_targets.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Target: Refresh button to the right of the Target dropdown that reloads the pods, services or deployments of the chosen kind; its text also fills the “Refreshing …” status.

kube_refreshing.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: status line under the port-forward fields while a list is reloading from the cluster; {resource_kind} is filled with the text of the Refresh button that was clicked.

kube_remote_port_invalid.value: リモート ポートは 1 ～ 65535 である必要があります
kube_remote_port_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the Remote port is not a whole number from 1 to 65535.

kube_remote_port_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: label of the input for the database port inside the cluster that the local forward connects to.

ssm_section.value: AWS セッションマネージャー
ssm_section.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: section heading for the AWS Systems Manager Session Manager port-forward options, below the Kubernetes port-forward section.

use_ssm_label.value: AWS セッションマネージャー経由で接続する
use_ssm_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager section: checkbox that routes the connection through an AWS Session Manager port-forward started on an EC2 instance, revealing the target, region, profile and remote host fields.

ssm_target_label.value: ターゲットインスタンス
ssm_target_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: label of the input for the EC2 instance id (or other managed node id) the Session Manager session starts on.

ssm_target_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: placeholder inside the empty Target instance input, showing the shape of an EC2 instance id.

ssm_region_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: label of the input for the AWS region the instance runs in.

ssm_region_placeholder.value: AWS CLI のデフォルト
ssm_region_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: placeholder inside the empty Region input, saying the AWS CLI's configured default region is used when left blank.

ssm_profile_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: label of the input for the named profile from ~/.aws/config used to start the session.

ssm_profile_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: placeholder inside the empty AWS profile input, showing the name of the AWS CLI profile used when left blank (a literal profile name, not translated).

ssm_remote_host_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: label of the input for the database host name or address the instance forwards to, when it differs from the connection's server.

ssm_remote_host_placeholder.value: 接続のサーバー (デフォルト)
ssm_remote_host_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: placeholder inside the empty Remote host input, saying the connection's own server name is used when left blank.

ssm_aws_cli_missing.value: AWS CLI (aws) が見つかりませんでした。 AWS CLI v2 をインストールして、AWS Session Manager 経由で接続します。
ssm_aws_cli_missing.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Status line: dimmed notice under the section when the AWS command-line tool is not installed.

ssm_plugin_missing.value: AWS セッション マネージャー プラグイン (session-manager-plugin) が見つかりませんでした。 AWS Session Manager 経由で接続するには、これをインストールします。
ssm_plugin_missing.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Status line: dimmed notice under the section when the AWS CLI is installed but its Session Manager plugin is not.

ssm_desktop_required.value: AWS Session Managerにはデスクトップアプリが必要です
ssm_desktop_required.location: Browser version (web preview) → New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: note shown under the section heading instead of the Session Manager fields, saying the feature requires the desktop app.

ssm_browser_unavailable.value: SQLLY がブラウザで実行されている場合、AWS Session Manager は使用できません
ssm_browser_unavailable.location: Browser version (served by a relay or embedded server) → New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: note shown under the section heading instead of the Session Manager fields, saying the feature is not available in a browser.

ssm_sqlite_unavailable.value: SQLite はローカル ファイルを開きます。転送先のリモートサーバーがありません
ssm_sqlite_unavailable.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: note shown under the section heading instead of the Session Manager fields when SQLite is the engine, since it opens a local file.

ssm_duckdb_unavailable.value: DuckDB はローカル ファイルを開きます。転送先のリモートサーバーがありません
ssm_duckdb_unavailable.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: note shown under the section heading instead of the Session Manager fields when DuckDB is the engine, since it opens a local file.

ssm_engine_unavailable.value: AWS Session Manager はこのエンジンではまだ利用できません
ssm_engine_unavailable.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager: note shown under the section heading instead of the Session Manager fields when the selected engine cannot use a tunnel yet.

transport_ssm_combination_invalid.value: AWS Session Manager を他のトンネルまたはプロキシ ホップと組み合わせることはできません
transport_ssm_combination_invalid.location: Connection editor dialog → Form error line: inline validation error on Save or Test when AWS Session Manager is enabled together with an SSH tunnel, proxy or Kubernetes port-forward, which is not allowed.

ssm_target_required.value: AWS Session Managerターゲットが必要です
ssm_target_required.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when Session Manager is on but no target instance id is entered.

ssm_target_invalid.value: AWS Session Manager ターゲットに無効な文字が含まれています
ssm_target_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the target instance id contains spaces or characters an instance id cannot have.

ssm_region_invalid.value: AWS リージョンに無効な文字が含まれています
ssm_region_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the Region input contains spaces or characters a region name cannot have.

ssm_profile_invalid.value: AWS プロファイルに無効な文字が含まれています
ssm_profile_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the AWS profile input contains spaces or characters a profile name cannot have.

ssm_remote_host_invalid.value: AWS Session Manager リモートホストに無効な文字が含まれています
ssm_remote_host_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → AWS Session Manager → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the Remote host input contains spaces or characters a host name cannot have.

kube_section.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: section heading for the Kubernetes port-forward options, below the Tunnel / Proxy section, where a connection can be routed through kubectl port-forward.

kube_service.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Target kind dropdown: option for forwarding to a Kubernetes Service. Kubernetes resource name; often left untranslated.

kube_sqlite_unavailable.value: SQLite はローカル ファイルを開きます。転送元のクラスターがありません
kube_sqlite_unavailable.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: note shown under the section heading instead of the port-forward fields when SQLite is the engine, since it opens a local file.

kube_target_invalid.value: Kubernetes ターゲット名に無効な文字が含まれています
kube_target_invalid.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when the target pod, service or deployment name contains characters that are not allowed.

kube_target_kind_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: label of the dropdown choosing whether the forward targets a Pod, a Service or a Deployment.

kube_target_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: label of the dropdown choosing the specific pod, service or deployment to forward to, with a Refresh button beside it.

kube_target_required.value: Kubernetes ターゲット名は必須です
kube_target_required.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when port-forwarding is on but no target pod, service or deployment name is chosen.

kubeconfig_empty.value: Kubeconfig パスを設定するときに空にすることはできません
kubeconfig_empty.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward → Form errors: red error on Save or Test when a kubeconfig path was set but is blank.

kubeconfig_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: label of the input for the path of the kubeconfig file that lists clusters and credentials; first field after ticking the port-forward checkbox.

kubeconfig_placeholder.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Kubernetes port-forward: placeholder inside the empty Kubeconfig input, showing the default file path used when it is left blank.

manage_tunnels_button.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Tunnel / Proxy: button under the Tunnel profile dropdown that opens the manager for reusable, named SSH/proxy tunnel profiles.

name_label.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form body: label of the first input at the top of the form, holding the display name of the saved connection.

name_required.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Form errors: red error shown at the bottom of the form on Save or Test when the Name field is empty.

no_entra_users.value: Entra アカウントはまだ登録されていません。
no_entra_users.location: New/Edit Connection dialog → Authentication → Entra (browser): empty-state line where the list of signed-in Entra accounts would appear, shown when no account has signed in yet.

no_relay_devices_hint.value: 直接接続します。アカウントに中継デバイスがまだ登録されていません。
no_relay_devices_hint.location: Connection editor → Routing section: dimmed help text shown in place of the relay controls when you are signed in but your account has no relay devices registered; the connection goes straight to the server.

no_tunnel_profile.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Tunnel profile dropdown: first option, selected by default, meaning no saved tunnel profile is used and the SSH/proxy settings are entered directly (inline) in this form.

optional_client_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Client and Project row (bottom of the form): placeholder in the Client text field, saying a client name is not required; typing completes against client names already saved.

optional_database_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Connection details → Database field: placeholder in the database name input for every engine except Oracle, saying the database is not required (the server default is used).

optional_project_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Client and Project row (bottom of the form): placeholder in the Project text field beside Client, saying a project name is not required; typing completes against project names already saved.

oracle_database_placeholder.value: サービス名 (または SID:ORCL)
oracle_database_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Connection details → Database field: placeholder shown only for Oracle, asking for the service name, or a SID written with the “SID:” prefix (e.g. SID:ORCL); keep “SID:ORCL” unchanged.

password_label.location: Connection editor → Authentication section: label above the password input for SQL Login, shown below the Username field; the password is stored in the system keychain.

password_option.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel → Authentication dropdown: option that signs in to the SSH server with a password (alongside “SSH agent” and “Private key file”).

password_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Authentication section → Password field: masked placeholder in the empty SQL Login password input, lowercase noun.

paste_url_button.location: Connection editor → Connection details: small button beside the Database engine field that opens a Connection string box where you paste a URL or connection string to fill in the form.

port_invalid.value: ポートは有効な番号である必要があります
port_invalid.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the Port field beside Server is not a whole number from 0 to 65535 (for example empty or containing letters).

port_label.location: Connection editor → Connection details: label above the narrow Port input to the right of the Server field (the database server port); short space.

private_key_file_filter.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel → Browse for private key: file-type filter name in the system open-file dialog, matching .pem, .key, .ppk and extensionless key files.

private_key_file_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: label above the private key path input (with a Browse button), shown when SSH Authentication is set to “Private key file”.

private_key_option.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel → Authentication dropdown: option that signs in to the SSH server with a private key file (optionally protected by a passphrase).

production_disabled.location: Connection editor → Safety options → Production mode: third chip in the three-way segmented control; forces this connection to be treated as not production regardless of its environment.

production_enabled.location: Connection editor → Safety options → Production mode: middle chip in the three-way segmented control; marks this connection as production regardless of its environment.

production_inherit.location: Connection editor → Safety options → Production mode: first chip in the three-way segmented control; the production flag follows the Environment chosen below (Production environment = production).

production_mode_label.value: プロダクションモード
production_mode_label.location: Connection editor → Safety options: label above the three-chip segmented control (Inherit from environment / Production / Not production), below the safety checkboxes.

project_label.location: Connection editor → Client and Project row (bottom of the form): label above the free-text Project field, used to group connections by project.

provisioned_save_read_only.value: この接続はファイルまたは環境変数からプロビジョニングされ、ここでは読み取り専用です。定義を編集して変更するか、複製して独自のコピーを作成します。
provisioned_save_read_only.location: Connection editor → Bottom of form: red error shown when Save is clicked on a connection that was preconfigured from a provisioning file or SQLLY_CONNECTION_ environment variable; explains it is read-only and how to change or copy it.

proxy_host_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Proxy first hop: label above the proxy server host name input, shown after “Use a proxy first hop” is checked.

proxy_host_required.value: プロキシホストは必須です
proxy_host_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Use a proxy first hop” is checked but the Proxy host field is empty.

proxy_kind_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Proxy first hop: label above the dropdown choosing the proxy protocol (SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT), shown after “Use a proxy first hop” is checked.

proxy_password_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Proxy first hop: label above the masked proxy password input, last field of the proxy settings.

proxy_password_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Proxy first hop → Proxy password field: masked placeholder in the empty input, lowercase noun.

proxy_port_invalid.value: プロキシ ポートは 1 ～ 65535 である必要があります
proxy_port_invalid.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the Proxy port field is not a number from 1 to 65535.

proxy_port_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Proxy first hop: label above the proxy port input (defaults to 1080), below Proxy host.

proxy_read_only.value: これらの接続は SQLLY が実行されるサーバー上でセットアップされ、ここでは読み取り専用になります。管理者に追加または変更を依頼してください。
proxy_read_only.location: Connection editor (View Connection) → Top of form: notice banner shown when SQLLY runs in a browser through a company server whose connections are managed there, explaining the form cannot be edited.

proxy_save_read_only.value: これらの接続は SQLLY が実行されるサーバー上でセットアップされ、ここでは読み取り専用になります。管理者に追加または変更を依頼してください。
proxy_save_read_only.location: Connection editor (View Connection) → Bottom of form: red error shown if saving is attempted while connections are managed by the server SQLLY runs through in the browser; explains the form is read-only.

proxy_user_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → Proxy first hop: label above the proxy user name input, below Proxy port; optional unless a proxy password is set.

proxy_username_required.value: パスワードを設定する場合はプロキシ ユーザー名が必要です
proxy_username_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when a proxy password was entered but the Proxy user field is empty.

redis_cluster_auto.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Cluster mode dropdown: default option that detects automatically whether the Redis server is a cluster.

redis_cluster_enabled.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Cluster mode dropdown: option that always connects in Redis Cluster mode (noun “cluster”).

redis_cluster_mode_label.value: クラスターモード (サーバーには複数のシードホストをカンマ区切りで指定できます)
redis_cluster_mode_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options (Redis-family engines only): label above the Cluster mode dropdown (Auto / Standalone / Cluster), noting that several seed hosts may be typed comma-separated in the Server field.

redis_cluster_relay_note.value: SSH ホップまたはプロキシを通じて、各クラスター ノードは独自の転送を通じてダイヤルされます。リレールート接続はシード ノードにのみ到達するため、そこではクラスター モードを使用できません。
redis_cluster_relay_note.location: Connection editor → Redis options: dimmed note under the Cluster node map field explaining that cluster mode works through SSH or a proxy, but not when the connection is routed through a relay device.

redis_cluster_standalone.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Cluster mode dropdown: option that treats the server as a single, non-clustered Redis instance.

redis_entra_host_hint.value: 有効期限が切れる前に更新されたアカウントのオブジェクト ID と Microsoft Entra トークンを使用して、Azure Cache for Redis または Azure Manageed Redis にサインインします。ホスト名は .redis.cache.windows.net または .redis.azure.net で終わります。 TLS が必要です (ポート 6380 または 10000)。以下のサインイン済みアカウントを選択してください。
redis_entra_host_hint.location: Connection editor → Authentication section: dimmed hint for Redis with Microsoft Entra sign-in, shown when the Server is empty or an Azure Redis host; explains how the Entra token sign-in works. Keep the host suffixes unchanged.

redis_entra_non_azure_host_hint.value: Microsoft Entra サインインは、ホスト名が .redis.cache.windows.net または .redis.azure.net で終わる Azure Cache for Redis および Azure Managed Redis でのみ機能します。このホストはそれらの 1 つではありません。以下のサインイン済みアカウントを選択してください。
redis_entra_non_azure_host_hint.location: Connection editor → Authentication section: dimmed warning for Redis with Microsoft Entra sign-in, shown instead of the usual hint when the Server is not an Azure Redis host name. Keep the host suffixes unchanged.

redis_key_delimiter_label.value: キーの区切り文字 (キーブラウザーで名前をグループ化します。:| など複数指定可、空白時は :)
redis_key_delimiter_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options (Redis-family engines only): label above the key delimiter input; the Redis key browser groups key names into folders on these characters (several may be typed, e.g. :| or space-separated tokens), colon when blank.

redis_node_map_invalid.value: クラスターノードマップ: {error}
redis_node_map_invalid.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when a line in the Redis Cluster node map cannot be parsed; {error} is the parser detail naming the bad line.

redis_node_map_label.value: クラスターノードマップ (アドバタイズされたアドレス => 実際に接続するアドレス。NAT、ポートマッピング、SSH 越しのノードに使用)
redis_node_map_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options: label above the multi-line Cluster node map box that rewrites each address a cluster node advertises to the address SQLLY should actually dial (NAT, port mapping, SSH).

redis_node_map_placeholder.value: 10.0.0.5:7001 => 127.0.0.1:17001 (1 行に 1 つ。空白時はノードがアドバタイズするアドレスに接続)
redis_node_map_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Cluster node map box: placeholder showing an example mapping line, one mapping per line, blank to dial the advertised addresses; keep the example addresses and “=>” as is.

redis_user_label.value: Redis ユーザー (オプション)
redis_user_label.location: Connection editor → Authentication section: label above the optional Redis user name input, shown for Redis when Microsoft Entra sign-in is selected (for an access policy naming the identity).

redis_user_placeholder.value: 空白: トークンのオブジェクト ID
redis_user_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Authentication section → Redis user field: placeholder saying that when left blank the Entra token's object id is used as the Redis user name.

relay_authorize_button.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device picker: button beside the “not authorized yet” hint, shown when the selected relay device is not yet paired; pairs this computer with that device.

relay_authorize_failed.value: 承認できませんでした: {error}
relay_authorize_failed.location: Connection editor → Routing section: relay error message shown when authorizing (pairing) the selected relay device fails; {error} is the server or network error detail.

relay_authorized.value: このアカウントに対して承認されています。
relay_authorized.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device picker: dimmed status text under the device dropdown, shown when the selected relay device is already paired with this account (next to the Revoke… button on desktop).

relay_device_not_registered.value: このデバイスはまだアカウントに登録されていません。
relay_device_not_registered.location: Connection editor → Routing section: relay error shown when Authorize is clicked but this computer has no device registration on the signed-in SQLLY account, so it cannot be paired.

relay_device_placeholder.value: リレーデバイスを選択
relay_device_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device dropdown: placeholder shown before any relay device is chosen, after “Route through a relay device” is checked.

relay_device_required.value: 経由するリレーデバイスを選択してください。
relay_device_required.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Route through a relay device” is checked but no relay device is selected in the dropdown.

relay_device_unauthorized.value: この中継デバイスはまだ認証されていません。ルーティングする前にペアリングしてください。
relay_device_unauthorized.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Route through a relay device” is checked and the selected relay device has not been paired (authorized) yet.

relay_devices_load_failed.value: リレーデバイスをロードできませんでした: {error}
relay_devices_load_failed.location: Connection editor → Routing section: dimmed status text shown in place of the relay controls when the list of relay devices could not be loaded or a relay action failed; {error} is the detail.

relay_devices_loading.value: リレーデバイスを確認しています…
relay_devices_loading.location: Connection editor → Routing section: dimmed progress text shown in place of the relay controls while SQLLY asks the account service which relay devices are registered.

relay_not_paired_hint.value: まだ承認されていません。経由するには、このデバイスをペアリングしてください。
relay_not_paired_hint.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device picker: dimmed hint under the device dropdown, left of the Authorize button, shown when the selected relay device is not paired with this computer yet.

relay_pairing_desktop_required.value: 認証されていません (ペアリングにはデスクトップ アプリが必要です)。
relay_pairing_desktop_required.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device picker (browser version only): dimmed hint under the dropdown shown when the selected relay device is not paired, since pairing can only be done in the desktop app.

relay_revoke_button.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device picker: button beside “Authorized for this account.”; opens an inline confirmation to remove the pairing with the selected relay device.

relay_revoke_cancel.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Revoke pairing confirmation: button that dismisses the inline confirmation and keeps the relay device paired.

relay_revoke_confirm.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Revoke pairing confirmation: red destructive button that removes the pairing between this computer and the selected relay device (verb).

relay_revoke_confirmation.value: 「{device_name}」とのペアリングを解除しますか？それを経由してルーティングされた接続は、再度許可されるまで機能を停止します。
relay_revoke_confirmation.location: Connection editor → Routing → Relay: message “Revoke the pairing with “{device_name}”? Connections routed through it will stop working until it is…”

relay_revoke_failed.value: 取り消しできませんでした: {error}
relay_revoke_failed.location: Connection editor → Routing section: relay error message shown when removing the pairing with a relay device fails; {error} is the server or network error detail.

relay_shared_device.location: Connection editor → Routing section → Relay device dropdown: entry for a relay device another account owner shared with you; {device_name} is that device's name, followed by a “shared” marker.

relay_signin_required_hint.value: 直接接続します。サインインしてリレー デバイスを登録し、この接続をリレー経由でルーティングします。
relay_signin_required_hint.location: Connection editor → Routing section: dimmed help text shown in place of the relay controls when you are not signed in to a SQLLY account; the connection goes straight to the server.

relay_signin_to_authorize.value: サインインして中継デバイスを認証します。
relay_signin_to_authorize.location: Connection editor → Routing section: relay error shown when Authorize is clicked but your SQLLY account session has expired or you are signed out.

relay_signin_to_revoke.value: サインインしてリレーのペアリングを取り消します。
relay_signin_to_revoke.location: Connection editor → Routing section: relay error shown when a pairing revocation is confirmed but your SQLLY account session has expired or you are signed out.

rollback_label.value: 実行をトランザクションで囲み、ロールバックする
rollback_label.location: Connection editor → Safety options: checkbox label; when on, every query on this connection runs inside a transaction that is rolled back afterwards, so no change is kept.

route_via_relay_label.value: リレーデバイス経由で接続する
route_via_relay_label.location: Connection editor → Routing section: checkbox label that sends this connection through one of your registered relay devices instead of connecting directly; reveals the relay device dropdown.

routing_section.location: Connection editor dialog → Routing section heading: heading shown below Environment for choosing whether the connection goes directly to the server or through a relay device.

save_button.location: Connection editor → Dialog footer: primary button at the far right that validates the form and saves the connection (disabled while the server name is invalid).

select_ca_certificate_title.value: CA 証明書ファイルを選択します
select_ca_certificate_title.location: Connection editor → TLS options → CA file Browse button: title of the system open-file dialog for choosing the certificate authority (CA) file used to verify the server.

select_client_certificate_title.value: クライアント証明書ファイルを選択します
select_client_certificate_title.location: Connection editor → TLS options → Client certificate Browse button: title of the system open-file dialog for choosing the client certificate presented to the server.

select_client_key_title.value: クライアントキーファイルを選択してください
select_client_key_title.location: Connection editor → TLS options → Client key Browse button: title of the system open-file dialog for choosing the private key that goes with the client certificate.

select_private_key_title.value: 秘密鍵ファイルを選択します
select_private_key_title.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel → Private key file Browse button: title of the system open-file dialog for choosing the SSH private key.

sentinel_behavior_note.value: 上記のホストとポートはダイヤルされません。すべての接続でセンチネルにマスターを要求し、以下のユーザーとパスワードを使用してそこにサインインし、フェイルオーバー後に読み取り専用スクリプトのみを再実行します。 SSH トンネル、プロキシ、リレー ルートは Sentinel では使用できません。
sentinel_behavior_note.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Sentinel: dimmed explanation at the end of the Sentinel fields, shown when “Connect through Sentinel” is checked, describing how the master is found and failover handled.

sentinel_enable_label.value: Sentinel 経由で接続します (Sentinel に現在のマスターを尋ねます)
sentinel_enable_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options: checkbox label that makes SQLLY ask Redis Sentinel servers for the current master instead of dialing Server/Port directly; reveals the Sentinel fields.

sentinel_host_required.value: Sentinel 接続には少なくとも 1 つの Sentinel ホストが必要です
sentinel_host_required.location: Connection editor → Redis → Sentinel: validation message shown when no Sentinel host is configured.

sentinel_hosts_label.value: Sentinel (host:port をカンマ区切りで指定。ポート省略時は 26379)
sentinel_hosts_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Sentinel: label above the input listing the sentinel servers as host:port, comma-separated (port 26379 if omitted); keep “host:port” and 26379.

sentinel_master_name_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Sentinel: label above the input for the name of the monitored master group the sentinels know (e.g. “mymaster”).

sentinel_master_required.value: Sentinel マスター名は必須です
sentinel_master_required.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Connect through Sentinel” is checked but the Sentinel Master name field is empty.

sentinel_password_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Sentinel: label above the masked input for the password used to sign in to the sentinel servers themselves (not the Redis data password).

sentinel_password_placeholder.value: (Sentinel がパスワードを要求する場合のみ)
sentinel_password_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Sentinel → Sentinel password field: placeholder saying this password is only needed if the sentinels require authentication.

sentinel_prefer_replica_label.value: 読み取りにはレプリカを優先します (読み取り専用スクリプトは正常なレプリカで実行されます)
sentinel_prefer_replica_label.location: Connection editor → Redis options → Sentinel: checkbox label; when on, read-only scripts run on a healthy replica instead of the master.

server_info_case_insensitive.value: 大文字と小文字を区別しない
server_info_case_insensitive.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: value of the Identifiers row after a successful Test Connection, meaning the server treats table and column names as case-insensitive; short lowercase adjective.

server_info_case_sensitive.value: 大文字と小文字を区別する
server_info_case_sensitive.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: value of the Identifiers row after a successful Test Connection, meaning the server treats table and column names as case-sensitive; short lowercase adjective.

server_info_charset.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and the server default character set (e.g. utf8mb4), listed left of the buttons after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_collation.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and the server default collation name, listed after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_database.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and the name of the database the test session landed in, listed after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_encrypted.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: value of the TLS row after a successful Test Connection, meaning the test session used an encrypted (TLS) link; short lowercase adjective.

server_info_identifiers.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and “case-sensitive” or “case-insensitive”, describing how the server compares object names; shown after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_latency.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and the measured round-trip time to the server in milliseconds, listed after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_latency_value.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: value of the Latency row after a successful Test Connection; {milliseconds} is the measured round-trip time as a whole number, “ms” is the milliseconds unit abbreviation.

server_info_not_encrypted.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: value of the TLS row after a successful Test Connection, meaning the test session used an unencrypted link; short lowercase adjective.

server_info_product.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: first row label, followed by a colon and the database product name the server reported (e.g. PostgreSQL), listed after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_tls.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and “encrypted” or “not encrypted”, telling whether the test session used TLS; keep the acronym TLS.

server_info_user.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and the user name the server says the test session is signed in as, listed after a successful Test Connection.

server_info_version.location: Connection editor → Footer → Server info: row label, followed by a colon and the server version string, listed after a successful Test Connection.

server_label.location: Connection editor → Connection details: label above the server host name, named instance or IP address input, left of Port; replaced by “Database file” for file-based engines.

server_required.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the Server field is empty for an engine that connects to a server.

signed_in_entra_users.value: サインインした Entra ユーザー ({count})
signed_in_entra_users.location: Connection editor → Authentication section → Microsoft Entra: heading above the list of signed-in Entra accounts to pick from; {count} is the number of accounts listed.

sql_account_password_missing.value: 保存された SQL アカウント「{account_name}」には、システム キーリングにパスワードがありません。
sql_account_password_missing.location: Connection editor → Authentication: error message “The saved SQL account “{account_name}” has no password in the system keyring.”

sql_account_password_read_failed.value: SQL アカウントのパスワードを読み取れませんでした: {error}
sql_account_password_read_failed.location: Connection editor → Authentication section: red error at the bottom of the form shown when a saved SQL account is picked but its password cannot be read from the system keychain; {error} is the keychain error.

sql_accounts_empty.value: 保存された SQL アカウントはありません。以下に資格情報を入力するか、[接続管理] > [アカウント] で資格情報を追加します。
sql_accounts_empty.location: Connection editor → Authentication section: dimmed empty-state text shown in place of the saved SQL account chips (SQL Login) when no accounts are saved; keep the menu path wording consistent with Connection Management.

sql_username_required.value: SQL ログインにはユーザー名が必要です
sql_username_required.location: Connection editor → Validation errors: red error line at the bottom of the form shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the authentication method is SQL Login and the Username field is empty.

ssh_agent_option.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel → Authentication dropdown: default option that signs in to the SSH server with keys held by the running SSH agent.

ssh_authentication_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: label above the dropdown choosing how to sign in to the SSH server (SSH agent / Private key file / Password), below SSH Username.

ssh_host_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: label above the SSH server (bastion) host name input, shown after “Connect through an SSH tunnel” is checked; short space.

ssh_host_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the SSH tunnel is enabled but its Host field is empty.

ssh_jump_host_required.value: SSHジャンプホストが必要です
ssh_jump_host_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Use a jump host” is checked but the Jump host field is empty.

ssh_jump_port_invalid.value: SSH ジャンプ ポートは 1 ～ 65535 である必要があります
ssh_jump_port_invalid.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Use a jump host” is checked and the jump host Port is not a number from 1 to 65535.

ssh_jump_username_required.value: SSHジャンプユーザー名が必要です
ssh_jump_username_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when “Use a jump host” is checked but the Jump username field is empty.

ssh_keepalive_invalid.value: SSH キープアライブには秒数を指定してください (0 で無効化)
ssh_keepalive_invalid.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when Keepalive (seconds) is not a whole number of seconds up to 86400; 0 disables keepalive messages.

ssh_passphrase_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: label above the masked input for the passphrase that unlocks the private key file, shown when Authentication is “Private key file”.

ssh_password_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: label above the masked SSH password input, shown when Authentication is “Password”.

ssh_password_required.value: SSHパスワードが必要です
ssh_password_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when SSH Authentication is “Password” and no password is entered or saved.

ssh_port_invalid.value: SSH ポートは 1 ～ 65535 である必要があります
ssh_port_invalid.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the SSH tunnel Port (next to SSH Host) is not a number from 1 to 65535.

ssh_port_label.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: label above the narrow SSH server port input (default 22) to the right of the SSH Host field; short space.

ssh_private_key_required.value: 秘密キーファイルが必要です
ssh_private_key_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when SSH Authentication is “Private key file” and the Private key file path is empty.

ssh_secret_placeholder.value: パスワードまたはパスフレーズ
ssh_secret_placeholder.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel: masked placeholder in the secret input, which is labeled Password or Passphrase depending on the chosen SSH authentication.

ssh_secret_required.value: SSHシークレットが必要です
ssh_secret_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section (also Tunnel Profiles dialog) → Validation errors: red error line shown when Save or Test Connection is clicked, when the SSH tunnel needs a secret (password or passphrase) and none is entered or saved.

ssh_tunnel_browser_unavailable.value: SQLLY がブラウザで実行されている場合、SSH トンネルは使用できません
ssh_tunnel_browser_unavailable.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section: dimmed text shown instead of the tunnel fields when SQLLY runs in a browser served by your organization’s server, where SSH tunnels cannot be opened.

ssh_tunnel_desktop_required.value: SSH トンネルにはデスクトップ アプリが必要です
ssh_tunnel_desktop_required.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section: dimmed text shown instead of the tunnel fields in the browser preview (demo) of SQLLY, pointing out that SSH tunnels need the desktop app.

ssh_tunnel_duckdb_unavailable.value: DuckDB はローカル ファイルを開きます。トンネリングするサーバーがありません
ssh_tunnel_duckdb_unavailable.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section: dimmed text shown instead of the tunnel fields when the engine is DuckDB, which opens a local file, so there is nothing to tunnel to.

ssh_tunnel_engine_unavailable.value: SSH トンネルはこのエンジンではまだ使用できません
ssh_tunnel_engine_unavailable.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section: dimmed text shown instead of the tunnel fields when the selected database engine does not support SSH tunnels yet.

ssh_tunnel_sqlite_unavailable.value: SQLite はローカル ファイルを開きます。トンネリングするサーバーがありません
ssh_tunnel_sqlite_unavailable.location: Connection editor → Tunnel / Proxy section: dimmed text shown instead of the tunnel fields when the engine is SQLite, which opens a local file, so there is nothing to tunnel to.

ssh_username_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel fields: label above the input for the user name to log in to the SSH server with; shown after “Connect through an SSH tunnel” is checked, below the SSH host and port.

ssh_username_required.value: SSH ユーザー名は必須です
ssh_username_required.location: Connection editor dialog → Form error line: inline validation error shown below the form on Save or Test when the SSH tunnel is enabled but its username field is empty.

startup_sql_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options: label above the multi-line box for SQL statements that run automatically each time this connection opens; sits right below the Timeout field.

startup_sql_placeholder.value: 接続を開いたときに実行する SQL (オプション)
startup_sql_placeholder.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options: grey placeholder inside the empty Startup SQL box, explaining that the field is optional SQL executed whenever the connection is opened.

notes_placeholder.value: オプションのメモ: このサーバーの所有者、目的、注意すべき点
notes_placeholder.location: Connection editor dialog → Notes box: grey placeholder inside the empty Notes box suggesting what to write there (owner, purpose, cautions).

notes_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Notes: label above the multi-line Notes box at the bottom of the form, below Client and Project, where the user keeps free-form notes about this connection.

test_button.location: Connection editor dialog → Footer: button at the bottom left that tries to connect with the current form values without saving; a verb meaning “test the connection”, keep it very short.

test_connected.location: Connection editor dialog → Footer status: green success message beside the Test button after a connection test succeeds; {latency_ms} is how many milliseconds the connection took.

test_connected_with_report.location: Connection editor dialog → Footer status: green success message after a Redis Sentinel connection test succeeds; {latency_ms} is the connect time in milliseconds and {report} names which master answered and which sentinel reported it.

test_failed.value: 接続テストに失敗しました。
test_failed.location: Connection editor dialog → Footer status: red summary beside the Test button when a connection test fails; the detailed reason is shown separately in the form’s error line.

test_running_button.location: Connection editor dialog → Footer: label that temporarily replaces the Test button while a connection test is in progress; short progressive verb form.

timeout_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options: label above the numeric input for how many seconds to wait for the server before a connection attempt gives up.

title_duplicate.location: Connection editor dialog → Title bar (duplicate mode): text shown when the editor is opened by duplicating an existing connection, so the user is creating a new copy of it.

title_edit.location: Connection editor dialog → Title bar (edit mode): text shown when the editor is opened to change an existing saved connection.

title_new.location: Connection editor dialog → Title bar (new mode): text shown when the editor is opened to create a brand-new connection from scratch.

title_view.location: Connection editor dialog → Title bar (view-only mode): text shown for a read-only connection provided by a relay proxy, which can be inspected and tested but not saved.

tls_browse_button.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section: button to the right of the CA file, client certificate and client key path inputs that opens a file picker to choose that file (desktop app only).

tls_client_pair_required.value: クライアント証明書とクライアントキーの両方を設定する必要があります
tls_client_pair_required.location: Connection editor dialog → Form error line: inline validation error on Save or Test when only one of the TLS client certificate and client key paths is filled in; both are needed together.

tls_disable.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section → TLS dropdown: option that turns off encryption so the connection is made without TLS.

tls_label.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section: label above the dropdown choosing the TLS mode (disable, require without verification, verify CA, verify full) for PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, libSQL and Redis connections.

tls_require_unverified.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section → TLS dropdown: option that encrypts the connection but does not verify the server certificate; the wording must make clear it is not a verified mode.

tls_verify_ca.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section → TLS dropdown: option that encrypts and checks that the server certificate is signed by a trusted certificate authority, without checking the host name.

tls_verify_full.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section → TLS dropdown: strictest option, which encrypts and verifies both the certificate authority and that the certificate matches the server host name.

transport_kube_combination_invalid.value: Kubernetes のポート転送を SSH またはプロキシ ホップと組み合わせることはできません
transport_kube_combination_invalid.location: Connection editor dialog → Form error line: inline validation error on Save or Test when kubectl port-forward is enabled together with an SSH tunnel or proxy hop, which is not allowed.

transport_too_many_hops.value: トランスポート チェーンは 2 ホップを超えることはできません
transport_too_many_hops.location: Connection editor dialog → Form error line: inline validation error on Save or Test when the proxy, SSH tunnel and jump host settings add up to more than two network hops before the database.

trust_certificate_label.value: サーバー証明書を信頼する
trust_certificate_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Connection options: checkbox under “Encrypt connection” for engines without a TLS dropdown (such as SQL Server) that accepts the server’s certificate without validating it.

trust_os_roots_label.value: OS キーチェーンのルートも信頼します
trust_os_roots_label.location: Connection editor dialog → TLS section: checkbox shown for Redis when the TLS mode is Verify CA or Verify full; also accepts certificates signed by authorities installed in the operating system’s trust store.

tunnel_profile_label.value: トンネルプロファイル
tunnel_profile_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section: label above the dropdown choosing a saved, reusable tunnel profile, or “None (inline)” to enter proxy and SSH settings directly in this form.

tunnel_profile_missing.value: トンネル プロファイルはもう存在しません
tunnel_profile_missing.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section: grey summary line under the Tunnel profile dropdown shown when the connection points to a tunnel profile that has since been deleted.

tunnel_proxy_section.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section heading: heading over the tunnel profile picker, proxy first hop and SSH tunnel settings used to reach the database through intermediate hosts.

unsupported_engine.value: {engine_name} はこのビルドではサポートされていません
unsupported_engine.location: Connection editor dialog → Form error line: error shown after pasting a connection URL or opening a connection link whose database engine cannot be used in this edition; {engine_name} is the engine’s display name.

use_jump_host_label.value: ジャンプホストを使用する
use_jump_host_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section → SSH tunnel fields: checkbox below the keep-alive field that reveals extra fields for an intermediate SSH jump (bastion) host the tunnel passes through first.

use_kube_port_forward_label.value: kubectl ポートフォワード経由で接続する
use_kube_port_forward_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Kubernetes port-forward section: checkbox that enables reaching the database through a kubectl port-forward to a pod or service, revealing the context, namespace and target fields.

use_no_account.value: アカウントを使用しない
use_no_account.location: Connection editor dialog → Authentication section → Microsoft Entra account list: clickable row at the end of the signed-in accounts list that clears the account choice so no Entra account is attached to this connection.

use_proxy_label.value: 最初のホップにプロキシを使用する
use_proxy_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section: checkbox that routes the connection through a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy as the first hop, revealing the proxy kind, host, port, username and password fields.

use_ssh_tunnel_label.value: SSHトンネル経由で接続する
use_ssh_tunnel_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Tunnel / Proxy section: checkbox that routes the connection through an SSH server, revealing the SSH host, port, username, authentication and jump host fields.

username_label.location: Connection editor dialog → Authentication section: label above the database login name input, shown when the SQL login (username and password) authentication mode is selected.

add_button.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Left list: button under the list of clients, projects or environments that creates a new entry of the active tab’s kind and selects it for renaming.

added_client.value: クライアントを追加しました。
added_client.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Status line: confirmation at the bottom left after “+ Add” creates a new client on the Clients tab.

added_environment.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Status line: confirmation at the bottom left after “+ Add” creates a new environment on the Environments tab.

added_project.value: プロジェクトを追加しました。
added_project.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Status line: confirmation at the bottom left after “+ Add” creates a new project on the Projects tab.

browse_icon_button.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Detail form → Icon: button to the right of the icon path input that opens a file picker for choosing an image to use as the entry’s icon.

browser_icon_picker_unavailable.value: アイコンファイルは選択できません
browser_icon_picker_unavailable.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Status line: message in the browser version when Browse… is clicked next to the icon path, because picking a local image file is not possible there.

client_singular.location: Connection Management → Clients pane → Editor: heading of the first group, holding the Name field, when a client is selected; singular noun.

clients_tab.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Tabs: first tab along the top, listing the clients that connections can be assigned to.

close_picker_button.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Detail form → Color: label of the toggle button beside the color input while the inline color picker is open; clicking it hides the picker.

color_invalid.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Detail form → Color: red hint under the color input when the typed text is not a valid hex color such as #1A2B3C.

color_label.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Detail form: label above the hex color input, swatch and picker button that set the color used to tag this client, project or environment.

color_optional.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Detail form → Color: grey hint under the color input when it is empty, saying a color does not have to be set.

color_valid.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Detail form → Color: grey hint under the color input confirming the typed text is a valid hex color.

dialog_title.value: クライアント、プロジェクト、環境の管理
dialog_title.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Title bar: title bar of the dialog opened from Tools → Manage entities for editing clients, projects and environments and their query protections.

empty_clients.value: まだクライアントがいません。
empty_clients.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Left list: placeholder text in the empty list on the Clients tab before any client exists.

empty_environments.value: まだ環境がありません。
empty_environments.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Left list: placeholder text in the empty list on the Environments tab before any environment exists.

empty_projects.value: まだプロジェクトはありません。
empty_projects.location: Manage Clients, Projects & Environments dialog → Left list: placeholder text in the empty list on the Projects tab before any project exists.
