sql_account_initial_status.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: initial text when the pane opens with no account selected, explaining reusable SQL logins and keychain password storage.

sql_account_keep_password_help.value: 既存のキーチェーンのパスワードを保持するには、パスワードを空白のままにします。
sql_account_keep_password_help.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: hint shown after selecting an existing SQL login, explaining that an empty Password field keeps the stored password.

sql_account_name_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor: field label for the reusable SQL login’s friendly name, shown in lists and on the account choices in the connection form.

sql_account_name_user_required.value: 名前とユーザー名は必須です。
sql_account_name_user_required.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: validation message after clicking Save Account with the Name or Username field empty.

sql_account_password_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor: field label for the reusable SQL login’s password, which is saved to the system keychain.

sql_account_password_missing.value: 保存された SQL アカウント「{account_name}」には、システム キーリングにパスワードがありません。
sql_account_password_missing.location: Connection Management → Connections → Authentication: error message “The saved SQL account “{account_name}” has no password in the system keyring.”

sql_account_password_read_failed.value: SQL アカウントのパスワードを読み取れませんでした: {error}
sql_account_password_read_failed.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Authentication group → Footer status line: error after clicking a saved SQL account choice whose keychain password cannot be read; {error} is the system’s reason.

sql_account_password_required.value: 新しい SQL アカウントにはパスワードが必要です。
sql_account_password_required.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: validation message after clicking Save Account for a new SQL login with the Password field empty.

sql_account_remove_password_failed.value: システム キーチェーンからパスワードを削除できませんでした: {error}
sql_account_remove_password_failed.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: error after clicking Remove Account when the stored password cannot be deleted from the keychain; {error} is the system’s reason.

sql_account_removed.value: SQL アカウントが削除されました。
sql_account_removed.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: confirmation after Remove Account deletes the selected SQL login and its keychain password.

sql_account_save_password_failed.value: パスワードをシステム キーチェーンに保存できませんでした: {error}
sql_account_save_password_failed.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: error after clicking Save Account when the password cannot be written to the keychain; {error} is the system’s reason.

sql_account_saved.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Status line: confirmation after Save Account stores a SQL login; {account_name} is the account’s friendly name.

sql_account_username_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor: field label for the database login user name stored with the reusable SQL account.

sql_account_username_placeholder.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account editor → Username field: placeholder asking for the database login user name.

sql_list_header.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Accounts pane → Account list: small section header above the reusable SQL logins, below the Microsoft Entra accounts.

sql_servers_root.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: top-level root node of the saved-connection tree, under which connections are grouped by client, project, environment and server.

staging_environment.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: group node for the staging environment level (below client and project) grouping connections marked as staging; all-caps tag.

startup_sql_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Advanced group: label of the multi-line field holding SQL that runs automatically each time this connection opens.

startup_sql_placeholder.value: 接続を開いたときに実行する SQL (オプション)
startup_sql_placeholder.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Advanced group → Startup SQL field: placeholder explaining that SQL entered here is optional and runs whenever the connection opens.

notes_placeholder.value: オプションのメモ: このサーバーの所有者、目的、注意すべき点
notes_placeholder.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Advanced group → Notes field: placeholder suggesting what to write there (owner, purpose, cautions).

notes_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Advanced group: label of the multi-line field holding the user's free-form notes about this connection, below Startup SQL.

supported_icon_formats.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Clients, Projects or Environments pane → Appearance group → Icon drop zone: secondary line listing accepted image formats while no icon is chosen.

test_all_button.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer: button beside Test that tests every saved connection in turn and updates their health badges; disabled while a run is in progress.

test_all_summary.value: すべてテスト: 成功 {passed}、失敗 {failed}。
test_all_summary.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: result after Test All finishes; {passed} and {failed} are the numbers of saved connections that succeeded and failed.

test_all_summary_skipped.value: すべてテスト: 成功 {passed}、失敗 {failed}、サインイン/クラウド IAM 接続は {skipped} 件スキップ。
test_all_summary_skipped.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: result after Test All when some connections were skipped; {passed}/{failed} are counts tested, {skipped} the Entra sign-in or cloud IAM connections not tested.

test_button.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer: first button on the left; tests a connection using the current form values without saving; disabled while the form has validation errors.

test_environment.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: group node for the test environment level (below client and project) grouping connections marked as test; all-caps tag.

test_failed.value: 接続テストに失敗しました。
test_failed.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: short status after clicking Test when the connection attempt fails; the detailed error appears in red at the bottom of the form.

test_password_load_failed.value: SQL アカウントのパスワードを読み込めませんでした: {error}
test_password_load_failed.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: error after clicking Test when the saved SQL account’s password cannot be loaded from the keychain; also shown as the test result. {error} is the reason.

test_succeeded.value: 接続テストに成功しました。
test_succeeded.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: short status after clicking Test when the connection attempt succeeds; a success line also appears at the bottom of the form.

testing_all_progress.value: {count} 件の接続をテストしています…
testing_all_progress.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: progress status while Test All runs; {count} is the number of saved connections being tested.

testing_connection.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: progress status while a single Test connection attempt is running.

timeout_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Advanced group: field label for the connection (login) timeout in seconds, default 30; distinct from the Query timeout field below.

tls_browse_button.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Safety group → CA file, Client certificate and Client key rows: button beside each path field that opens a file picker for the certificate or key (desktop only).

tls_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Safety group: label of the dropdown choosing the TLS mode (for example verify-full) for PostgreSQL and MySQL connections.

trust_certificate_label.value: サーバー証明書を信頼する
trust_certificate_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Safety group: checkbox label for engines without TLS modes (such as SQL Server); when on, the server’s certificate is accepted without validation.

unassigned_client.value: 未割り当てのクライアント
unassigned_client.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: group node collecting connections that have no client assigned; appears directly under the SQL Servers root.

unassigned_project.value: 未割り当てのプロジェクト
unassigned_project.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: group node collecting connections that have no project assigned; appears under a client node.

unfavorite_button.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer: button replacing “☆ Favorite” when the edited connection is already a favorite; removes its star. Keep the leading star symbol.

unsaved_changes_prompt.value: この接続には保存されていない変更があります。
unsaved_changes_prompt.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Unsaved changes prompt: text at the left of the footer prompt (Discard, Save, Keep editing) raised when closing the dialog with unsaved connection edits.

unsaved_changes_status.value: 未保存の変更 — 保存するか、破棄するか、編集を続行します。
unsaved_changes_status.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: status set when Close or ✕ is clicked with unsaved edits, while the Save / Discard / Keep editing prompt is shown instead of closing.

unset_environment.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: group node for connections with no environment set (below client and project); all-caps tag.

unsupported_engine.value: {engine_name} はこのビルドではサポートされていません
unsupported_engine.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Server group → Paste URL: footer status line when a pasted connection string is for an engine not included in this build; {engine_name} is the engine.

unsupported_icon.value: PNG、JPEG、GIF、BMP、WebP、ICO、または SVG 画像を選択します。
unsupported_icon.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Clients, Projects or Environments pane → Footer status line: error after dropping or choosing an icon file that is not a supported image type.

untested_badge.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection list: badge on a saved connection row never tested; also the {status} word in the Health group’s Last observed status line.

username_label.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Authentication group (SQL login mode): field label for the database login user name; locked when a saved SQL account supplies the credentials.

using_sql_account.value: 保存された SQL アカウント {account_name} を使用する
using_sql_account.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Footer status line: status after clicking a saved SQL account choice in the Authentication group, which fills Username and the masked Password; {account_name} is the account.

validation_name_required.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Validation errors: red inline error below the form when the Name field is empty; disables Test, Connect and Save until fixed.

validation_port_required.value: ポートはゼロより大きくなければなりません
validation_port_required.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Validation errors: red inline error below the form when the Port field is zero or empty; disables Test, Connect and Save until fixed.

validation_server_required.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Validation errors: red inline error below the form when the Host (server) field is empty; disables Test, Connect and Save until fixed.

validation_timeout_required.value: タイムアウトはゼロより大きくなければなりません
validation_timeout_required.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Validation errors: red inline error below the form when the connection Timeout (seconds) field is zero or empty; disables Test, Connect and Save.

windows_credentials_hint.value: 資格情報は、システムの Windows トークン キャッシュから解決されます。
windows_credentials_hint.location: Connections & Settings dialog → Connections pane → Connection form → Authentication group (Windows authentication mode, SQL Server): note explaining that no username or password is entered; credentials come from the Windows token cache.

access_revoked.value: この中継デバイスへのアクセスが取り消されました。アカウントでペアリングを再認証します。
access_revoked.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when connecting a Via Relay connection fails because the account's pairing with that relay device was revoked; tells the user to re-authorize the pairing in their SQLLY account.

account_not_authorized.value: あなたのアカウントには、このリレー セッションを開く権限がありません。再度サインインするか、デバイスの所有者に認証を依頼してください。
account_not_authorized.location: Workbench → Status bar and Connection editor → Routing → Via Relay: error shown when the SQLLY account service rejects the signed-in user (not authorized) while opening a relay session or loading relay devices; suggests signing in again or asking the device owner.

account_unreachable.value: SQLLY アカウント サービスにアクセスできません。ネットワーク接続を確認して、もう一度試してください。
account_unreachable.location: Workbench → Status bar and Connection editor → Routing → Via Relay: error shown when the SQLLY account service cannot be reached over the network while opening a relay session or loading, authorizing, or revoking relay devices.

authentication_failed.value: 中継認証に失敗しました。再度サインインしてリレー アクセスを更新します。
authentication_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when the app's own login to the relay server fails during the secure handshake for a Via Relay connection; asks the user to sign in again to refresh relay access.

browser_connections_unavailable.value: リレー接続は利用できません
browser_connections_unavailable.location: Connection editor → Routing → Via Relay: error explaining that relay connections cannot be used in this build (the account service reports relay support as unavailable, as in the browser preview); short standalone sentence.

code_authentication_failed.value: 中継認証に失敗しました。再度サインインしてリレー アクセスを更新します。
code_authentication_failed.location: Connection status → Relay → Authentication: guidance after relay authentication fails.

device_not_authorized.value: この中継デバイスはあなたのアカウントに対して承認されていません。接続をルーティングする前に、ペアリングしてください。
device_not_authorized.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when connecting a Via Relay connection whose selected relay device has no active pairing with this computer; tells the user to pair the device first.

device_offline.value: この接続の中継デバイスはオフラインです。そのマシン上で SQLLY ブリッジを開始し、再試行してください。
device_offline.location: Connection status → Relay → Device availability: guidance when the selected relay device is offline.

handshake_closed.value: 安全なセッションが確立される前にリレー接続が閉じられました。もう一度試してください。
handshake_closed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when the relay connection drops before the encrypted session with the relay device finishes setting up while connecting a Via Relay connection; invites a retry.

no_server_available.value: 現在利用可能な中継サーバーはありません。しばらくしてからもう一度お試しください。
no_server_available.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when connecting a Via Relay connection and the relay directory lists no usable relay server at the moment; invites retrying shortly.

noise_identity_mismatch.value: 中継デバイスの ID を検証できませんでした (ノイズ キーの不一致または改ざんが検出されました)。
noise_identity_mismatch.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: security error shown when the encrypted handshake with the relay device fails its key check (Noise is the encryption protocol name; keep it untranslated), suggesting tampering or a changed device key.

not_routed.value: この接続はリレーを介してルーティングされません。
not_routed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: internal-guard error shown if a relay session is requested for a connection whose routing is Direct rather than Via Relay.

open_session_failed.value: アカウントからリレー セッションを開けませんでした。もう一度試してください。
open_session_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar and Connection editor → Routing → Via Relay: generic fallback error shown when the SQLLY account service returns an unexpected error while preparing a relay session or loading relay devices; invites a retry.

peer_identity_mismatch.value: 中継デバイスの ID を検証できませんでした (フレームがペアリングされたデバイスと一致しませんでした)。
peer_identity_mismatch.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: security error shown when data received through the relay did not come from the paired device the connection expects (the “frame” is a protocol message), so SQLLY stops connecting.

protocol_error.value: リレーがセッションを拒否しました (プロトコル エラー)。もう一度試してください。
protocol_error.location: Connection status → Relay → Session: guidance after a relay protocol error.

proxy_session_not_open.value: リレー プロキシ セッションが接続されていません。 SQLly は再接続中です。しばらくしてから再試行するか、ページをリロードしてください。
proxy_session_not_open.location: Browser preview → Relay proxy connections: error returned by every query or metadata request on a connection supplied by the relay proxy while the proxy session is down; says SQLly is reconnecting and suggests waiting or reloading the page.

rate_limited.value: 中継リクエストが多すぎます。しばらく待ってから、もう一度試してください。
rate_limited.location: Connection status → Relay → Rate limiting: guidance when relay requests are rate-limited.

routing_denied.value: この接続には、その中継デバイスを使用する権限がありません。アカウントでペアリングを再認証します。
routing_denied.location: Connection status → Relay → Routing: guidance when the connection is not authorized for the relay device.

security_key_missing.value: 中継装置にセキュリティキーが登録されていません。接続する前に再度ペアリングしてください。
security_key_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when connecting a Via Relay connection whose paired relay device has no registered encryption key on the account; tells the user to pair the device again.

server_at_capacity.value: 中継サーバーが限界に達しています。しばらくしてからもう一度お試しください。
server_at_capacity.location: Connection status → Relay → Capacity: guidance when the relay server is full.

server_unreachable.value: 中継サーバーに到達できませんでした。ネットワーク接続を確認して、もう一度試してください。
server_unreachable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: error shown when a network failure prevents reaching the relay server while connecting a Via Relay connection; asks the user to check the network and retry.

session_failed.value: リレーセッションが失敗しました。もう一度試してください。
session_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Relay connect errors: generic fallback error shown when opening the relay session for a Via Relay connection fails for a reason not covered by a more specific message.

session_limit.value: このブリッジの同時接続制限に達しました。リレー ページからスロットを解放して (またはブリッジの所有者に依頼して)、再試行してください。
session_limit.location: Connection status → Relay → Session limits: guidance when the bridge has no free connection slots.

session_not_open.value: リレーセッションが開いていません。この操作を実行する前に、リレーを介して接続してください。
session_not_open.location: Via Relay connection → Query and object operation error: error (prefixed “Connection error:”) shown when a query or metadata request runs before the relay session is connected or after it dropped; tells the user to connect through the relay first.

browser_chinook_sample_name.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer and connection lists: name of the built-in sample connection to the Chinook music database running in PGlite (Postgres compiled to run inside the browser tab); Chinook and PGlite are proper names.

browser_chinook_sample_server.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer and connection lists: server text of the Chinook sample connection, explaining it is PGlite, a Postgres database running inside the browser tab; short subtitle, the “·” is a separator.

browser_northwind_sample_name.value: ノースウィンド（サンプル）
browser_northwind_sample_name.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer and connection lists: name of the built-in sample connection to the Northwind demo database (SQLite) that ships with the browser preview; Northwind is a proper name.

browser_northwind_sample_server.value: SQLite・ブラウザプレビュー
browser_northwind_sample_server.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer and connection lists: server text of the Northwind sample connection, saying it is a SQLite database inside the browser preview; short subtitle, the “·” is a separator.

import_blocked_by_unreadable_store.value: 保存された接続ファイルを読み取れなかったため、インポートされた接続を保存できませんでした
import_blocked_by_unreadable_store.location: Workbench → Status bar → Import Connections: error shown after importing a connections file (or a Redis Insight export) when the existing saved-connections file was unreadable at startup, so the import is refused rather than overwriting it.

invalid_json.value: 接続ストアの JSON が無効です: {error}
invalid_json.location: Saved connections file → Load errors: error produced at startup when the saved connections file exists but is not valid JSON; {error} is the parser's technical detail (line, column, reason). Saving is then blocked to protect the file.

read_failed.value: 接続ストアを読み取れませんでした: {error}
read_failed.location: Saved connections file → Load errors: error produced at startup when the saved connections file exists but the operating system refuses to read it; {error} is the system's error text, such as permission denied.

tunnel_profile_missing.value: トンネル プロファイルはもう存在しません
tunnel_profile_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar and Connection editor → Test result: error shown when connecting or testing a connection whose selected named tunnel profile has since been deleted.

delete_button.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Footer: left-side button that starts deleting the profile selected in the list; disabled until a profile is selected and opens a confirmation (the ellipsis signals a follow-up step).

delete_cancel_button.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Delete Tunnel Profile confirmation: secondary button that backs out of deleting and returns to the dialog with the profile untouched.

delete_confirm_button.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Delete Tunnel Profile confirmation: red primary button that permanently deletes the tunnel profile and its saved passwords.

delete_confirmation_question.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Delete Tunnel Profile confirmation: question at the top of the confirmation body; {profile_name} is the name of the tunnel profile about to be deleted.

delete_confirmation_title.value: トンネルプロファイルの削除
delete_confirmation_title.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Delete Tunnel Profile confirmation: title of the small confirmation dialog stacked over the Tunnel profiles dialog after clicking Delete….

delete_impact_many.value: {count} 接続では、このトンネル プロファイル: {connection_names} が使用されます。削除後は、別のサーバーを選択するまで、トンネルを使用せずにサーバーに直接接続します。元に戻すことはできません。
delete_impact_many.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Delete Tunnel Profile confirmation: impact note shown when two or more saved connections use the profile; {count} is how many, {connection_names} their quoted, comma-separated names.

delete_impact_none.value: このトンネル プロファイルを使用する保存された接続はありません。これを削除すると、保存されているプロキシ パスワードと SSH パスワードも削除されます。元に戻すことはできません。
delete_impact_none.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Delete Tunnel Profile confirmation: impact note shown when no saved connection uses the profile, warning that its saved proxy and SSH passwords are removed too and that it cannot be undone.

delete_impact_one.value: 接続「{connection_name}」はこのトンネル プロファイルを使用します。削除後は、別の接続を選択するまで、その接続はトンネルなしでサーバーに直接接続されます。元に戻すことはできません。
delete_impact_one.location: Tunnel Profiles → Delete confirmation: impact shown when one connection uses the profile.

deleted_many_connections.value: 「{profile_name}」を削除。 {count} 接続はトンネルなしで接続できるようになりました
deleted_many_connections.location: Tunnel Profiles → Delete confirmation: status message “Deleted “{profile_name}”; {count} connections now connect without a tunnel”

deleted_one_connection.value: 「{profile_name}」を削除。 {count} 接続がトンネルなしで接続されるようになりました
deleted_one_connection.location: Tunnel Profiles → Delete confirmation: status message “Deleted “{profile_name}”; {count} connection now connects without a tunnel”

deleted_password_cleanup_failed.value: 「{profile_name}」を削除しましたが、保存されたパスワードをキーリングから削除できませんでした: {error}
deleted_password_cleanup_failed.location: Tunnel Profiles → Delete confirmation: error message “Deleted “{profile_name}”, but its saved passwords could not be removed from the keyring: {error}”

deleted_without_connections.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: confirmation shown below the form after deleting a tunnel profile that no saved connection used; {profile_name} is the deleted profile's name.

dialog_title.value: トンネルプロファイル
dialog_title.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Title bar: title of the dialog, opened from the Command Palette or the Connection editor, for managing reusable proxy and SSH tunnel profiles shared by connections.

duplicate_name.value: この名前のトンネル プロファイルはすでに存在します
duplicate_name.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: validation error shown on Save when a new profile's name matches an existing tunnel profile's name (case-insensitive).

hop_required.value: 少なくとも 1 つのホップ (プロキシまたは SSH) を有効にします。
hop_required.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: validation error shown on Save when neither the proxy hop nor the SSH hop checkbox is ticked; a profile needs at least one.

import_ssh_config_option.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → SSH hop: first entry of the dropdown listing hosts from the user's SSH config file; acts as the prompt to fill the SSH fields from a host. Keep “~/.ssh/config” unchanged.

name_label.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Profile form: label above the text input for the tunnel profile's name, at the top of the form on the right of the profile list.

name_required.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: validation error shown on Save when the profile Name input is empty.

no_ssh_target.value: プローブする SSH ターゲットがありません
no_ssh_target.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: error shown after clicking Test when there is no target to test against (no SSH hop host and the dialog was not opened from a connection).

password_option.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → SSH hop → Authentication dropdown: option to sign in to the SSH server with a password typed in the masked field below.

private_key_option.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → SSH hop → Authentication dropdown: option to sign in to the SSH server with a private key file whose path is entered below.

profile_missing.value: そのトンネル プロファイルはもう存在しません
profile_missing.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: error shown after clicking Delete… when the selected profile was already removed (for example from another window).

proxy_host_required.value: プロキシホストは必須です
proxy_host_required.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: validation error shown on Save or Test when the proxy hop is enabled but its host input is empty.

proxy_port_invalid.value: プロキシ ポートは 1 ～ 65535 である必要があります
proxy_port_invalid.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: validation error shown on Save or Test when the proxy hop's port is not a whole number from 1 to 65535.

save_button.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Footer: primary button that validates the form and saves the tunnel profile (creating it or updating the selected one).

saved.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: short confirmation shown below the form after the tunnel profile is saved successfully.

ssh_agent_option.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → SSH hop → Authentication dropdown: default option to sign in to the SSH server using keys held by the system SSH agent.

test_button.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Footer: button that opens the tunnel through the configured hops as a trial (to the connection's server or the SSH host) and reports the result in the status line.

test_opened.value: トンネルは 127.0.0.1 にオープンしました:{local_port}
test_opened.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Status line: success message after clicking Test, when the tunnel opened; {local_port} is the temporary local port number it listened on.

use_proxy_label.value: プロキシの最初のホップを使用する
use_proxy_label.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Profile form: checkbox label that enables a SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT proxy as the first hop and reveals its host, port, user, and password fields.

use_ssh_label.value: SSH ホップを使用する
use_ssh_label.location: Tunnel profiles dialog → Profile form: checkbox label that enables an SSH hop (after the proxy, if any) and reveals its host, port, user, and authentication fields.

average.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Aggregate: selectable row that plots the mean (arithmetic average) of each category's values. Noun, one word.

count.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Aggregate: selectable row that plots how many non-empty values each category has. Noun, one word.

maximum.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Aggregate: selectable row that plots the largest value in each category. Noun, one word.

minimum.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Aggregate: selectable row that plots the smallest value in each category. Noun, one word.

none.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Aggregate: first selectable row, meaning no aggregation, so every result row becomes its own category.

sum.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Aggregate: selectable row that plots the total of each category's values. Noun, one word.

billions.location: Results → Chart tab → Value axis and histogram bin labels: abbreviated number for values of one billion or more; {value} is the value divided by 1,000,000,000 (e.g. 2.5B). Keep it very short.

millions.location: Results → Chart tab → Value axis and histogram bin labels: abbreviated number for values from one million up to a billion; {value} is the value divided by 1,000,000 (e.g. 2.5M). Keep it very short.

thousands.location: Results → Chart tab → Value axis and histogram bin labels: abbreviated number for values from one thousand up to a million; {value} is the value divided by 1,000 (e.g. 1.5K). Keep it very short.

false.location: Results → Chart tab → Category axis labels and legend: how a false Boolean value from the category column is written when it labels a bar, point, or slice.

true.location: Results → Chart tab → Category axis labels and legend: how a true Boolean value from the category column is written when it labels a bar, point, or slice.

no_numeric_column_to_histogram.value: ヒストグラムに数値列がありません
no_numeric_column_to_histogram.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a chart when Histogram is selected but the result has no numeric column to divide into bins.

no_numeric_columns.value: グラフに数値列がありません
no_numeric_columns.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a chart when the result has rows but none of its columns hold numbers to plot.

no_numeric_values_to_histogram.value: ヒストグラムに数値がありません
no_numeric_values_to_histogram.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a histogram when the chosen numeric column has no usable values (all empty), so no bins can be built.

no_rows.value: グラフ化する行がありません
no_rows.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a chart when the query result has no rows.

radial_category_limit.value: 円グラフとドーナツ グラフは最大 {max_categories} カテゴリをサポートします
radial_category_limit.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a pie or donut chart when there are too many categories; {max_categories} is the limit (16).

radial_negative_values.value: 円グラフとドーナツ グラフは負の値を表すことはできません
radial_negative_values.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a pie or donut chart when the plotted column contains negative numbers, which cannot be drawn as slices.

radial_requires_one_series.value: 円グラフとドーナツ グラフには 1 つの数値系列が必要です
radial_requires_one_series.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a pie or donut chart when zero or several value columns are selected; exactly one must be checked under Values.

radial_requires_positive_value.value: 円グラフとドーナツ グラフには少なくとも 1 つの正の値が必要です
radial_requires_positive_value.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart area: message shown instead of a pie or donut chart when every plotted value is zero or empty, so there is nothing to slice.

area.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for an area chart (lines with the area beneath them filled).

bar.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for a bar chart, the default type; grouped vertical bars per category.

donut.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for a donut chart (a pie chart with a hollow center).

histogram.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for a histogram, which counts how many values of one numeric column fall into each range (bin).

line.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for a line chart (one line per value column).

pie.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for a pie chart showing each category's share of one value column.

scatter.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Type: chart-type button for a scatter chart (a dot marker per category value).

by_label.location: SQLLY → Results → Chart → Legend strip: label naming the category source column.

category_ascending.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Order: selectable row that sorts categories alphabetically by label, A to Z.

source.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Order: selectable row that keeps categories in the order the rows came from the query (the source order).

value_descending.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Order: selectable row that sorts categories by their first plotted value, highest first.

fallback_name.location: SQLLY → Results → Chart → Legend or export: fallback series name when a numeric source column is unnamed.

aggregate_heading.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data section: small group heading above the rows choosing how rows sharing a category are combined (None, Sum, Average…).

behavior_section.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls: heading of the collapsible Behavior section, which holds the click-to-show-source-rows option.

browser_save_svg_unavailable.value: SVG の保存はブラウザーのプレビューでは使用できません。 SVGのコピーを使用します。
browser_save_svg_unavailable.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Export section (browser preview only): note in place of the Save SVG… action explaining files cannot be saved there and Copy SVG should be used instead.

category_auto.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Category: first selectable row, letting the chart pick the label column automatically (first text column, else row numbers).

category_heading.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data section: group heading above the list of columns to choose the one whose values label the categories (hidden for histograms).

controls_title.value: チャートコントロール
controls_title.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls sidebar: bold title at the top of the side panel holding the Type, Data, Behavior, and Export sections.

copy_svg.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Export section: action that copies the current chart to the clipboard as SVG vector-image markup. Keep “SVG” as is.

data_section.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls: heading of the collapsible Data section, holding category, values, aggregate, order, and limit choices.

export_section.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls: heading of the collapsible Export section, holding the Copy SVG and Save SVG… actions.

limit_heading.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data section: group heading above the row that sets the maximum number of categories drawn.

navigate_explanation.value: バー、ポイント、またはスライスをクリックすると、[グリッド] タブでその後ろにある結果行が選択されます。
navigate_explanation.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Behavior section: small help text under the click-to-show-source-rows checkbox, explaining that clicking a bar, point, or slice selects its rows on the Grid tab.

navigate_on_click.value: マークをクリックしてソース行を表示します
navigate_on_click.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Behavior section: checkbox label; when on, clicking a chart mark switches to the Grid tab with the rows behind it selected.

no_numeric_columns.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Values: muted placeholder shown in place of the value-column checklist when the result has no numeric columns.

order_heading.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data section: group heading above the rows choosing how categories are sorted along the axis.

save_svg.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Export section (desktop only): action that opens a save dialog to write the chart to an SVG file; the ellipsis signals a follow-up dialog.

top_n.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data → Limit: clickable row showing the current category cap; {count} is the cap, and each click cycles it through 10, 25, 50, 100, and 200.

type_section.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls: heading of the collapsible Type section, holding the chart-type buttons (Bar, Line, Pie…) and the save-chart button.

values_heading.location: Results → Chart tab → Chart Controls → Data section: group heading above the checklist of numeric columns plotted as series.

component_separator.location: Results → Chart tab → Legend strip → Showing note: separator placed between the listed limits (top categories, first numeric columns, first source rows) inside the “Showing …” note; spaces included.

first_numeric_columns.location: Results → Chart tab → Legend strip → Showing note: fragment, inserted after “Showing”, saying only the first {count} numeric columns are plotted (the series cap, 4). Lowercase fragment.

first_source_rows.location: Results → Chart tab → Legend strip → Showing note: fragment, inserted after “Showing”, saying only the first {count} result rows feed the chart (the row cap, 10,000). Lowercase fragment.

showing.location: Results → Chart tab → Legend strip: note shown above the plot when chart limits dropped data; {details} is one or more lowercase fragments such as “top 25 categories” joined by separators.

top_categories.location: Results → Chart tab → Legend strip → Showing note: fragment, inserted after “Showing”, saying only the top {count} categories (the Limit setting) are drawn. Lowercase fragment.

false.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Boolean cells: display text for a false value in a boolean column when the default true/false wording is used; a lowercase cell value, not a button.

true.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Boolean cells: display text for a true value in a boolean column when the default true/false wording is used; a lowercase cell value, not a button.

day_friday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Friday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_friday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Friday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

day_monday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Monday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_monday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Monday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

day_saturday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Saturday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_saturday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Saturday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

day_sunday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Sunday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_sunday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Sunday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

day_thursday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Thursday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_thursday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Thursday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

day_tuesday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Tuesday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_tuesday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Tuesday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

day_wednesday.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full weekday name for Wednesday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full day name; standalone word, capitalize as your language does for weekdays in dates.

day_wednesday_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short weekday name for Wednesday, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated day name; keep it about three characters.

month_april.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for April, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 April 2024”).

month_april_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for April, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_august.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for August, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 August 2024”).

month_august_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for August, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_december.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for December, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 December 2024”).

month_december_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for December, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_february.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for February, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 February 2024”).

month_february_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for February, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_january.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for January, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 January 2024”).

month_january_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for January, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_july.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for July, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 July 2024”).

month_july_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for July, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_june.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for June, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 June 2024”).

month_june_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for June, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_march.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for March, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 March 2024”).

month_march_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for March, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_may.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for May, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 May 2024”).

month_may_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for May, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_november.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for November, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 November 2024”).

month_november_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for November, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_october.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for October, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 October 2024”).

month_october_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for October, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_september.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for September, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 September 2024”).

month_september_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for September, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

unknown_day.location: SQLLY → Results → Date-formatted cell → Invalid weekday: fallback name for an invalid day component.

unknown_month.location: SQLLY → Results → Date-formatted cell → Invalid month: fallback name for an invalid month component.

billions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the billions (thousand millions), {value} is the scaled number and “G” the short magnitude suffix (4 000 000 000 shown as 4G); keep the suffix very short.

millions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the millions, {value} is the scaled number and “M” the short magnitude suffix (2 300 000 shown as 2.3M); keep the suffix very short.

quadrillions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the quadrillions and larger, {value} is the scaled number and “P” the short magnitude suffix (10¹⁵ range and above); keep the suffix very short.

thousands.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the thousands, {value} is the scaled number and “K” the short magnitude suffix (1 500 shown as 1.5K); keep the suffix very short.

trillions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the trillions (million millions), {value} is the scaled number and “T” the short magnitude suffix (10¹² range); keep the suffix very short.

component_separator.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: connector placed between two duration parts, as in “2 days and 3 hours”; include surrounding spaces as your language needs.

day_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: day unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 days ago”; the number is placed before it.

day_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: day unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 day ago”; the number is placed before it.

future.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: full text for a date in the future, {duration} is the number-plus-unit phrase such as “2 days and 3 hours”.

hour_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: hour unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 hours ago”; the number is placed before it.

hour_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: hour unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 hour ago”; the number is placed before it.

minute_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: minute unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 minutes ago”; the number is placed before it.

minute_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: minute unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 minute ago”; the number is placed before it.

month_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: month unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 months ago”; the number is placed before it.

month_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: month unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 month ago”; the number is placed before it.

now.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: text shown instead of a duration when the date equals the current moment (less than the smallest displayed unit away).

past.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: full text for a date in the past, {duration} is the number-plus-unit phrase such as “2 days and 3 hours”.

second_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: second unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 seconds ago”; the number is placed before it.

second_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: second unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 second ago”; the number is placed before it.

week_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: week unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 weeks ago”; the number is placed before it.

week_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: week unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 week ago”; the number is placed before it.

year_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: year unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 years ago”; the number is placed before it.

year_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: year unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 year ago”; the number is placed before it.

clear_filter.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: last menu item, removes any filter applied to the right-clicked column so all its rows show again.

clear_grouping.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that removes row grouping and returns to a flat list of rows.

clear_sort.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that removes the current sort and restores the original row order.

copy_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that copies the right-clicked column's values to the clipboard without its header name.

copy_column_with_headers.value: ヘッダー付きの列をコピー
copy_column_with_headers.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that copies the right-clicked column's values to the clipboard with the column name as the first line.

filter_prompt.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item near the bottom that opens the column's sort-and-filter panel; the trailing dots signal that a panel follows.

freeze_columns_up_to_here.value: ここまでの列を固定します
freeze_columns_up_to_here.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that pins every column from the left edge through this one so they stay visible while scrolling sideways; title-case command.

group_by_column.value: この列でグループ化する
group_by_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that groups the rows into collapsible sections by the values of the right-clicked column.

hide_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that hides the right-clicked column from the grid.

move_column_left.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that swaps the right-clicked column one position to the left.

move_column_right.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that swaps the right-clicked column one position to the right.

select_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: first menu item, selects every cell of the right-clicked column.

show_all_columns.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that brings back every previously hidden column.

sort_ascending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that sorts all rows by this column, smallest or A–Z first.

sort_descending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that sorts all rows by this column, largest or Z–A first.

unfreeze_columns.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that releases all pinned (frozen) columns so they scroll normally again.

ragged_row.value: 行 {row_index} には {actual} セルがありますが、{expected} が予期されていました
ragged_row.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Data validation: error shown when a row does not match the column count.

banner.value: ピボットからフィルタリング: {filter_label}
banner.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: strip above the grid after drilling into a pivot cell, telling the user the grid is filtered; {filter_label} is the comma-separated list of column = value conditions.

clear_filter.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: clickable button with an X icon at the right end of the banner that removes the drill-through filter and shows all rows again.

field_equals.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: one condition inside the banner's filter list; {field_name} is the column name and {values} the matching value or values joined by a vertical bar.

values_omitted.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: shortened value list used when a condition has more than three values; {values} are the first two values and {value_count} the total number of values.

no_rows.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Empty result area: message shown when no rows are available.

clear_filter.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: bottom-left button that removes this column's filter; greyed out and inactive when no filter is applied.

close.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: bottom-right button that closes the panel and keeps whatever sort or filter was set.

date_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the date operand placeholder input.

filter_heading.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: small muted section heading above the condition dropdown, search box and value checklist; a noun.

number_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the number operand placeholder input.

number_operator_between.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows inside a range and shows two input boxes joined by “and”; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_choose_one.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel → Numeric operator menu: Choose One placeholder option.

number_operator_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value equals the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_greater_than.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is above the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_greater_than_or_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is at or above the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_less_than.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is below the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_less_than_or_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is at or below the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_not_between.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows outside a range and shows two input boxes joined by “and”; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_not_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value differs from the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

refine_search.value: さらに表示するには検索を絞り込みます…
refine_search.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: muted note at the end of the value checklist when more than 200 distinct values match, asking the user to type in the search box to narrow the list.

regex_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the regex operand placeholder input.

search_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the search placeholder input.

second_operand_and.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: small muted word between the two input boxes shown when the “between” or “not between” condition is chosen, linking the lower and upper bounds.

select_all.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: first row of the distinct-values checklist, with a checkbox that checks or unchecks every listed value; parentheses mark it as a special entry, not a data value.

sort_ascending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: left button under the Sort heading that sorts rows by this column smallest or A–Z first; highlighted while active.

sort_descending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: right button under the Sort heading that sorts rows by this column largest or Z–A first; highlighted while active.

sort_heading.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: small muted section heading at the top of the panel, above the Ascending and Descending buttons; a noun.

text_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the text operand placeholder input.

text_operator_begins_with.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text starts with the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_choose_one.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel → Text operator menu: Choose One placeholder option.

text_operator_contains.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text includes the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_does_not_contain.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text does not include the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_ends_with.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text ends with the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_is.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text exactly equals the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_is_not.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text is anything other than the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_matches_regex.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text matches the entered regular expression; the parenthesized word names the pattern syntax; lowercase phrase following the column value.

row_plural.location: Results → Grid tab → Grouped rows → Group header row: label for a group with zero or several rows; {marker} is the expand/collapse arrow, {group_label} the shared column value, {row_count} the number of rows (not 1).

row_singular.location: Results → Grid tab → Grouped rows → Group header row: label for a group containing exactly one row; {marker} is the expand/collapse arrow, {group_label} the shared column value, {row_count} is 1.

no_matches.location: Results → Grid find bar (Find in results): match counter beside the search field when the typed text matches no cell in the active grid.

position.location: Results → Grid find bar (Find in results): match counter beside the search field; {current} is the number of the highlighted match and {total} the total match count.

position_truncated.location: Results → Grid find bar (Find in results): match counter used when the scan stopped at the match limit; {current} is the highlighted match, {total} the capped count and the plus sign means more exist.

collapsed_chart.location: Results → Chart tab → Collapsed sidebar rail: vertical label on the slim strip left where the chart settings sidebar was collapsed; clicking it expands the sidebar again; very narrow space.

collapsed_pivot.location: Results → Pivot tab → Collapsed sidebar rail: vertical label on the slim strip left where the pivot field sidebar was collapsed; clicking it expands the sidebar again; very narrow space.

chart.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: tab that shows the chart view of the same rows, present when charting is enabled; short noun.

chart_with_status.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: Chart tab title while the tab is locked, e.g. during streaming; {status} is a short state such as “Loading...” or “Result too large”.

grid.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: first tab, always shown, that displays the rows as a plain table; short noun.

pivot.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: tab that shows the pivot-table view of the same rows, present when pivoting is enabled; short noun.

pivot_with_status.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: Pivot tab title while the tab is locked, e.g. during streaming; {status} is a short state such as “Loading...” or “Result too large”.

average.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Avg” that summarizes the Values field as the arithmetic mean of its numbers; very short abbreviation, it also starts the “Avg of …” caption.

average_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the average (mean) aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Avg of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

count.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Count” that summarizes the Values field as the number of source rows in each pivot cell; short noun, not a verb.

count_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the count (number of rows) aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Count of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

first.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “First” that shows the first source value found for each pivot cell instead of a calculated summary; short adjective/noun.

first_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the first-value aggregation and its source column, e.g. “First of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

maximum.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Max” that summarizes the Values field as the largest value in each pivot cell; very short abbreviation of maximum.

maximum_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the maximum aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Max of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

minimum.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Min” that summarizes the Values field as the smallest value in each pivot cell; very short abbreviation of minimum.

minimum_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the minimum aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Min of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

sum.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Sum” that summarizes the Values field as the total of its numbers in each pivot cell; short noun, not a verb.

sum_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the sum (total) aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Sum of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

copy_csv.value: ピボットをCSVとしてコピー
copy_csv.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot cell right-click menu: item that copies the whole pivot table (headers, rows, totals) to the clipboard as comma-separated text.

copy_value.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot cell right-click menu: item that copies only the right-clicked cell’s aggregated value to the clipboard.

show_source_rows.value: ソース行をグリッドに表示
show_source_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot cell right-click menu: drill-through item that switches to the Grid tab filtered to the source rows behind the clicked pivot cell (same as double-clicking it).

no_matching_data.value: 現在のピボット フィルターに一致するデータはありません。
no_matching_data.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot canvas: centered message shown instead of the table when the pivot is configured but the active Filters exclude every source row.

not_configured.value: フィールドを行、列、値にドラッグしてピボットを構築します。
not_configured.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot canvas: centered prompt shown before any field has been placed, telling the user to drag fields into the Rows, Columns and Values zones of the sidebar.

blank.location: SQLLY → Results → Pivot → Row or column group header: label for null or blank source values.

align_center.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Alignment row: middle toggle button that centers the field’s values in their cells; one short word, the three buttons share a narrow row.

align_left.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Alignment row: first toggle button that left-aligns the field’s values in their cells; one short word, the three buttons share a narrow row.

align_right.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Alignment row: last toggle button that right-aligns the field’s values in their cells; one short word, the three buttons share a narrow row.

alignment_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: small heading above the Left / Center / Right buttons that set how the double-clicked field’s values are aligned.

collapse_columns.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that collapses every column group to its subtotal; abbreviated “cols” because it sits beside “Expand cols” in a narrow row.

collapse_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that collapses every row group to its subtotal line; sits beside “Expand rows” in a narrow row.

column_subtotals.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that adds a subtotal column after each column group; means “show subtotal columns for column groups”.

columns_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Columns drop zone; fields dragged here become the pivot’s column headers.

columns_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: one-letter badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Columns zone; must stay one or two letters.

controls_title.value: ピボットコントロール
controls_title.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: bold title at the top of the sidebar that holds the Fields, Layout and Display and export sections.

copy_csv.value: ピボットをCSVとしてコピー
copy_csv.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Export: button that copies the whole pivot table to the clipboard as comma-separated text.

decimals_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: label beside the minus/plus stepper that sets how many decimal places (0–8) the field’s numbers show.

display_section.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: title of the third collapsible section, holding the totals, group expand/collapse and CSV export options.

drag_fields_here.value: ここにフィールドをドラッグします
drag_fields_here.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: muted placeholder inside an empty Filters, Columns, Rows or Values drop zone, inviting the user to drop a field there.

expand_columns.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that expands every collapsed column group; abbreviated “cols” because it sits beside “Collapse cols” in a narrow row.

expand_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that expands every collapsed row group; sits beside “Collapse rows” in a narrow row.

export_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the “Copy pivot as CSV” button.

fallback_field_name.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: chip label used for a field placed in a zone when its source column has no name; {column_index} is the column’s zero-based position.

fields_section.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: title of the first collapsible section, listing the result set’s columns that can be dragged into the layout zones.

filter_clear.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: button at the bottom that removes this field’s filter so all its values are included again.

filter_close.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: button at the bottom that closes the popover, keeping the checked values as the filter.

filter_first_values.value: 最初の {count} 値を表示しています…
filter_first_values.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: muted note at the end of the value checklist when the field has more distinct values than the list shows; {count} is how many are listed.

filter_select_all.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: first checklist entry that checks or unchecks every value of the field at once; parentheses mark it as a special entry, not a data value.

filter_title.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: heading of the popover opened by clicking a chip in the Filters zone; {field_name} is the column being filtered.

filters_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Filters drop zone; fields dragged here can be clicked to choose which of their values the pivot includes.

filters_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: short badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Filters zone; must stay one or two letters and differ from the other zone badges.

flat_rows.value: フラットな行 (階層なし)
flat_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Layout: checkbox that shows the row fields side by side as flat columns instead of an indented, collapsible hierarchy.

format_close.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: button at the bottom that closes the popup, keeping the format changes already applied.

format_reset.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: button at the bottom that restores the field’s default number format and alignment.

format_title.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: heading of the popup opened by double-clicking a field chip in a layout zone; {field_name} is the column being formatted.

grand_total_column.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that shows a grand-total column at the right edge of the pivot.

grand_total_row.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that shows a grand-total row at the bottom of the pivot.

groups_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the Expand/Collapse rows and columns buttons that open or fold all group levels.

layout_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the “Flat rows (no hierarchy)” checkbox; distinct from the Layout section title.

layout_section.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: title of the second collapsible section, holding the Filters, Columns, Rows and Values drop zones and the save-configuration icon.

negative_example_minus.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Negatives row: button showing a sample negative number with a leading minus sign; picks that style. Localize only digit grouping, not the digits.

negative_example_parentheses.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Negatives row: button showing a sample negative number in accounting parentheses; picks that style. Localize only digit grouping, not the digits.

negative_numbers_in_red.value: 負の数は赤色で表示されます
negative_numbers_in_red.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: checkbox that paints the field’s negative values in red.

negatives_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: small heading above the two sample buttons that choose how negative numbers are written (minus sign or parentheses).

row_subtotals.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that adds a subtotal row after each row group.

rows_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Rows drop zone; fields dragged here become the pivot’s row headers (nested groups).

rows_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: short badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Rows zone; must stay one or two letters and differ from the other zone badges.

save_configuration.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → section header: tooltip on the disk icon that saves the current pivot layout (fields, aggregation, options) so it can be reused; only present when the app supports saving.
