thousands_separator.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: checkbox that groups the field’s digits with a thousands separator (e.g. 1,234).

totals_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the subtotal and grand-total checkboxes.

unconfigured_hint.value: フィールドをレイアウト ゾーンにドラッグします
unconfigured_hint.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section: muted hint above the field list telling the user to drag a column into one of the Filters, Columns, Rows or Values zones.

values_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Values drop zone; the field dragged here is summarized (Count, Sum, Avg…) in the pivot’s cells.

values_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: one-letter badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Values zone; must stay one or two letters.

grand_total.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table and copied CSV: label of the grand-total row at the bottom and grand-total column at the right, summing every group.

group_total.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table and copied CSV: label of a subtotal row or column, or of a collapsed group; {group_label} is the group’s value, e.g. “2024 Total”.

total.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table and copied CSV: label of the single summary row when no row fields are placed, or a subtotal column whose group name is unknown.

caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table: generic value column header shown when no field is in the Values zone, so the cells hold only row counts.

fallback_field_name.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table value header: name used inside the “Sum of …” caption when the Values field’s source column has no name; {column_index} is its zero-based position.

close.location: Dialogs (shared frame) → Footer: default Close button at the bottom right of dialogs that have no custom buttons; dismisses the dialog.

pop_out.location: Dialogs (shared frame) → Title bar: small button on detachable dialogs that moves the dialog out of the main window into its own separate window; keep the ⤢ arrow symbol.

sandbox_blocked.value: App Store サンドボックスでは Mac にインストールされているプログラムの起動が許可されていないため、{feature} は Mac App Store 版の SQLLY では利用できません。異なる点については、「ヘルプ」▸「Mac App Store エディション」を参照してください。
sandbox_blocked.location: Mac App Store edition → Sandbox limitation error: feature-specific message explaining why launching an installed program is unavailable and where to read edition differences.

add_foreign_key_join.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that inserts a JOIN to the table referenced by the clicked column’s foreign key.

automagic_commas_disable.value: このクエリの Automagic {clause} カンマを無効にします
automagic_commas_disable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns off automatic comma repair for one clause in this query only; {clause} is the SQL clause keyword, e.g. SELECT or ORDER BY.

automagic_commas_enable.value: このクエリに対して Automagic {clause} カンマを有効にする
automagic_commas_enable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns on automatic comma repair for one clause in this query only; {clause} is the SQL clause keyword, e.g. SELECT or ORDER BY.

automagic_commas_reset.value: Automagic カンマ設定を環境設定にリセットする
automagic_commas_reset.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that drops this query’s comma overrides so the Settings defaults apply again.

automagic_connectors_disable.value: このクエリに対して Automagic WHERE/ON コネクタを無効にする
automagic_connectors_disable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns off automatic AND/OR connector repair in WHERE and ON clauses for this query only.

automagic_connectors_enable.value: このクエリに対して Automagic WHERE/ON コネクタを有効にする
automagic_connectors_enable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns on automatic AND/OR connector repair in WHERE and ON clauses for this query only.

automagic_submenu.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: submenu title grouping the per-query toggles of the Automagic comma and connector repairs; Automagic is the feature name.

expand_wildcard.value: ワイルドカードを列名に展開します
expand_wildcard.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item shown on a SELECT * that replaces the asterisk with the explicit list of column names.

format_column.value: {column} をフォーマットします…
format_column.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that opens the Format column dialog for the clicked column; {column} is the column name; the ellipsis signals that a dialog opens.

identity_insert_on.value: この INSERT 付近の {table} の IDENTITY_INSERT を ON にします
identity_insert_on.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item on a SQL Server INSERT into an identity table that wraps the statement in SET IDENTITY_INSERT ON/OFF; {table} is the table name; IDENTITY_INSERT and INSERT are SQL keywords.

qualify_identifier.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that prefixes the clicked column with its table or alias; {qualifier} is that table or alias and {column} the column name, shown as written in SQL.

qualify_selection_many.value: 選択範囲内の {count} 列を修飾します
qualify_selection_many.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that prefixes every unqualified column in the selection with its table or alias; {count} is the number of columns (2 or more).

qualify_selection_one.value: 選択範囲内の {count} 列を修飾します
qualify_selection_one.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that prefixes the single unqualified column in the selection with its table or alias; {count} is always 1.

remove_qualifier.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that removes the table or alias prefix from the clicked column; {column} is the column name.

show_display_name.value: 参照されている表示名を表示する
show_display_name.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that adds the referenced table’s human-readable display column for the clicked foreign-key column.

column_inferred.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card (Ctrl+Shift+Space after a comparison on a date column): column description when the column has no known type but its name suggests a date; {column} is the column as written.

column_typed.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: column description when the column’s declared type is known; {column} is the column as written and {parameter_type} its SQL type, e.g. “OrderDate (datetime)”.

empty_phrase_hint.value: Enter で日付を書き込み、言葉を --sqlly date に保持します: コメント · Esc でキャンセル
empty_phrase_hint.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: last line before anything is typed, explaining that Enter inserts the date plus a “--sqlly date:” comment keeping the phrase, and Esc closes the card; keep “--sqlly date:” verbatim.

for_column.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card → first line: dimmed fragment appended after “Type a date in plain words”; {column} is the column description. Starts with a space and continues that sentence.

insert_hint.value: 挿入するには Enter、キャンセルするには Esc
insert_hint.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: last line shown once the typed phrase is understood, under the preview of the resulting SQL; Enter inserts it, Esc cancels.

instruction.value: わかりやすい言葉で日付を入力してください
instruction.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: bold first line telling the user to type a date phrase such as “last wed at 3” or “ytd”; followed by the dimmed “for {column}” fragment.

unrecognized_phrase.value: 「{phrase}」はまだ読めない日付です。試してみてください:
unrecognized_phrase.location: SQL Editor → Date Helper: message or display text shown as ““{phrase}” isn't a date I can read yet — try:”.

current_monitor_label.location: Go to definition (Cmd/Ctrl-click) → Definition popup placement: name for the monitor holding the active SQLLY window, used when the popup opens there; {resolution} is width×height in pixels.

monitor_label.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window → Monitor dropdown: option naming one connected display; {number} is its 1-based position and {resolution} its width×height in pixels.

copy_button.location: Definition viewer (Cmd/Ctrl-click an object; tab, side panel or popup) → Header: button that copies the shown DDL source to the clipboard.

find_close.value: 閉じる検索 (エスケープ)
find_close.location: Definition viewer → find bar: tooltip of the ✕ button that closes the find bar (also Escape).

find_next.location: Definition viewer → find bar: tooltip of the down-arrow button that moves to the next match (also Enter).

find_previous.location: Definition viewer → find bar: tooltip of the up-arrow button that moves to the previous match (also Shift+Enter).

find_placeholder.location: Definition viewer → find bar: placeholder in the search field.

find_button.location: Definition viewer (read-only DDL tab, side panel or popup) → header toolbar: button that opens the find bar to search the shown definition.

header_subtitle.location: Definition viewer → Header: dimmed line under the object name; {role} is what was clicked (table, column X…), {source} the definition source, {database} and {connection} where it came from.

loading.location: Definition viewer → Body: centered placeholder shown while the object’s DDL is being fetched from the server.

no_source.value: このオブジェクトに対して DDL ソースが返されませんでした。
no_source.location: Definition viewer → Body: warning shown when the server answered but returned no DDL text for the clicked object.

open_query_button.location: Definition viewer → Header: button that copies the shown DDL into a new, editable query tab.

role_column.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the user Cmd/Ctrl-clicked a table column; {name} is the column name. Lowercase noun phrase.

role_function.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a function. Single lowercase noun.

role_index.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the user Cmd/Ctrl-clicked an index name; {name} is the index name. Lowercase noun phrase.

role_parameter.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the user Cmd/Ctrl-clicked a stored-procedure parameter; {name} is the parameter name. Lowercase noun phrase.

role_procedure.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a stored procedure. Single lowercase noun.

role_table.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a table (not a column or index of it). Single lowercase noun.

role_type.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a user-defined data type. Single lowercase noun.

role_view.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a database view. Single lowercase noun.

directive_hover_action.value: クリックしてすべての書式設定オプションを表示 →
directive_hover_action.location: SQL Editor → Hover popup over a “-- sqlly” formatting comment: second, accent-colored clickable line that opens the full formatting-directives reference.

directive_hover_explanation.value: このコメントは、SQLLY がこれらの結果をどのようにフォーマットするかを制御します。
directive_hover_explanation.location: SQL Editor → Hover popup over a “-- sqlly” formatting comment: first line explaining that the comment controls how the query’s results are formatted.

improve_hint_prefix.value: これを改善するには、 を押してください
improve_hint_prefix.location: SQL Editor → Completion popup → bottom hint strip: lowercase text placed directly before an “F2” keycap, inviting the user to report bad suggestions; sentence fragment ending at the key.

more_lines.location: SQL Editor → Folded region hover preview: last line of the preview when the folded block is longer than the lines shown; {count} is the number of hidden lines.

no_suggestions.value: 提案はありません - F2 を押して問題を改善してください
no_suggestions.location: SQL Editor → Completion popup: empty-state text shown when IntelliSense has no suggestions at the caret; F2 opens the feedback report. Keep “F2”.

refresh_date.location: SQL Editor → Inline chip at the end of a line with a “--sqlly date:” comment: clickable chip that re-evaluates the statement’s single natural-language date against today.

refresh_dates.location: SQL Editor → Inline chip at the end of a statement line: clickable chip that re-evaluates all of the statement’s natural-language dates against today; {count} is how many (2 or more).

see_formatting_directives.value: SQLLY フォーマットディレクティブを参照→
see_formatting_directives.location: SQL Editor → Diagnostic hover popup on a problem inside a “-- sqlly” comment: accent-colored link line that opens the formatting-directives reference.

count.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: match counter beside the search box; {current} is the selected match’s number and {total} the number of matches.

count_truncated.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: match counter when the search stopped at the match limit; {total} is the limit and the “+” means there are more.

no_matches.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: counter text beside the search box when the search text is not found in the editor.

pattern_too_large.value: パターンが {limit_kib} KiB 制限を超えています
pattern_too_large.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: inline error when Regex mode is on and the pattern exceeds the size limit; {limit_kib} is the limit in kibibytes. Lowercase sentence fragment.

binary_base64.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing the bytes as Base64; Base64 is a technical name.

binary_hex.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing the bytes as hexadecimal.

binary_ulid.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing 16-byte values as a ULID (26-character sortable id); other lengths stay hexadecimal. ULID is a technical name.

binary_uuid.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing 16-byte values as a hyphenated UUID; other lengths stay hexadecimal. UUID is a technical name.

boolean_one_zero.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: true/false column option showing 1 and 0.

boolean_true_false.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: true/false column option showing the words true and false; keep the words lowercase.

boolean_yes_no.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: true/false column option showing Yes and No; the rendered cells use the English words Yes/No, so keep them.

custom.value: カスタムフォーマッタ…
custom.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: last option, available for every column type, that opens a custom formatter instead of a preset; the ellipsis signals more input follows.

date_only.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: date/time column option showing only the date; the example date in parentheses shows the format.

date_time.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: date/time column option showing the date and time of day.

date_time_offset.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: date/time column option showing the date, time of day, and UTC offset.

decimals_four.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option rounding to four decimal places with thousands separators.

decimals_no_grouping.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option with two decimal places and no thousands separators.

decimals_six.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option rounding to six decimal places with thousands separators.

decimals_two.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option rounding to two decimal places with thousands separators.

epoch_milliseconds.value: エポックミリ秒 → 日付/時刻
epoch_milliseconds.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option reading the value as Unix epoch milliseconds and showing it as a date and time.

epoch_seconds.value: エポック秒 → 日付/時刻
epoch_seconds.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option reading the value as Unix epoch seconds and showing it as a date and time.

integer_plain.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option shown without separators.

integer_thousands.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option adding thousands separators.

text_lowercase.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that shows the text in lowercase.

text_mask_all.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that hides every character.

text_mask_last_four.value: マスク (最後の 4 件を表示)
text_mask_last_four.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that hides all but the last four characters, e.g. for card numbers.

text_original.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that leaves the text unchanged.

text_uppercase.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that shows the text in uppercase.

clear_filter.value: すべての {count} ファミリを表示するには、フィルターをクリアします。
clear_filter.location: Formatting Directives window → Detail pane: centered empty-state hint shown on the right when the filter matches nothing; {count} is the total number of directive families available.

copied_button.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card → Examples: chip text shown for about 1.6 seconds after an example line is copied, confirming it is on the clipboard; past participle, very short.

copy_button.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card → Examples: small chip at the right edge of each example line, idle state; clicking the line copies it to the clipboard (verb).

canvas_dimensions.value: キャンバスの寸法。 2x2 (空ではない最初の行のみ)。
canvas_dimensions.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<rows>x<columns>” parameter; the canvas size such as 2x2, only recognized on the first non-empty line.

canvas_layout_overview.value: 複数の結果セットを 1 つのグリッド キャンバスに配置します。 Canvas ディレクティブは、空ではない最初の行でのみ適用されます。各結果: 次の結果を生成するステートメントを配置します。
canvas_layout_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly <rows>x<columns> / -- sqlly result:” directive places several result sets on one grid-shaped canvas, with the size line honored only first and each result: line placing the next result.

canvas_layout_title.value: キャンバスのレイアウト
canvas_layout_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly <rows>x<columns> / -- sqlly result:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (arranging several results on one grid canvas).

canvas_result.value: 次の結果セットの 1 から始まるセル。範囲はセルにまたがります。
canvas_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result: <row>|<column>” parameter; the 1-based canvas cell where the next result set goes; ranges make it span several cells.

chart_aggregate.value: カテゴリごとに行を折りたたむ: なし、合計、平均、最小、最大、またはカウント。
chart_aggregate.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “aggregate:<agg>” parameter; how rows sharing a category are combined: none, sum, average, minimum, maximum, or count.

chart_kind.value: 棒、線、面、散布図、ヒストグラム、円グラフ、またはドーナツ (必須)。
chart_kind.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “kind:<type>” parameter; required; lists the allowed chart types as keywords (bar, line, area, scatter, histogram, pie, donut) that stay untranslated in the directive.

chart_label.value: カテゴリにラベルを付ける列 (デフォルト: 最初のテキスト列)。
chart_label.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “label:<col>” parameter; the column whose values label the chart's categories; defaults to the first text column.

chart_navigate.value: マークをクリックすると、[グリッド] タブでそのソース行が選択されます (デフォルトは true)。
chart_navigate.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “navigate:<true|false>” parameter; whether clicking a bar, point, or slice selects its source rows on the Grid tab; on by default.

chart_order.value: カテゴリの順序: ソース、カテゴリ (A ～ Z)、または値 (高値から低値)。
chart_order.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “order:<order>” parameter; how categories are sorted: source order, alphabetically by category, or by value from high to low.

chart_overview.value: [チャート] タブを構成します: タイプ、カテゴリ ラベル、系列、集計。 -- sqlly view: chart と組み合わせて、実行時に開きます。
chart_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly chart:” directive configures the result's Chart tab (type, labels, series, aggregation) and pairs with the view directive to open it on run.

chart_result.value: グラフが属する 1 から始まる結果セット (デフォルトは 1)。
chart_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result:<n>” parameter; which 1-based result set the chart settings apply to; defaults to the first.

chart_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly chart:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (the Chart tab configuration; noun).

chart_top.value: 注文後に保持できるカテゴリは最大 n 個です。
chart_top.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “top:<n>” parameter; limits the chart to the first n categories after sorting.

chart_values.value: 系列としてプロットする数値列 (デフォルト: 自動検出)。
chart_values.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “values:<col[,col…]>” parameter; the numeric column or columns plotted as series; detected automatically when omitted.

column_format_overview.value: 単一の結果列の表示方法をフォーマットします。
column_format_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly format:” directive changes how one result column is displayed.

column_format_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly format:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (per-column display formatting of a result).

computed_after.value: この列の後に配置します (デフォルト: 最後)。
computed_after.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “after=<column>” parameter; the existing column the new column is inserted after; appended at the end by default.

computed_column_overview.value: 結果自体の列から Excel の数式で計算された列を追加します。列には !Name、!Name[1] の前の行、固定行 !Name[$1]、および宣言された変数 @name が書き込まれます。 IF、COALESCE、テキスト、数学、および日付関数は Excel と同様に機能し、Excel エクスポートでは数式が保持されます。
computed_column_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly column:” directive adds a column calculated by an Excel-style formula and explains the !Name, !Name[1], !Name[$1], and @name reference syntax, which must stay as written.

computed_column_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly column:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (adding a formula-based column).

computed_formula.value: Excel の数式。先頭の = はオプションです。
computed_formula.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<formula>” parameter; the Excel-style formula that computes each cell; the leading equals sign may be omitted.

computed_name.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<Name>” parameter; the header name of the column being added.

computed_range.value: 範囲: この行とその前の 2 行。
computed_range.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “!A[2]:!A” parameter; explains this range example covers the current row plus the two rows above it.

computed_result.value: n 番目の結果セットのみ (デフォルト: 適合するすべての結果セット)。
computed_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result=<n>” parameter; restricts the computed column to the n-th result set; otherwise it is added to every result it fits.

computed_row_refs.value: この行、前の行、最初の行。
computed_row_refs.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “!Name / !Name[1] / !Name[$1]” parameter; glosses the three reference forms in order: current row, previous row, and the fixed first row.

computed_value.value: -- sqlly set または -- sqlly param: 値。
computed_value.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “@name” parameter; says @name refers to a value declared by a set or param directive line.

conditional_bar.value: 各値 (数値) に比例したデータ バー。
conditional_bar.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “bar=#RRGGBB” parameter; draws an in-cell data bar whose length is proportional to each numeric value.

conditional_bold.value: 一致するセルの太字テキスト。
conditional_bold.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “bold” parameter; a flag that makes the text of cells passing the test bold.

conditional_column.value: ルールが適用される結果列 (必須)。
conditional_column.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “column=<name>” parameter; required; the result column whose cells the coloring rule tests and styles.

conditional_fill.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “fill=#RRGGBB” parameter; the background color given to cells that pass the test.

conditional_overview.value: このクエリの場合のみ、列のセルを値に基づいて色付けします。 1 行に 1 つのルール。列に最初に一致する when= ルールが優先され、これらのルールは [条件付き書式設定] ダイアログに保存されたルールよりも前に置かれます。
conditional_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly conditional:” directive colors a column's cells by value for this query only, one rule per line, and takes precedence over rules saved in the Conditional Formatting dialog.

conditional_scale.value: 列の最小値から最大値までのカラー スケール (数値)。
conditional_scale.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “scale=#RRGGBB..#RRGGBB” parameter; a two-color gradient spanning the numeric column's lowest to highest value.

conditional_text.value: 一致するセルのテキストの色。
conditional_text.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “text=#RRGGBB” parameter; the font color given to cells that pass the test.

conditional_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly conditional:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (value-based cell coloring rules).

conditional_when.value: null、not null、> n、< n、a と b の間、<text> であるか、<text> を含む (テキスト テストは大文字と小文字を無視します)。
conditional_when.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “when=<test>” parameter; lists the available tests (null, comparisons, between, is, contains); text tests are case-insensitive.

date_phrase.value: 入力した内容: 今日、去年の水曜日の 3 時、11 月、過去 7 日間…
date_phrase.location: Formatting Directives window → Natural-language date directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<phrase>” parameter; the original plain-words date the user typed, with example phrases (today, last wed at 3, november, ytd, past 7 days) that the parser understands in English.

default_result_overview.value: 結果が到着したときにどの結果セットを表示するかを選択します。そのタブはタブ付きレイアウトで選択され、そのカードは積み上げレイアウトでスクロールされて表示されます。コメントが行全体である場合、スクリプト内のどこでも尊重されます。後のフォーカス: 以前のフォーカスをオーバーライドします。
default_result_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Default result directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly focus:” directive chooses which result set is in view when results arrive (selected tab or scrolled-to card) and how repeated lines resolve.

default_result_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Default result directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly focus:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (which result set is shown first).

focus_result.value: デフォルトで表示される結果セットの 1 から始まるインデックス。
focus_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Default result directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<n>” parameter; the only parameter: the 1-based number of the result set shown by default.

format_binary.value: binary/varbinary 値をレンダリングする方法。
format_binary.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “binary=<hex|base64>” parameter; chooses how binary/varbinary column values are rendered as text.

format_boolean.value: true / false を表示するテキスト。例:はい/いいえ。
format_boolean.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “boolean=<true-text>/<false-text>” parameter; the replacement words displayed for true and false values, e.g. Yes/No.

format_column.value: このルールが適用される結果列 (必須)。
format_column.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “column=<name>” parameter; says which result column the format rule targets and that it is required.

format_date.value: strftime パターン、例: %Y-%m-%d または %d %b %Y。
format_date.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “date=<pattern>” parameter; explains the value is a strftime date pattern; keep the example patterns unchanged.

format_number.value: 指定された小数点以下の桁を持つ固定小数点数。
format_number.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “number=<decimals>” parameter; shows values as fixed-point numbers with that many decimal places.

format_text.value: テキスト列の大文字と小文字を変更します。
format_text.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “text=<upper|lower|title|none>” parameter; changes the letter case of a text column's values.

format_thousands.value: 数値形式の千の位の区切り文字 (デフォルトは true)。
format_thousands.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “thousands=<true|false>” parameter; turns digit-group separators on or off for a number format; default is on.

format_width.value: フォント相対単位での列幅: 1 dp はグリッド フォント サイズの 4 分の 1 なので、どのフォント サイズでも列に表示される文字数はほぼ同じになります。回線上の唯一の設定である可能性があります。
format_width.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “width=<n>dp” parameter; explains the font-relative dp width unit (1dp = a quarter of the grid font size) and that width may be the line's only setting.

grid_columns_overview.value: 結果グリッドの列を配置します: 順序、非表示列と固定列、並べ替え、グループ化、列フィルター、外部キー ラベル。 SQLly がクエリ用に記憶するレイアウトを優先します。
grid_columns_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly grid:” directive sets column order, hidden and frozen columns, sorting, grouping, filters, and foreign-key labels, overriding the layout SQLly remembers for the query.

grid_columns_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly grid:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (arranging results-grid columns).

grid_filter.value: 列フィルタ (反復可能): を含む、含まない、で始まる、で終わる、で終わる、でない、一致する、=、!=、>、>=、<、<=、a と b の間、a と b の間ではない、または a | b | c.
grid_filter.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “filter=<col> <op> <value>” parameter; a repeatable column filter, listing the allowed operators; operator words are typed in the directive.

grid_freeze.value: 表示されている最初の n 列を固定します。
grid_freeze.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “freeze=<n>” parameter; keeps the first n visible columns pinned while scrolling horizontally.

grid_group.value: 行を列ごとにグループ化します。
grid_group.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “group=<col>” parameter; groups the grid rows by the values of one column.

grid_hide.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “hide=<cols>” parameter; the list of columns hidden from the grid.

grid_label.value: キー列の横に表示される外部キー ラベル (繰り返し可能)。
grid_label.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “label=<col>:<column|off>” parameter; a repeatable foreign-key label: a readable column shown next to a key column, or off to suppress it.

grid_order.value: 表示順序;リストされていない列は独自の順序で続きます。
grid_order.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “order=<cols>” parameter; the display order of the listed columns; columns not listed keep their original order after them.

grid_result.value: オプションの 1 から始まる結果セット。それがなければ、すべての結果セット。
grid_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<n>” parameter; an optional leading 1-based result-set number; without it the line applies to every result set.

grid_sort.value: 複数列の並べ替え (デフォルトでは昇順)。
grid_sort.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “sort=<col> [asc|desc], …” parameter; sorts by one or more columns, ascending unless desc is given.

layout_lines.value: 行は、独自の割り当てを持たないスタックされたカードすべてに割り当てられます。
layout_lines.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “lines: <rows>” parameter; the default height in rows for every stacked result card without its own setting.

layout_lines_result.value: n 番目の結果セットのスタック カードに割り当てられる行 (1 から始まる)。カードの区切り線をドラッグすると、引き続き区切り区切りが上書きされます。
layout_lines_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “lines <n>: <rows>” parameter; the height in rows for one specific stacked card (the n-th result set); dragging the card divider still overrides it.

layout_mode.value: 結果を表示するレイアウト (タブもタブ化できます)。
layout_mode.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “layout: stacked | tabbed | canvas” parameter; the results layout to open in; tabs is accepted as a synonym for tabbed.

name_index.value: name に対する結果セットの 1 から始まるインデックス。
name_index.location: Formatting Directives window → Result names directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<n>” parameter; the 1-based position of the result set that receives the name.

name_text.value: その結果セットのタブに表示するラベル。
name_text.location: Formatting Directives window → Result names directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<text>” parameter; the custom label that appears on that result set's tab in the Results area.

natural_date_overview.value: 平易な言葉で入力した日付の後に書き込まれます (日付比較の後に Ctrl+Shift+Space)。単語を保持し、行末の更新ボタンを使用して日付を再評価できるようにします。
natural_date_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Natural-language date directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “--sqlly date:” directive follows a date typed in plain words (inserted via Ctrl+Shift+Space) and keeps the words so the refresh button at the line end can recompute the date.

natural_date_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Natural-language date directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “--sqlly date:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (plain-words date comments).

number_align.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “align=<left|center|right>” parameter; the horizontal alignment of pivot number cells.

number_decimals.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “decimals=<n>” parameter; how many digits are shown after the decimal point in pivot numbers.

number_parens.value: 負の数値を括弧で囲みます。
number_parens.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “parens=<true|false>” parameter; whether negative pivot numbers are shown in parentheses (accounting style).

number_red.value: 負の数を赤色で表示します。
number_red.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “red=<true|false>” parameter; whether negative pivot numbers are drawn in red.

number_thousands.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “thousands=<true|false>” parameter; whether pivot numbers use thousands separators; short noun phrase.

param_default.value: ストリップのフィールドが空のままの場合に使用されるオプションの値。 SQL NULL の場合は NULL を入力します。
param_default.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “= default” parameter; an optional fallback used when the parameter strip's field is blank; NULL means SQL NULL.

param_name.value: SQL 内に出現する場所 (文字列およびコメントの外側) を置き換えるプレースホルダー。
param_name.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “@name” parameter; the placeholder name replaced throughout the SQL, except inside strings and comments.

param_type.value: text、int、decimal、bool、date、datetime のいずれか。値は実行前に検証されます。
param_type.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<type>” parameter; the value type (text, int, decimal, bool, date, datetime — keep these keywords) checked before Run.

parameters_overview.value: クエリパラメータを宣言します。結果の上にパラメータ ストリップが表示され、そこに各値を入力します。 Run は、それらを入力されたエスケープされたリテラルとして置き換えます。
parameters_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly param:” directive declares a query parameter whose value is typed in a strip above the results and substituted as an escaped literal on Run.

parameters_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly param:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (query parameters typed in a strip above results); plural noun, distinct from the Parameters table section label.

pivot_columns.value: 値がピボット列になる列 (必須)。
pivot_columns.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “column:<col[,col…]>” parameter; required; the column or columns whose distinct values become the pivot table's columns.

pivot_format.value: フィールドごとの数値形式 (以下のオプションを参照)。
pivot_format.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “format:<col>:<opts>” parameter; a number format for one pivot field, pointing to the Pivot number options card for the option list.

pivot_number_overview.value: pivot format: フィールドと valueformat: フィールドで共有されるオプション。
pivot_number_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “format / valueformat options” directive lists options shared by the pivot directive's format: and valueformat: fields; keep those two keywords unchanged.

pivot_number_title.value: ピボット番号のオプション
pivot_number_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “format / valueformat options” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (number options for pivot format fields).

pivot_overview.value: ビューがピボットされるときにピボット テーブルを構成します。
pivot_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly pivot:” directive configures the pivot table used when the result view is pivot.

pivot_result.value: ピボットが属する 1 から始まる結果セット (デフォルトは 1)。
pivot_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result:<n>” parameter; which 1-based result set the pivot settings apply to; defaults to the first.

pivot_rows.value: ピボット行を形成する列 (必須)。
pivot_rows.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “row:<col[,col…]>” parameter; required; the column or columns whose values form the pivot table's rows.

pivot_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly pivot:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (pivot table configuration).

pivot_value.value: 値の列と集計: count、sum、avg、first、max、または min (必須)。
pivot_value.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “value:<col>:<agg>” parameter; required; the measured column plus its aggregate (count, sum, avg, first, max, min — keep these keywords unchanged).

pivot_valueformat.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “valueformat:<opts>” parameter; the number format applied to the aggregated value cells in the pivot body.

result_layout_overview.value: 実行を開く結果レイアウトを選択し、スタックカードの場合は各結果セットに割り当てる行数を選択します。コメントが行全体である場合、スクリプト内のどこでも両方が受け入れられます。最初のレイアウト: が勝ち、その後の行: 同じ結果セットに対して、以前のレイアウトがオーバーライドされます。
result_layout_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly layout: / -- sqlly lines:” directive picks the results layout and the rows each stacked card gets, with rules on which line wins when repeated.

result_layout_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly layout: / -- sqlly lines:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (stacked, tabbed, or canvas results).

result_names_overview.value: 結果セットに名前を付けます。バッチが複数を返す場合に便利です。
result_names_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Result names directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly name” directive gives a result set a custom name, useful when one batch returns several.

result_names_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Result names directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly name” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (labelling result-set tabs).

result_view_overview.value: 結果セットの表示方法を選択します。クエリの空でない最初の行でのみ受け入れられます。
result_view_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Result view directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly view:” directive picks Grid, Pivot, or Chart presentation and only counts on the query's first non-empty line.

result_view_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Result view directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly view:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (Grid, Pivot, or Chart presentation).

variable_name.value: @、$、: を含まない文字/アンダースコア識別子。
variable_name.location: Formatting Directives window → Variables directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<name>” parameter; the variable name rule: letters and underscores, without an @, $, or : prefix.

variable_value.value: テキストはすべての `${name}` プレースホルダーにそのまま貼り付けられます (引用符は付けません)。
variable_value.location: Formatting Directives window → Variables directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “= <value>” parameter; the text inserted unquoted and verbatim wherever ${name} appears; keep the ${name} placeholder as written.

variables_overview.value: このスクリプトのテキスト変数を定義します。文字列とコメントの外側にあるすべての `${name}` は、パラメーターが置換される前、およびクエリが実行される前に、そのまま値に置き換えられます。後で設定された行は、同じ名前の以前の行をオーバーライドします。
variables_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Variables directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly set” directive defines a text variable whose ${name} placeholders are replaced verbatim before parameters and before running, later lines overriding earlier ones.

variables_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Variables directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly set” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (script-wide text variables).

view_chart.value: 「チャート」タブを開きます (--sqlly chart: で構成)。
view_chart.location: Formatting Directives window → Result view directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “chart” parameter; opens the result on the Chart tab, set up by a separate chart directive line.

view_grid.value: 標準の行/列結果グリッド (デフォルト)。
view_grid.location: Formatting Directives window → Result view directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “grid” parameter; the default presentation, the ordinary rows-and-columns results grid.

view_pivot.value: ピボット テーブルとしてレンダリングします (--sqlly pivot: で構成)。
view_pivot.location: Formatting Directives window → Result view directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “pivot” parameter; renders the result as a pivot table set up by a separate pivot directive line.

enter_to_copy_button.value: コピーするには入力してください
enter_to_copy_button.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card → Examples: chip text replacing Copy while an example line has keyboard focus, telling the user to press Enter (or Space) to copy it; very short.

examples_section.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card: small uppercase section label above the list of click-to-copy example directive lines.

filter_placeholder.value: フィルタディレクティブ
filter_placeholder.location: Formatting Directives window → Header: placeholder in the search box at the top right; typing narrows the left list of directive families by title, syntax, parameters, or examples.

header_description.value: 特殊 -- クエリ結果のフォーマット、名前、レイアウト方法を SQLLY に指示する sqlly コメント。
header_description.location: Formatting Directives window → Header: one-line subtitle under the page heading explaining that -- sqlly comments control how SQLLY formats, names, and lays out results.

header_title.value: フォーマットディレクティブ
header_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Header: bold page heading at the top left of the reference window, naming the -- sqlly directive reference; sentence case.

no_matches.value: 「{query}」に一致するディレクティブはありません。
no_matches.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive list: empty-state message in the left list when the filter matches no directive family; {query} is the typed filter text, trimmed and shortened.

parameters_section.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card: small uppercase section label above the table describing each option of the selected directive; shown only when it has options.

syntax_section.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card: small uppercase section label above the monospace block that shows the selected directive's syntax pattern.

window_title.value: SQLLY フォーマットディレクティブ
window_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Title bar: operating-system title bar text of the separate reference window opened from Help → Formatting Directives or by clicking a directive hint popup in the SQL editor.

apply_button.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Footer: primary button that writes the chosen JSON-path, template or number format into the query as a “-- sqlly format:” comment; disabled while the input is invalid.

decimals_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: field label above the small input for how many decimal places the column’s numbers are shown with.

dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog: dialog title, opened by choosing “Custom formatter…” in the column format list; {column} is the result column being formatted.

formatted_preview.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Preview box: second line showing the sample cell value after the selected format is applied; {value} is that formatted text (or a dash when nothing can be shown).

json_path_required.value: JSON パスを入力してください
json_path_required.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: validation message under the preview while the Path input is empty; Apply stays disabled until a path is typed.

json_path_semicolon.value: JSON パスにはセミコロンを含めることはできません
json_path_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: validation message when the typed path contains a semicolon, which the format comment uses as its separator; Apply is disabled.

json_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: first of three toggle buttons, selects formatting a JSON cell by extracting the value at a path.

number_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: third of three toggle buttons, selects number formatting (style, decimals, thousands separators). Noun.

path_help.value: ドットセグメントと[インデックス]のみ。コピーしてエクスポートすると、完全な JSON が保持されます。
path_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: dim help text under the Path input explaining the supported path syntax and that copying or exporting still uses the full JSON.

path_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: field label above the input where the JSON path to extract (e.g. dot segments and [index]) is typed.

preview_help.value: 入力中に更新をプレビューします。適用すると、クエリに --sqlly format: コメントが書き込まれます。
preview_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog: dim intro text at the top of the dialog explaining the live preview and that Apply adds a format comment to the query; keep “-- sqlly format:” untranslated.

raw_preview.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Preview box: first dim line showing the original, unformatted sample cell value; {value} is that raw text, cut to 120 characters.

style_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: field label above the row of number-style buttons (fixed, percent, bytes).

template_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: dim help text under the Template input listing the helper names usable in a template; the helper names and :N/:S suffixes are syntax and stay untranslated.

template_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: field label above the input where a text template using {value} is typed.

template_required.value: テンプレートを入力してください
template_required.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: validation message under the preview while the Template input is empty; Apply stays disabled until text is entered.

template_semicolon.value: テンプレートにセミコロンを含めることはできません
template_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: validation message when the template text contains a semicolon, which the format comment cannot hold; Apply is disabled.

template_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: second of three toggle buttons, selects formatting the cell through a text template. Noun.

thousands_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: checkbox label that turns grouping separators (e.g. 1,234,567) on or off in the formatted numbers.

diagnostic.value: 列 '{column}' は、集計関数にも GROUP BY 句にも含まれていないため、選択リストでは無効です。
diagnostic.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined column: error (warning on MySQL) shown when a selected column is neither aggregated nor in GROUP BY; {column} is that column. Mirrors SQL Server error 8120.

fix_label.value: これを修正します: {columns} を GROUP BY に追加します
fix_label.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an ungrouped column: clickable accent link under the explanation that adds the missing columns to the GROUP BY clause; {columns} is a comma-separated list of names.

accepts_label.location: SQL editor → Signature help card (shown while typing function arguments): short lowercase label before the list of fixed keywords the current argument accepts.

blocking_label.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command: label before the reason the command can block the server or connection, warning before it is run.

column_in_table.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a column: fragment after the column’s type and nullability naming its owning table; {table} is the qualified table name. Lowercase fragment.

deprecated_since.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command → Title line: note after the command group/badges when the command is deprecated; {note} is the existing note, {since} the version it was deprecated in.

example_label.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a built-in function: dim label before the function’s usage example on the same line; keep the trailing space.

more_columns.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a table or view: final dim line after the listed columns when the card shows only some; {count} is how many columns are not listed.

more_forms.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a built-in function: dim line after the first four signatures when the function has more overloads; {count} is how many more call forms exist.

overload_note.location: SQL editor → Signature help card: suffix after the signature when the function has several overloads; {current} is the shown form’s number and {total} the number of forms. Keep the leading spaces.

routine_returns.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a stored procedure or function: dim line after the parameter list giving the routine’s return type; {return_type} is the SQL type. Lowercase fragment.

since.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command: fact fragment giving the server version that introduced the command; {version} is that version number. Lowercase fragment.

system_variable_note.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a system variable (e.g. @@VERSION): dim note on the title line after the variable name identifying what kind of word it is.

clipboard_empty.value: クリップボードには値がありません。
clipboard_empty.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard text contains no values to turn into an IN (…) list.

clipboard_too_large.value: クリップボードのテキストが大きすぎます ({actual_bytes} バイト)。制限は{limit_bytes}です。
clipboard_too_large.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard text exceeds the size limit; {actual_bytes} is its size and {limit_bytes} the maximum, both in bytes.

clipboard_too_many_values.value: 値が多すぎます ({actual_count})。制限は{limit_count}です。
clipboard_too_many_values.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard splits into more values than allowed; {actual_count} is the value count, {limit_count} the maximum.

selection_too_large.value: 選択範囲が大きすぎます ({actual_bytes} バイト)。制限は{limit_bytes}です。
selection_too_large.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Preview: warning shown in place of the preview when the selected text exceeds the size limit; {actual_bytes} is its size, {limit_bytes} the maximum, in bytes.

selection_too_many_values.value: 値が多すぎます ({actual_count})。制限は{limit_count}です。
selection_too_many_values.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Preview: warning shown in place of the preview when the selection splits into more values than allowed; {actual_count} is the count, {limit_count} the maximum.

add_param_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: button that adds a query parameter declaration.

empty_markdown_cell.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Markdown cell: placeholder shown while the cell has no content.

expand_cycle.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when cell dependencies contain a cycle; includes the cell path.

expand_not_select.value: {cell_id} は単一の SELECT ではありません
expand_not_select.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced SQL cell does not contain exactly one SELECT statement.

expand_not_sql.value: {cell_id} は SQL セルではありません
expand_not_sql.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced cell is not a SQL cell.

expand_self_reference.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a cell references itself.

expand_unknown_cell.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced cell does not exist.

export_markdown_button.value: マークダウンのエクスポート
export_markdown_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that exports the notebook as Markdown.

export_jupyter_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that saves a copy of the notebook as a Jupyter .ipynb file that Azure Data Studio, VS Code and Jupyter open; keep “Jupyter” unchanged.

invalid_file.value: 無効なノートブック ファイル: {error}
invalid_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when the notebook file cannot be decoded.

invalid_ipynb_file.value: 無効な Jupyter ノートブック: {error}
invalid_ipynb_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when a Jupyter .ipynb file chosen to open cannot be decoded; {error} is the parser's explanation.

unsupported_ipynb_version.value: Jupyter ノートブック形式 {version} はサポートされていません。まず Jupyter で開いて再保存します (形式 4 以降)。
unsupported_ipynb_version.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when a Jupyter .ipynb file uses an nbformat version older than 4, which SQLly cannot read; {version} is the file's nbformat number.

markdown_done_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Markdown cell editor: button that finishes editing and returns to the rendered view.

newer_version.value: このノートブックは新しい SQLLY によって作成されたため、ここでは開くことができません。
newer_version.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when the file uses a newer notebook format version.

param_name_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: placeholder in the new-parameter name field.

parameters_label.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: heading above the parameter fields.

run_all_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that runs every SQL cell in dependency order.

run_all_completed.value: 実行 すべて完了: {count} セルが実行されました
run_all_completed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: completion status reporting how many cells ran.

run_all_stopped.value: {count} セルが完了した後、すべての実行が {cell_id} で停止しました
run_all_stopped.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: error status identifying the failing cell and how many cells had already completed.

save_as_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that opens the Save As flow for the notebook.

save_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that saves the current notebook.

stop_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: button that stops the remaining queued cells.

unsaved_badge.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: badge shown when the notebook has unsaved changes.

writes_badge.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Cell: badge shown when the SQL cell may modify data.

convert_copy_button.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Footer: secondary button on the left that copies the converted list shown in the preview to the clipboard without changing the editor text.

convert_dialog_title.value: 区切りリストを変換する
convert_dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: title of the dialog opened from Edit → Convert delimited list on the selected text, which reshapes a list of values (delimiters, quotes, wrapping).

convert_replace_button.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Footer: main button that replaces the selected editor text with the converted list from the preview. Verb.

dedupe_label.value: 重複排除 (大文字と小文字を区別)
dedupe_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: checkbox label that removes repeated values from the converted list, treating different letter case as different values.

delimiter_auto.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: first small toggle button, detects how the selected values are separated automatically.

delimiter_comma.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on commas.

delimiter_newline.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text into one value per line.

delimiter_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on semicolons.

delimiter_space.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on spaces.

delimiter_tab.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on tab characters (the Tab key character, not a UI tab).

find_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace: placeholder in the find input.

find_replace_all_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Replace row: small button beside Replace that replaces every match in the editor at once; very short space.

find_replace_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Replace row: small button next to the replacement input that replaces only the current match. Verb; very short space.

find_word_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Find row: small toggle button between “Aa” and “.*” that limits matches to whole words; very short space.

format_dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Column format list: title of the small dialog listing preset formats for a column, opened from the grid column header or editor context menu; {column} is the column name.

goto_line_label.location: SQL editor → Go to line bar (Ctrl+G): label at the top right of the editor before the line-number input; {line_count} is the total number of lines in the query.

input_delimiter_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the row of buttons choosing how the selected text is split into values.

invalid_regex.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar: red error line under the search row when regular-expression mode is on and the pattern does not compile; {error} is the parser’s message.

line_number_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Go to Line: placeholder in the line-number input.

output_delimiter_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for the text placed between values in the converted list.

prefix_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for text added before each value in the converted list.

preview_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the live monospace preview of the converted list. Noun.

quote_double.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: third small toggle button, wraps each value in double quote marks.

quote_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the three buttons choosing which quote marks wrap each value. Noun.

quote_none.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: first small toggle button, leaves values without quote marks.

quote_single.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: second small toggle button, wraps each value in single quote marks (apostrophes).

replace_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace: placeholder in the replace input.

suffix_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for text added after each value in the converted list.

wrap_width_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for the line length at which the converted list wraps; 0 turns wrapping off.

cancel_delete_button.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: button that closes the prompt without deleting the SQL file or folder.

change_folder_menu.value: ライブラリフォルダを変更…
change_folder_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): item that lets the user pick a different disk folder as the SQL library root.

delete_button.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: destructive button that permanently deletes the file or folder from disk. Verb.

delete_confirm.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: warning heading after choosing Delete on an item; {name} is the file or folder name.

delete_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: item that asks for confirmation and then deletes it from disk. Verb.

delete_warning.value: これを元に戻すことはできません。
delete_warning.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: detail line under the heading warning that the deletion is permanent.

empty.value: SQL ファイルはまだありません。ライブラリに保存するか、.sql ファイルを {path} にドロップします
empty.location: Sidebar → Library: empty-state message when the library folder has no SQL files; {path} is the library folder on disk.

filter_placeholder.value: フィルターライブラリ…
filter_placeholder.location: Sidebar → Library → Header filter: placeholder in the search input that narrows the library tree by file name.

name_placeholder.location: Sidebar → Library: placeholder in the inline input that appears in the tree when creating a new folder or renaming a file or folder.

open_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file: first item, opens the SQL file in a query tab (not shown for folders). Verb.

refresh_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): first item, rescans the library folder on disk to pick up added, removed or renamed files. Verb.

rename_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: item that turns the row into an inline name input to rename it on disk. Verb.

reveal_finder_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): item that opens the library root folder in the system file manager (Finder on macOS).

reveal_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: last item, shows the item selected in the system file manager. Verb.

chart_invalid.value: {error} (期待される `-- sqlly chart: kind:<bar|line|area|scatter|histogram|pie|donut>[; label:<col>][; value:<cols>]`)。
chart_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly chart:” comment cannot be parsed; {error} is the specific parse error, followed by the expected syntax. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

computed_column_invalid.value: この計算列は無視されます — {error} (予期される `-- sqlly 列: <名前> = <Excel 式>`、列の書き込みは !Name、前の行は !Name[1]、固定行は !Name[$1])。
computed_column_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly column:” computed-column formula cannot be parsed, so the column is dropped; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

conditional_invalid.value: この条件ディレクティブは無視されます — {error} (期待される `-- sqlly 条件: column=<name>; when=<test>; text=#RRGGBB; fill=#RRGGBB;大胆`、または `scale=#RRGGBB..#RRGGBB`、または `bar=#RRGGBB`)。
conditional_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly conditional:” grid colouring rule cannot be parsed and is ignored; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

focus_invalid.value: このフォーカス ディレクティブは無視されます。1 から始まる結果セット番号 (`-- sqlly focus: 2`) が期待されます。
focus_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly focus:” comment does not give a valid result set number, so the result-tab focus is ignored. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

format_invalid.value: この形式ディレクティブは無視されます。期待される `-- sqlly 形式: column=<name>; <format>` (ヘルプ ▸ フォーマットディレクティブを参照)。
format_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly format:” column format comment has the right prefix but an unparseable body; points to the Help menu reference. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

format_spacing.value: この形式ディレクティブは無視されます。正確なスペル `-- sqlly format:` (`--` の後にスペースが必要です) が必要です。
format_spacing.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a format comment is written “--sqlly format” without the space after the two dashes, so it is not applied. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

grid_invalid.value: このグリッド ディレクティブは無視されます — {error} (期待される `-- sqlly Grid [<n>]: order=<cols>; Hide=<cols>;freeze=<n>; sort=<col> [desc]; group=<col>; filter=<col> <op> <value>; label=<col>:<column|off>`)。
grid_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly grid:” layout comment (column order, hide, freeze, sort, filter) cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

lines_invalid.value: この行ディレクティブは無視されます。1 から {maximum} までの行数が期待されます (`-- sqlly 行: 10` または `-- sqlly 行 2: 10`)。
lines_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly lines:” comment is not a row count in range; {maximum} is the largest allowed number of visible rows. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

not_first_line.value: このディレクティブはここでは無視されます。クエリの空でない最初の行でのみ受け入れられます。
not_first_line.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a view or canvas directive appears below the first non-empty line of the query, where it has no effect.

not_standalone.value: このディレクティブはここでは無視されます。コメントが行全体である場合にのみ適用されます。
not_standalone.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a directive is written after SQL code on the same line instead of on a line of its own, so it has no effect.

param_invalid.value: この param ディレクティブは無視されます — {error} (期待される `-- sqlly param: @name <type> [=default]`)。
param_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly param:” query parameter declaration cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

set_invalid.value: この set ディレクティブは無視されます — {error} (期待される `-- sqlly set <name> = <value>`)。
set_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly set” value assignment cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

unknown_layout.value: 不明なレイアウト — 予期される `-- sqlly レイアウト: スタック`、`-- sqlly レイアウト: タブ付き`、または `-- sqlly レイアウト: キャンバス`。
unknown_layout.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly layout:” comment names a result layout other than stacked, tabbed or canvas. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

unknown_view.value: 不明なビュー — 予期される `-- sqlly view:grid`、`-- sqlly view: pivot`、`-- sqlly view: chart`、または `-- sqlly view:map`。
unknown_view.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly view:” comment names a result view other than grid, pivot or chart. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

unrecognized.value: 認識される SQLLY ディレクティブではありません。サポートされているフォームについては、「ヘルプ」▸「ディレクティブのフォーマット」を参照してください。
unrecognized.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a comment starts with the SQLLY directive prefix but matches no known directive; points to the Help menu reference.

action_enabled_label.value: エクスプローラーの右クリック メニューに表示 (カスタム アクション)
action_enabled_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: checkbox label below the template body; when ticked, the saved template also appears as an action under Custom Actions in the database explorer’s right-click menu.

action_run_label.value: すぐに実行します (デフォルト: 確認のためにクエリ タブで開きます。読み取り専用 SQL 以外のものが最初に要求されます)。
action_run_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: checkbox label shown once the explorer-action box is ticked; when ticked the action runs the SQL at once instead of opening it in a query tab, and non-read-only SQL still asks for confirmation first.

body_help.value: 本文 — <name,type,default> のようなプレースホルダーは、保存時にパラメーターになります。エクスプローラー アクションは、最初に値を要求し、デフォルト値が事前に入力されます。 {server}、{database}、{schema}、{object} は引用符で囲まれた識別子としてクリックされたオブジェクトから入力され、{kind} はその種類の単語として入力されます。引用符で囲まれた文字列リテラル ({object:literal}) の場合は :literal を追加し、裸のテキスト (エスケープされていない {object:raw}) の場合は :raw を追加します。
body_help.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: help paragraph above the template body text area explaining <name,type,default> parameters and the {server}/{database}/{schema}/{object}/{kind} tokens; keep the brace tokens and :literal/:raw suffixes untranslated.

body_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: example SQL shown greyed in the empty template body text area, illustrating the <name,type,default> parameter syntax; it is SQL code and should normally stay as is.

cancel_edit_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: footer button shown while creating or editing a user template; discards the form and returns to browsing templates without saving.

catalog_read_failed.value: ユーザー テンプレート カタログを読み取れませんでした: {error}
catalog_read_failed.location: Template Explorer and explorer Custom Actions → Template catalog load error: error shown when the saved user-template file exists but cannot be parsed (for example it is corrupt); {error} is the technical parse error.

category_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: short field label to the left of the Category input, the second field after Name.

category_placeholder.value: カテゴリ (空 → マイ テンプレート)
category_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: greyed hint inside the empty Category input explaining that a template with no category is filed under the “My Templates” group in the list.

delete_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: footer button at the far left, shown only when a user-created template is selected; permanently removes that template (built-in templates cannot be deleted).

description_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: short field label to the left of the Description input, the third field after Name and Category.

description_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: greyed hint inside the empty Description input where the user types an optional one-line explanation of the template.

dialog_title.value: テンプレートエクスプローラー
dialog_title.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer: title of the dialog for browsing SSMS-style SQL script templates, filling in their parameters and inserting the result into a query tab. Product feature name.

edit_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: footer button at the far left, shown only when a user-created template is selected; opens that template in the inline edit form.

filter_placeholder.value: フィルターテンプレート
filter_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: greyed hint inside the search box at the top right of the dialog; typing narrows the template list on the left.

insert_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: primary footer button, enabled once a template is selected; puts the rendered SQL from the preview into a new query editor tab and closes the dialog (nothing is executed).
