send_reasoning_effort.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: checkbox label shown only for OpenAI-compatible profiles; when on, the chosen reasoning level is sent as the “reasoning_effort” request parameter. Keep “reasoning_effort” untranslated.

show_ai_query_summary_bar.value: AIクエリの概要バーを表示する
show_ai_query_summary_bar.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: checkbox label that turns on the bar above query results showing a plain-language AI summary of the tab's SQL.

use_local_agent_cli.value: エージェントモードでは、ローカルなコーディングエージェントCLIを使用します
use_local_agent_cli.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: checkbox label at the top of the pane; when on, the AI drawer's Agent mode runs a locally installed coding-agent CLI (Claude Code or Codex) instead of the built-in agent.

deepseek_reasoning.value: 推論深度は、このプロバイダーのモデルIDによって選択されます。上のレベルは無視されます。
deepseek_reasoning.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the Reasoning dropdown, shown only for DeepSeek profiles, explaining the chosen reasoning level is ignored because the model id decides reasoning depth.

cloud.location: Settings → AI → Cloud and AI playground: short cloud-egress badge for a remote provider.

cloud_detail.value: クラウド — プロンプトとスキーマの抜粋を{host}に送信します。
cloud_detail.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Privacy: remote-provider egress explanation including the destination host.

local.location: Settings → AI → Cloud and AI playground: short local-egress badge for a provider hosted on this machine.

local_detail.value: ローカル — {host}; プロンプトとスキーマはこのマシンに残ります。
local_detail.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Privacy: local-provider egress explanation including the provider host.

api_key_rejected.value: {provider_name}はAPIキーを拒否しました。キーを確認し、もう一度お試しください。
api_key_rejected.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider answers HTTP 401 or 403; {provider_name} is the profile name.

browser_unavailable.value: クラウドAIは利用できません
browser_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details (browser build): clause saying cloud AI providers are unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown as the provider error.

http_status.value: {provider_name}はHTTP {status_code}を返しました。プロバイダーのステータスを確認し、もう一度お試しください。
http_status.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider answers with any other failing HTTP status; {provider_name} is the profile name, {status_code} the numeric HTTP code.

invalid_response.value: {provider_name}は予期せぬモデルリストを返しました。SQLLYは保存されたモデルを更新しませんでした。
invalid_response.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider's model list cannot be read or its endpoint URL is unusable; saved models are left unchanged. {provider_name} is the profile name.

network.value: モデルプロバイダーに接続できませんでした。インターネット接続を確認し、もう一度お試しください。
network.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models or Test latency when the provider's server cannot be reached at all (no connection, DNS failure, timeout).

rate_limited.value: {provider_name}はレート制限付きのリクエストです。しばらくお待ちいただき、もう一度お試しください。
rate_limited.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider answers HTTP 429 (too many requests); {provider_name} is the profile name.

openai_compatible_reasoning.value: チェックボックスがオンになっている場合にのみ、reasoning_effortとして送信されます。
openai_compatible_reasoning.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the Reasoning dropdown, shown only for OpenAI-compatible profiles, saying the level is sent only while the “Send reasoning_effort” checkbox is on.

app_store_unavailable.value: Mac App Store版では、ローカルコーディングエージェントのコマンドラインツールを起動できません。エージェントモードは、クラウドAIプロバイダーまたはローカルOllamaサーバーで引き続き機能します。
app_store_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: notice that replaces the whole pane in the Mac App Store edition, explaining that sandboxing blocks launching local CLI tools while Agent mode still works with cloud or Ollama.

browser_unavailable_health.value: ローカル コーディング エージェント CLI は使用できません
browser_unavailable_health.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Health check (browser build): clause inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown as the failed health-check detail.

browser_unavailable_status.value: ローカル コーディング エージェント CLI は使用できません
browser_unavailable_status.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Detect (browser build): clause inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown in the pane's status line after detection is attempted.

invalid_environment_on_parse.value: 解析中に無効な環境行: `{line}`。
invalid_environment_on_parse.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Extra environment: error produced when SQLLY reads the saved extra environment to start an Agent-mode run and finds a line without “=”; {line} is the offending line.

invalid_environment_on_save.value: 保存時に環境行が無効です: `{line}`。
invalid_environment_on_save.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Extra environment: error produced when the edited extra environment text is stored and a line has no “=” (KEY=VALUE expected); {line} is the offending line.

invalid_stored_environment.value: 保存された設定の環境行が無効です: `{line}`。
invalid_stored_environment.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: status error shown after pressing Save when the previously stored extra environment contains a line without “=”; {line} is the offending line.

executable_not_found.value: PATH で見つかりません — 手動でパスを入力してください
executable_not_found.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: warning notification shown when automatic executable detection finds no CLI on PATH.

check.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: Check button that tests the local runtime connection.

check_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: Check button that tests the decision-model connection.

decision_model_unavailable.value: この意思決定モデルは利用できません。
decision_model_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: feature name inserted into the browser-preview “unavailable” message shown when Test is pressed in the browser build, where no decision-model client exists.

fetch_models.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button below the Model field that downloads the provider's list of available models into the model dropdown.

fetching.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: label the Fetch models button shows while the provider's model list is being downloaded.

local_runtime.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend: first option in the backend dropdown, meaning Ask, Generate and schema cards keep using the local Ollama runtime instead of a cloud profile.

saved_to_your_keychain.value: キーチェーンに保存されました。
saved_to_your_keychain.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Provider profile → API key: status shown after saving the provider key in the OS keyring.

saved_to_your_keychain_2.value: キーチェーンに保存されました。
saved_to_your_keychain_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key: status shown after saving the decision-model key in the OS keyring.

test.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection section: button that sends one sample yes/no question to the decision model and reports the round-trip time or error.

test_latency.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button beside Fetch models that times a request to the selected provider and shows the result in milliseconds.

testing.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: status shown while testing the local runtime connection.

testing_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: status shown while testing the decision-model connection.

auto_match_model.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format: option in the Format dropdown that automatically uses the prompt format matching the selected autocomplete model.

automatically_as_type.value: 入力するたびに自動的に
automatically_as_type.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger: option in the Trigger dropdown that requests inline completions automatically after typing pauses.

browser_unavailable.value: AIの完了は利用できません。
browser_unavailable.location: Query editor → AI inline autocomplete (browser build): clause saying fill-in-the-middle AI completion is unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice reported as the completion error.

custom_tokens_pattern.value: カスタム（パターン内のトークン）
custom_tokens_pattern.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format: option in the Format dropdown for using the user's own fill-in-the-middle tokens written in the pattern template.

only_i_press_key.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger: option in the Trigger dropdown that requests inline completions only when the user presses the trigger shortcut.

enable_autocomplete.value: 自動コンプリテンートを有効にする
enable_autocomplete.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Enable section: checkbox label that turns AI inline (fill-in-the-middle) autocomplete in the SQL editor on or off.

enable_new_queries_by_default.value: デフォルトで新しいクエリを有効にする
enable_new_queries_by_default.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Enable section: checkbox label that makes AI inline autocomplete start switched on in every newly opened query tab.

stop_newline.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: checkbox label; when on, an inline suggestion stops at the end of the current line instead of spanning several lines.

trim_leading_whitespace.value: 先頭の空白をトリムする
trim_leading_whitespace.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: checkbox label; when on, spaces and tabs at the start of an inline suggestion are removed before it is shown.

autocomplete_fim.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): title at the top of the pane for AI inline autocomplete settings; FIM means fill-in-the-middle and can stay as an abbreviation.

coding_agent_cli.value: コーディングエージェントCLI
coding_agent_cli.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: pane title shown in the Mac App Store edition, above the notice that local coding-agent CLIs cannot be launched.

coding_agent_cli_2.value: コーディングエージェントCLI
coding_agent_cli_2.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: pane title shown in editions that can launch local programs, above the intro and the CLI agent settings.

decision_model.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: title at the top of the pane for the optional fast decision-model provider used for quick typed judgments.

device.location: Settings → AI → On device: title at the top of the pane for on-device AI (query summaries, Agent mode limits and the local Ollama runtime).

providers.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: title at the top of the pane that lists cloud and self-hosted AI provider profiles.

agent_read_only_safeguards.value: エージェント照会は2回読み取り専用で読み込まれます。SQLLYはそれぞれがSELECTであることを確認し、データベースは常にロールバックされる読み取り専用トランザクションで実行します（SQLiteではクエリ専用、SQL Serverではロールバックされたトランザクションとステートメント画面が追加されます。読み取り専用トランザクションがないため）。
agent_read_only_safeguards.location: Settings → AI → On device → Agent mode section: help text under Max agent turns explaining the two safeguards that keep the AI agent's database lookups read-only, with per-engine caveats.

app_backend_help.value: ルートは、ローカル実行時に代わりに選択されたプロファイルのモデルを介して、スキーマカードキャッシュを要求、生成します。このパスは、プロファイルがクラウドホストされているときに、このマシンからプロンプト、スキーマ抜粋、MCPツール名の簡単なリストを送信します。クエリ概要、AIレビュー、インライン自動コンプリテンートは、ローカルOllamaに残ります。適用するには、SQLLYを再起動します。
app_backend_help.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend section: help text above the backend dropdown explaining what using a profile for Ask, Generate and schema cards changes and what data leaves the machine.

base_url_help.value: OpenAI互換のURLには/v1が含まれますが、AnthropicとGeminiのベースURLには含まれていません。
base_url_help.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the Base URL field explaining when the URL should end in “/v1”.

choose_new_profile_kind.value: 新しいプロファイルにプロバイダーの種類を選択してください。
choose_new_profile_kind.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: prompt shown after pressing “+ Add profile”, above the dropdown of provider kinds; picking one creates the new profile. Ends with a colon.

cloud_key_not_saved.value: まだ保存されていません。キーを入力して「キーを保存」を選択してください。
cloud_key_not_saved.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the API key field, shown while the selected profile has no key stored in the Keychain yet.

contacting_local_ai_runtime.value: ローカルAI実行環境に連絡しています...
contacting_local_ai_runtime.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: progress text shown under the Check button while SQLLY contacts the local Ollama runtime.

drawer_tool_round_limit.value: AIドローアームが停止する前に、読み取り専用ツールラウンドを何回実行できるか（5〜100回）。
drawer_tool_round_limit.location: Settings → AI → On device → Agent mode section: help text under the Max agent turns field; the allowed range is 5 to 100.

fim_model_size_tradeoff.value: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5Bベースは高速ですが、Qwen2.5-Coder-3Bベースはより正確です。
fim_model_size_tradeoff.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Model section: help text under the autocomplete Model dropdown comparing the speed and accuracy of the two suggested models; model names stay untranslated.

format_auto_custom.value: 自動で選択したモデルに一致するフォーマットが選択されます。カスタムを選択すると、パターンに独自のトークンを埋め込むことができます。
format_auto_custom.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format: help text under the Format dropdown explaining the Auto and Custom options.

generation_delay_help.value: 自動完了を要求する前に、タイピングをどれくらい一時停止する必要がありますか。
generation_delay_help.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger section: help text under the Generation delay (s) field.

install_ollama_help.value: ollama.comからOllamaをインストールし、起動します（アプリを起動するか、`ollama serve`を実行します）、そしてもう一度確認します。
install_ollama_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: help text shown under the red error after Check fails to reach the runtime, explaining how to install and start Ollama. Keep “ollama serve” untranslated.

key_not_saved.value: まだ保存されていません。キーを入力して「キーを保存」を選択してください。
key_not_saved.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: help text under the API key field, shown while the decision-model key is being entered or not yet stored.

pinned_model_help.value: モデルIDは固定されているため、回答は安定しています。プロバイダーが新しいバージョンを文書化する場合にのみ変更してください。
pinned_model_help.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Endpoint section: help text under the Model field advising not to change the pinned model id.

runtime_check_help.value: チェックでは、実行時間がアクセス可能であることを検証し、インストールされているモデルをリストアップします。
runtime_check_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: help text under the Check button, shown before any check runs, explaining what Check does.

runtime_no_models.value: アクセス可能ですが、モデルがインストールされていません。`ollama pull <model>`で1つインストールし、もう一度確認してください。
runtime_no_models.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: help text shown after Check succeeds but the runtime has no models; keep the command untranslated.

shortcuts_help.value: 「キーボードショートカット」パネルでトリガーと受信キーを設定します。
shortcuts_help.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Shortcuts section: help text pointing to the Keyboard Shortcuts pane for the autocomplete trigger and accept keys.

suffix_budget_help.value: カーソル後のテキスト用に予約されたコンテキストウィンドウの割合。
suffix_budget_help.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: help text under the Suffix budget (0–1) field.

summary_bar_help.value: 各クエリタブのSQLを、ローカルAI実行時に生成され、結果の上部にあるバーに表示される、簡単な言葉で要約します。デフォルトではオフです。また、エディタ▸一般の下にもあります。
summary_bar_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: help text under the “Show the AI query summary bar” checkbox; “Editor ▸ General” names another Settings pane.

summary_model_help.value: アプリのデフォルトの要約モデルを使用するには空白のままにしてください。または、ローカル実行時にインストールされているモデルの名前を入力してください（以下のリストを参照してください）。
summary_model_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: help text under the summary Model field.

generation_delay_s.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger section: label beside the number field for the pause, in seconds, before an automatic completion is requested.

max_context_tokens.value: 最大コンテキストトークン
max_context_tokens.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the number field for how many tokens of surrounding editor text are sent to the model.

max_new_tokens.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the number field limiting how many tokens one inline suggestion may contain.

suffix_budget_0_1.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the field for the fraction (0 to 1) of the context reserved for text after the cursor.

temperature.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the field for the sampling temperature (randomness) of inline suggestions; use the usual AI term.

autocomplete.value: 中間埋め込み式インライン完了は、このマシンでOllamaと通信します。エディタテキストは決してコンピュータから離れません。モデル、プロンプト形式、トリガー動作、および生成パラメータ。変更は、環境設定を閉じると有効になります。
autocomplete.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining that inline autocomplete runs on local Ollama and when changes apply.

coding_agent_cli.value: ベンダーのクラウドと通信するローカルCLIを実行します。SQLLYは決してCLIにデータベースの認証情報を渡しません。SQLLYはMCPサーバーを介してのみ読み書きを行い、すべての書き込みには依然として確認が必要です。
coding_agent_cli.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining how the local CLI is sandboxed from database credentials.

decision_model.value: 決定モデルは、小さなタイピングされた質問（Nのいずれかを選択するか、スケールで評価するか、イエスまたはノー）を数秒以内に回答します。高速なループ内判断が必要な機能は、有効になっているときにそれを使用し、無効になっている場合はApp AIバックエンドに切り替えます。テキストを生成することはできず、SQLを書くには決して使用されません。
decision_model.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining what a decision model does and that it never writes SQL.

on_device.value: このページのクエリ概要は、このマシン上のローカルOllama実行時に対話します。そのSQLは決してコンピュータから離れません。スキーマの質問、生成、およびスキーマカードキャッシュは、クラウドページのApp AIバックエンドに従います。
on_device.location: Settings → AI → On device: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining which AI features on this page stay local.

providers.value: 各プロファイルには、プロバイダー、エンドポイント、モデル、および推論レベルが指定されます。 API キーはプラットフォームキーリングに保存され、設定ファイルには保存されません。各プロファイルの下のラベルには、プロンプトとスキーマの抜粋が正確にどこに保存されるかが記載されています。
providers.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: introductory paragraph under the Providers title explaining what a provider profile holds and where API keys are kept.

api_key.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the read-only “Saved to your Keychain” value, shown when the selected profile already has a stored key.

api_key_2.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the text field for typing a new API key for the selected profile.

api_key_3.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: row label beside the read-only “Saved to your Keychain” value, shown when a decision-model key is stored.

api_key_4.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: row label beside the text field for typing the decision-model API key.

base_url.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the text field for the selected provider profile's base URL.

base_url_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Endpoint section: row label beside the text field for the decision-model service's base URL.

endpoint.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: row label beside the read-only address of the local Ollama runtime.

executable.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: row label beside the text field for the path to the coding-agent CLI program; the Detect button below fills it in.

extra_arguments.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: row label beside the text field for additional command-line arguments passed to the coding-agent CLI.

extra_environment.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: row label beside the field for extra environment variables given to the CLI, one KEY=VALUE pair per line; keep “KEY=VALUE” as is.

format.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format section: row label beside the dropdown choosing the fill-in-the-middle prompt format.

kind.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the read-only provider type of the selected profile (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).

max_agent_turns.value: マックスエージェントのターン
max_agent_turns.location: Settings → AI → On device → Agent mode section: row label beside the number field limiting the built-in AI drawer agent's read-only tool rounds.

max_turns.value: マックスは回転します
max_turns.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: row label beside the number field limiting how many turns the coding-agent CLI may take in one run.

model.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: row label beside the text field naming the local model used for query summaries.

model_2.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Model section: row label beside the dropdown choosing the local autocomplete model.

model_3.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the model dropdown and text field for the selected provider profile's model id.

model_4.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Endpoint section: row label beside the text field for the pinned decision-model model id.

name.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the text field for the selected provider profile's display name.

reasoning.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the dropdown choosing the reasoning level (Off, Low, Medium, High) for the selected profile.

thinking_budget_tokens.value: 予算を考える（トークン）
thinking_budget_tokens.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: row label beside the number field for the maximum thinking tokens, shown only for Gemini and Anthropic-compatible profiles.

timeout_minutes.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: row label beside the number field for how many minutes a coding-agent CLI run may last before being stopped.

trigger.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger section: row label beside the dropdown choosing whether completions appear automatically or only on a key press.

answered_ms.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection section: status shown under the Test button after the decision model answers; {value} is the round-trip time in milliseconds.

app_ai_backend_after_restart.value: App AIは次の再起動後に{name}を使用します。
app_ai_backend_after_restart.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend: status shown after a profile is picked in the backend dropdown; {name} is the profile name, which takes effect after restarting SQLLY.

could_not_read_key_e.value: キーを読み込めませんでした：{e}
could_not_read_key_e.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Provider profile → API key: error shown when the provider key cannot be read from the OS keyring.

could_not_read_key_e_2.value: キーを読み込めませんでした：{e}
could_not_read_key_e_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key: error shown when the decision-model key cannot be read from the OS keyring.

could_not_read_key_e_3.value: キーを読み込めませんでした：{e}
could_not_read_key_e_3.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend → API key: error shown when the backend key cannot be read from the OS keyring.

could_not_remove_key_e.value: キーを削除できませんでした：{e}
could_not_remove_key_e.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: status error shown when Remove key fails to delete the decision-model key from the Keychain; {e} is the system error.

could_not_remove_key_e_2.value: {name}キーを削除できませんでした：{e}
could_not_remove_key_e_2.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown when Remove key fails to delete a profile's key from the Keychain; {name} is the profile name, {e} the system error.

could_not_save_key_keychain_e.value: キーチェーンにキーを保存できませんでした: {e}
could_not_save_key_keychain_e.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: status error shown when Save key fails to store the decision-model key in the Keychain; {e} is the system error.

could_not_save_profiles_error.value: プロファイルを保存できませんでした：{error}
could_not_save_profiles_error.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Provider profiles → Save: error shown when provider profiles cannot be saved.

fetching_models_from.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: progress status shown after pressing Fetch models while the list downloads; {name} is the provider profile name.

key_removed_from_keychain.value: {name}キーがキーチェーンから取り外されました。
key_removed_from_keychain.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status confirmation after Remove key deletes a profile's API key from the Keychain; {name} is the profile name.

key_saved_keychain.value: {name}キーがキーチェーンに保存されました。
key_saved_keychain.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status confirmation after Save key stores a profile's API key in the Keychain; {name} is the profile name.

models_found.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status shown after Fetch models succeeds; {value} is the number of models, {provider_name} the profile name.

ms_host.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: result line under the Fetch models and Test latency buttons after a latency test; {value} is milliseconds, {host} the provider's host name.

privacy_egress_note.value: 質問、スキーマ名、およびSQLテキストは{host}に送信されます。結果データは、許可した場合のみ送信されます。
privacy_egress_note.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Privacy section: note under the “Allow result data to be sent” checkbox saying what is sent; {host} is the decision-model service host.

remove_profile_save_failed.value: プロファイルを保存できませんでした：{error}
remove_profile_save_failed.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend → Save: error shown when the selected backend profiles cannot be saved.

removed.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: status confirmation shown after Remove profile deletes a provider profile; {name} is the removed profile's name.

save_app_ai_backend_failed.value: アプリのAIバックエンドを保存できませんでした：{error}
save_app_ai_backend_failed.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend: status error shown when the backend chosen in the dropdown cannot be written to the settings file; {error} is the system error.

save_profile_key_failed.value: {name} キーをキーチェーンに保存できませんでした。{e}
save_profile_key_failed.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown when Save key fails to store a profile's key in the Keychain; {name} is the profile name, {e} the system error.

testing_decision_model.value: {host}での意思決定モデルのテスト...
testing_decision_model.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection section: progress status shown after pressing Test while waiting for an answer; {host} is the service host name.

testing_latency.value: {name}への遅延をテストしています...
testing_latency.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: progress status shown after pressing Test latency while timing the request; {name} is the provider profile name.

unreachable_error.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: red warning shown after Check cannot reach the local Ollama runtime; {error} is the technical error.

app_ai_stays_local_runtime.value: App AIはローカル実行時に残ります。
app_ai_stays_local_runtime.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend: status confirmation shown after choosing “Local runtime” in the backend dropdown, meaning App AI keeps using local Ollama.

high.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: “High” option in the Reasoning dropdown, the deepest reasoning level for the selected profile.

low.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: “Low” option in the Reasoning dropdown, a light reasoning level for the selected profile.

medium.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: “Medium” option in the Reasoning dropdown, a moderate reasoning level for the selected profile.

off.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: “Off” option in the Reasoning dropdown, meaning no extra reasoning is requested from the model.

add_profile.value: + プロフィールを追加する
add_profile.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: button under the provider profile list that shows a provider-kind dropdown for creating a new profile; the “+” is a plus sign.

cancel.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button beside Save key, shown while replacing an already stored key; discards the typed key and keeps the saved one.

detect.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: button below the Executable field that searches the system for the selected CLI (Claude Code or Codex) and fills in its path.

remove_key.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button beside Replace key that deletes the selected profile's stored API key from the Keychain.

remove_key_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: button beside Replace key that deletes the stored decision-model API key from the Keychain.

remove_profile.value: プロフィールを削除する
remove_profile.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button at the bottom of the details that deletes the selected provider profile and its stored key.

replace_key.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button shown when a profile key is already stored; opens an empty field to type a new key.

replace_key_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: button shown when a decision-model key is stored; opens an empty field to type a new key.

save.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: button at the bottom of the pane that saves the coding-agent CLI settings.

save_key.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button shown once text is typed in the API key field; stores the key in the system Keychain for the selected profile.

save_key_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key: button beside the key input, shown only once something is typed, that stores the decision model’s API key in the system Keychain.

plural.value: アクセス可能 — {count} がインストールされているモデル：{models}
plural.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: status line after a successful check when the local Ollama runtime answers with two or more models; {count} is the model count, {models} a comma-separated list of model names.

single.value: アクセス可能 — {count} インストールされたモデル: {models}
single.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: status line after a successful check when the local Ollama runtime answers with exactly one installed model; {count} is 1, {models} is that model’s name.

agent_mode.location: Settings → AI → On device: section heading above the maximum-agent-turns field that limits how many read-only lookup rounds the AI drawer’s agent may run.

api_key.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: section heading above the API key field and its Save key / Replace key / Remove key buttons for the decision model provider.

app_ai_backend.location: Settings → AI → Cloud (Providers pane): section heading above the dropdown that chooses which cloud profile, or local, powers the app’s AI features such as Ask and Generate.

connection.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: section heading above the Test button that sends a sample question to the decision model and reports latency or an error.

enable.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): first section heading, above the checkboxes that turn inline AI autocomplete on and enable it for new query tabs by default.

enable_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: first section heading, above the single checkbox that turns the optional decision model on or off.

endpoint.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: section heading above the base URL and model ID fields that say where the decision model provider is reached.

generation.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): section heading above the numeric fields that tune completion generation: max context tokens, max new tokens, suffix budget and temperature.

local_ai_runtime.location: Settings → AI → On device: section heading above the read-only endpoint of the local Ollama runtime and the button that checks whether it is reachable.

model.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): section heading above the dropdown that picks which local code model produces inline completions.

privacy.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: section heading above the checkbox that controls whether result-row data may be sent to the decision model provider.

profile_details.location: Settings → AI → Cloud (Providers pane): section heading above the name, kind, base URL, API key and model fields of the cloud AI profile selected in the list.

prompt_format.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): section heading above the dropdown choosing the fill-in-the-middle prompt template sent to the model (Auto or a specific format).

query_summaries.location: Settings → AI → On device: first section heading, above the checkbox that shows the AI query summary bar and the model used for summaries.

shortcuts.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): section heading above a note explaining that the trigger and accept keys are set in the Keyboard Shortcuts pane.

trigger.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): section heading above the dropdown choosing when inline completions are requested and the generation delay field (typing pause before an automatic completion).

checking.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: status shown while checking local runtime availability.

checking_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: status shown while checking decision-model availability.

checking_3.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Provider profile → Connection: status shown while checking provider availability.

decision_test_needs_key.value: APIキーを入力し、最初にキーを保存を選択します。
decision_test_needs_key.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: status line shown when Test is pressed but no API key is typed or saved; tells the user to enter a key and press the Save key button first.

enter_an_api_key_first.value: まずAPIキーを入力してください。
enter_an_api_key_first.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Provider profile → API key: validation shown when a provider operation requires an API key.

enter_an_api_key_first_2.value: まずAPIキーを入力してください。
enter_an_api_key_first_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key: validation shown when a decision-model operation requires an API key.

executable_path_updated.value: 実行可能なパスを更新しました。
executable_path_updated.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: status line shown after the Detect button finds the selected coding agent’s program and fills it into the Executable field.

fetch_models_needs_key.value: APIキーを入力し、最初にキーを保存を選択します。
fetch_models_needs_key.location: Settings → AI → Cloud (Providers pane): status line shown when Fetch models is pressed for a provider profile that needs an API key but has none typed or saved.

key_removed.value: キーチェーンから決定モデルのキーが削除されました。
key_removed.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: status line under the Test button, shown after Remove key succeeds, confirming the stored API key was deleted from the macOS Keychain.

key_saved.value: キーチェーンに保存された決定モデルのキー。
key_saved.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: status line under the Test button, shown after Save key succeeds, confirming the typed API key was stored in the macOS Keychain.

latency_test_needs_key.value: APIキーを入力し、最初にキーを保存を選択します。
latency_test_needs_key.location: Settings → AI → Cloud (Providers pane): status line shown when Test latency is pressed for a provider profile that needs an API key but has none typed or saved.

profile_added.value: プロフィールが追加されました。
profile_added.location: Settings → AI → Cloud (Providers pane): status line shown after Add profile creates a new cloud AI provider profile and selects it for editing.

saved.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: short status line shown after the Save button stores the coding agent settings (executable, arguments, turns, timeout).

active_profile_no_model.value: このプロファイルにはモデルが選択されていません。モデルを選択するまで、アプリはローカルのままです。
active_profile_no_model.location: Settings → AI → Cloud (Providers pane) → App AI backend: warning under the backend dropdown when the chosen cloud profile has no model set, so AI features keep running locally.

keep_love_message_paid.value: 支払った後、「I love SQLly」メッセージを残してください。
keep_love_message_paid.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Free tier: checkbox label; when on, the small “I love SQLly” supporter chip in the status bar keeps showing after the user buys a license.

show_tips_startup.value: 起動に関するヒントを表示する
show_tips_startup.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Startup: checkbox label that controls whether the Tip of the Day window opens automatically each time the app starts.

display.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: title at the top of the pane holding interface, code and results font choices plus free-tier and startup options.

themes.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes: title at the top of the pane where the user picks Light/Dark/System mode and the light and dark color palettes.

interface_font_scope.value: UIクローム（メニュー、タブ、ツリー、ステータス）。デフォルトはシステムサンです。
interface_font_scope.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Interface Font: help text under the heading listing where the interface font is used (menus, tabs, tree, status bar) and that the default is the system sans-serif.

love_message_free_tier.value: 無料ティアに登録している間、このメッセージは単独で表示されます。ライセンスを購入すると、オフになります。これをオンにしておくと、保持できます。
love_message_free_tier.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Free tier: help text under the “I love SQLly” checkbox explaining the supporter chip shows automatically while unlicensed and turns off after purchase unless kept.

results_font_scope.value: 結果グリッドセルとヘッダー、ピボットテーブル、およびチャート。デフォルトはプラットフォームのモノスペースです。
results_font_scope.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Results Font: help text under the heading listing what the results font applies to and that the default is the system monospaced font.

results_font_size_default.value: 変更するまで、サイズは結果▸グリッド▸行密度に従います。カスタムサイズは行の高さを調整して一致させます。
results_font_size_default.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Results Font: help text under the size stepper explaining the default size comes from the Results ▸ Grid ▸ Row density setting and a custom size rescales rows.

sql_editor_ddl_plans_logs.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Code Font: short help text under the heading listing where the code font is used (SQL editor, DDL views, query plans, logs); a terse list fragment.

tip_of_the_day.value: SQLLYが開始すると、今日のヒントが表示されます。ヘルプ▸今日のヒントからいつでも開きます...
tip_of_the_day.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Startup: help text under the Show tips on startup checkbox; “Help ▸ Tip of the Day…” names the Help menu item that opens tips manually.

fonts_and_sizes.value: ワークベンチのフォントとサイズ。エディタズームもステータスバーにあります。
fonts_and_sizes.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: intro paragraph under the pane title saying this pane sets fonts and sizes, and that editor zoom can also be changed from the status bar.

mode_and_palette.value: ライト、ダーク、またはシステムを選択し、パレットを選択します。システムは、日中はライトテーマ、夜中はダークテーマを使用します。
mode_and_palette.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes: intro paragraph under the pane title explaining the Light/Dark/System mode pills and that System switches between the chosen light and dark palettes by time of day.

applied.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: success status shown after Apply updates the application language and custom overrides.

apply_button.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: button beside the language dropdown that applies the pending language choice immediately.

apply_error.value: 言語設定を適用できませんでした: {error}
apply_error.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: inline error shown when the selected translation file cannot be read or validated, or the language cannot be applied.

browse_button.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: button that opens the native file picker for a custom translation JSON file.

browser_file_hint.value: ブラウザープレビューの翻訳オーバーライドは、ホストページで管理されます。
browser_file_hint.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: browser-only help text replacing the unavailable native custom translation file picker.

clear_button.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: button beside the custom translation file path that removes the selected override file.

custom_file_description.value: このファイルの値は、選択した言語に組み込まれた翻訳を上書きします。ロケーションの説明は翻訳作成時に必要ですが、アプリには読み込まれません。
custom_file_description.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: help text explaining selected-language JSON overrides and translator location descriptions.

custom_file_title.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: section heading below the application language controls for custom translation overrides.

file_label.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: label for the selected custom translation JSON file path.

intro.value: アプリの表示言語を選択します。必要に応じて、カスタム JSON ファイルで組み込みの翻訳を上書きできます。
intro.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: explanatory paragraph immediately below the Language pane title.

language_label.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: label to the left of the native-language application language dropdown.

no_file.value: カスタムファイルが選択されていません
no_file.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: read-only value shown when no custom translation JSON file is selected.

startup_failed.value: 起動時にカスタム翻訳ファイルを読み込めなかったため、組み込みのテキストを表示しています: {error}
startup_failed.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: warning shown when the saved custom translation file could not be read or parsed at startup.

startup_skipped.value: このバージョンで認識されないか、プレースホルダーが英語版と異なるため、起動時にカスタム翻訳ファイルの {count} 件をスキップしました: {keys}。ファイルを修正し、適用をクリックして再確認してください。
startup_skipped.location: Settings → Appearance → Language → Custom translations: warning listing saved custom translation entries skipped at startup for unknown keys or mismatched placeholders.

title.location: Settings → Appearance → Language: title of the language preferences pane and its Appearance sidebar destination.

font_family.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Interface Font: row label to the left of the searchable dropdown that picks the typeface used for menus, tabs, tree and status bar.

font_family_2.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Code Font: row label to the left of the searchable dropdown that picks the typeface used in the SQL editor, DDL, plans and logs.

font_family_3.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Results Font: row label to the left of the searchable dropdown that picks the typeface for result grid cells, pivot tables and charts.

size.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Interface Font: row label to the left of the minus/plus stepper that sets the interface font size in points.

size_2.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Code Font: row label to the left of the minus/plus stepper that sets the code and SQL editor font size in points.

size_3.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Results Font: row label to the left of the minus/plus stepper that sets the results grid font size, next to the Use density size button.

theme_mode_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode pills: internal element identifier of the Dark mode pill, never displayed; keep it unchanged and unique (do not translate).

theme_mode_hc.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode pills: internal element identifier of the High Contrast mode pill, never displayed; keep it unchanged and unique (do not translate).

theme_mode_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode pills: internal element identifier of the Light mode pill, never displayed; keep it unchanged and unique (do not translate).

theme_mode_system.value: テーマモードシステム
theme_mode_system.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode pills: internal element identifier of the System mode pill, never displayed; keep it unchanged and unique (do not translate).

use_density_size.value: 密度サイズを使用する
use_density_size.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Results Font: small button after the size stepper, shown only when a custom results font size is set, that resets the size to follow the grid row density.

search_fonts.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Interface Font: placeholder in the interface-font family search dropdown.

search_fonts_2.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Code Font: placeholder in the code-font family search dropdown.

search_fonts_3.location: Settings → Appearance → Display → Results Font: placeholder in the results-font family search dropdown.

code_font.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: section heading (title case) above the font family dropdown and size stepper for the SQL editor and other code text.

dark_theme.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes: section heading (title case) above the gallery of dark color palettes; the one picked is used in Dark mode and at night in System mode.

free_tier.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: section heading above the checkbox that keeps the “I love SQLly” supporter chip in the status bar after purchase.

interface_font.value: インターフェイスフォント
interface_font.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: first section heading (title case), above the font family dropdown and size stepper for the app’s menus, tabs, tree and status bar.

light_theme.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes: section heading (title case) above the gallery of light color palettes; the one picked is used in Light mode and by day in System mode.

results_font.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: section heading (title case) above the font family dropdown and size stepper for result grids, pivot tables and charts.

startup.location: Settings → Appearance → Display: last section heading, above the checkbox that opens the Tip of the Day window when the app launches.

amber_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Amber (warm orange-yellow accents) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

amber_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Amber (warm orange-yellow accents) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

cobalt_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Cobalt (deep blue accents) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

cobalt_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Cobalt (deep blue accents) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under the first palette card, the default SQLLY brand dark color theme; an adjective naming the theme, not the Dark mode pill.

graphite_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Graphite (neutral grey) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

graphite_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Graphite (neutral grey) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

harbor_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Harbor (sea-blue/teal) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

harbor_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Harbor (sea-blue/teal) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

high_contrast_dark.value: ハイコントラストダーク
high_contrast_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the High Contrast (maximum-contrast accessibility palette) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

high_contrast_light.value: ハイコントラストライト
high_contrast_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the High Contrast (maximum-contrast accessibility palette) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

lavender_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Lavender (soft purple) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

lavender_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Lavender (soft purple) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under the first palette card, the default SQLLY brand light color theme; an adjective naming the theme, not the Light mode pill.

nordic_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Nordic (cool, muted Nord-style) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

nordic_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Nordic (cool, muted Nord-style) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

sepia_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Sepia (warm brownish, paper-like) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

sepia_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Sepia (warm brownish, paper-like) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

signature_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Signature (SQLLY’s signature color family) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

signature_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Signature (SQLLY’s signature color family) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

solarized_dark.value: ソーラー化されたダーク
solarized_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Solarized (the well-known Solarized scheme; usually a proper name) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

solarized_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Solarized (the well-known Solarized scheme; usually a proper name) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

tokyo_dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Dark Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the dark variant of the Tokyo (Tokyo Night–style scheme; proper name) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

tokyo_light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Light Theme gallery: name under a palette thumbnail card for the light variant of the Tokyo (Tokyo Night–style scheme; proper name) color theme; clicking the card selects it.

align_metadata.value: 名前、データタイプ、および無効性の列に合わせる
align_metadata.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata alignment: master checkbox under “Line up object metadata”; when on, the server explorer tree pads each item’s name, data type, and nullability into aligned columns.

auto_navigate_schema.value: スキーマを自動的にビューにナビゲートする
auto_navigate_schema.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Navigation: checkbox label; when on, jumping to an object’s definition expands and scrolls the server explorer tree to reveal that object.

function_parameters.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata alignment: checkbox under the align-into-columns option choosing whether function parameters in the tree are lined up into columns; noun phrase, part of a list of object kinds.

stored_procedure_parameters.value: 保存された手順パラメータ
stored_procedure_parameters.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata alignment: checkbox under the align-into-columns option choosing whether stored procedure parameters in the tree are lined up into columns; noun phrase in a list of object kinds.

table_columns.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata alignment: checkbox under the align-into-columns option choosing whether the columns listed under tables in the tree are lined up; noun phrase in a list of object kinds.

type_columns.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata alignment: checkbox under the align-into-columns option choosing whether the members of user-defined types in the tree are lined up; noun phrase in a list of object kinds.

view_columns.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata alignment: checkbox under the align-into-columns option choosing whether the columns listed under views in the tree are lined up; noun phrase in a list of object kinds.

server_explorer.value: サーバーエクスプローラー
server_explorer.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer: large heading at the top of the pane holding the options that control how the server explorer tree (left sidebar of database objects) is organized and displayed.

auto_navigate.value: オブジェクトの定義にジャンプすると、サーバーエクスプローラは展開され、そのオブジェクトにスクロールされます（すでにツリーにロードされている場合）。
auto_navigate.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Navigation: help text under the auto-navigate checkbox explaining that jumping to a definition reveals the object in the tree, but only if that tree branch is already loaded.

data_type_width_auto.value: 0 = 自動 - 兄弟間で最も広い値までのサイズ。
data_type_width_auto.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Data type: help text under the data type width stepper explaining that a width of 0 sizes the data type column to the widest value among sibling tree items.

flat_prefixed_path.value: サーバー▸データベース▸テーブル/ビュー/プログラミング可能性▸スキーマ.Name
flat_prefixed_path.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Schema display: help text under the “All schemas together” radio button showing the resulting tree path; keep “schema.Name” as a literal schema-qualified name pattern.

nullability_width_auto.value: 0 = 自動 - 兄弟間で最も広い値までのサイズ。
nullability_width_auto.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Nullability: help text under the nullability width stepper explaining that a width of 0 sizes the nullability column to the widest value among sibling tree items.

schema_folders_path.value: サーバー▸データベース▸スキーマ▸テーブル/ビュー/プログラミング可能性▸名前
schema_folders_path.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Schema display: help text under the “Group by schema” radio button showing the resulting tree path; ▸ separates levels, Name is a placeholder for the object name.

system_databases.value: マスター、テンプレートデータベース、モデル、MSDB。サーバーが拡張する次のときに有効になります。
system_databases.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System databases: help text under the three placement radio buttons listing the SQL Server system databases affected and noting the change applies the next time a server node is expanded.

system_schemas.value: sys、INFORMATION_SCHEMA、guest、およびdb_*ロールスキーマ。スキーマがフォルダにグループ化されるときに適用されます。データベースが拡張する次のときに有効になります。
system_schemas.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System schemas: help text under the system-schema radio buttons listing which schemas count as system schemas and saying the setting only matters with grouped schema folders, after a database is re-expanded.

server_explorer.value: サーバーエクスプローラーがあなたのデータモデルをどのように整理して表示するか。
server_explorer.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer: introductory sentence under the pane heading summarizing that these settings control how the server explorer tree organizes and shows databases, schemas, and objects.

data_type.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns: group label above the Align left / Align right radio buttons and width stepper that format the data type text shown beside columns and parameters in the tree.

general_schemas.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Organization: group label above the radio buttons that decide whether ordinary (non-system) schemas are always shown, shown only when not empty, or have empty ones grouped into a folder.

line_up_object_metadata.value: オブジェクトメタデータを並べる
line_up_object_metadata.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Organization: group label above the checkboxes that align names, data types, and nullability into columns for tables, views, procedure and function parameters, and types.

navigation.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Organization: short group label above the auto-navigate checkbox, which controls whether the tree reveals objects you jump to; noun meaning tree navigation behavior.

nullability.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns: group label above the Align left / Align right radio buttons and width stepper that format the NULL / NOT NULL marker shown beside columns in the tree.

schema_display.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Organization: group label above the two radio buttons choosing whether objects are grouped into per-schema folders or listed together with schema-qualified names.

system_databases.value: システムデータベース
system_databases.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Organization: group label above the radio buttons choosing whether system databases are grouped into a folder, listed inline with user databases, or hidden.

system_schemas.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Organization: group label above the radio buttons choosing whether system schemas are grouped into a folder, hidden, or shown only when not empty.

width_characters.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Data type: label beside the number stepper setting the fixed width, in characters, of the data type column in the tree (0 means automatic).

width_characters_2.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Nullability: label beside the number stepper setting the fixed width, in characters, of the nullability column in the tree (0 means automatic).

align_left.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Data type: radio button that left-aligns the data type text within its column in the tree.

align_left_2.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Nullability: radio button that left-aligns the NULL / NOT NULL marker within its column in the tree.

align_right.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Data type: radio button that right-aligns the data type text within its column in the tree.

align_right_2.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Metadata Columns → Nullability: radio button that right-aligns the NULL / NOT NULL marker within its column in the tree.

empty_schemas_folder.value: 空でない場合は表示します。空のスキーマを空スキーマフォルダにグループ化します
empty_schemas_folder.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → General schemas: radio button that shows non-empty schemas normally and gathers empty ones into an Empty Schemas folder; the folder name should match the tree.

flat_prefixed.value: すべてのスキーマを一緒に—オブジェクトはスキーマ.Nameとして表示されます。
flat_prefixed.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Schema display: radio button for the flat layout with no schema folders, where each object is labeled with its schema-qualified name; keep “schema.Name” as a literal pattern.

hidden.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System databases: radio button that hides the system databases from the server explorer tree entirely; adjective describing the databases.

hidden_2.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System schemas: radio button that hides the system schemas from the server explorer tree entirely; adjective describing the schemas.

only_show_not_empty.value: 空でない場合のみ表示します
only_show_not_empty.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System schemas: radio button that lists a system schema in the tree only when it contains objects.

schema_folders.value: スキーマごとにグループ化 - 各スキーマには独自のフォルダが割り当てられます。オブジェクトは名前のみを表示します
schema_folders.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → Schema display: radio button for the layout where every schema becomes its own folder in the tree and objects inside show only their bare name.

show_all_schemas.value: すべてのスキーマを表示する
show_all_schemas.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → General schemas: radio button that lists every ordinary schema in the tree, including empty ones.

show_inline_user_databases.value: ユーザーデータベースとインラインで表示する
show_inline_user_databases.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System databases: radio button that lists system databases mixed in with the user’s own databases rather than in a separate folder.

show_not_empty.value: 空でない場合は表示する
show_not_empty.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → General schemas: radio button that lists an ordinary schema in the tree only when it contains objects; empty schemas are left out.

system_databases_folder.value: システムデータベースフォルダに分類する
system_databases_folder.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System databases: radio button that collects master, tempdb, model, and msdb into a separate System Databases folder under each server; the folder name should match the tree.

system_schemas_folder.value: システムスキーマフォルダに分類する
system_schemas_folder.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer → System schemas: radio button that collects sys, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, and similar schemas into a separate System Schemas folder under each database; the folder name should match the tree.

metadata_columns.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer: section header above the Data type and Nullability formatting options (alignment and width) for the aligned metadata columns in the tree.

organization.location: Settings → Data Model → Server Explorer: first section header, above the schema display, metadata alignment, navigation, system database, and schema grouping options.

include_pg_privileges.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Definition contents: checkbox that appends GRANT/REVOKE statements for the object’s privileges to PostgreSQL definitions and Script as CREATE output.

modifier_click_navigation.value: 修飾子クリックナビゲーションを有効にする
modifier_click_navigation.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: checkbox under the pane intro that turns on opening an object’s definition by holding the activation modifier key and clicking its name in the SQL editor.

ddl_navigation.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: large heading at the top of the pane for options controlling how modifier-clicking an object in the SQL editor opens its definition (DDL); keep “DDL” as is.

monitor_info_unavailable.value: このプラットフォームではモニタリング情報が利用できません。ポップアップはアプリウィンドウの真ん中に表示されます。
monitor_info_unavailable.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window → Preview: message shown in place of the monitor preview when the operating system cannot report display information; the definition popup then opens centered on the app window.

popup_clamped.value: ポップアップが表示されると、サイズと位置が選択したモニターにクランプされるため、画面外に表示されることはありません。
popup_clamped.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: help text below the preview explaining that the popup’s size and position are limited to the chosen monitor so it never opens offscreen.

privileges_explained.value: CREATEの定義とスクリプトは、オブジェクトの権限を再作成するGRANTとREVOKEステートメントで終わります。これには、デフォルトでPostgreSQLの許可権限のREVOKEが含まれます。したがって、スクリプトを実行すると、同じ権限が復元されます。
privileges_explained.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Definition contents: help text under the PostgreSQL privileges checkbox explaining that generated scripts end with GRANT/REVOKE statements so running them restores identical privileges.

intro.value: 修飾子-テーブル、ビュー、列、手順、関数、またはSQLエディタにクリックして、その定義を開きます。テーブルはカタログメタデータからCREATE TABLEを生成します。手順、関数、ビューはサーバーソースを示します。
intro.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: introductory paragraph under the heading explaining which objects can be modifier-clicked in the SQL editor and how tables versus procedures, functions, and views get their definition.

activation_modifier.value: アクティベーション修飾子
activation_modifier.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: label beside the dropdown choosing which modifier key (such as Cmd or Ctrl) must be held while clicking an object name to open its definition.

height_px.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: label beside the number input for the definition popup’s height in pixels; shown only when definitions open in a popup.

horizontal_position.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: label beside the slider setting where the definition popup appears left to right on the monitor, as a percentage; shown only in popup mode.

monitor.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: label beside the dropdown choosing which display the definition popup opens on (the app’s current monitor or a specific one); shown only in popup mode.

vertical_position.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: label beside the slider setting where the definition popup appears top to bottom on the monitor, as a percentage; shown only in popup mode.

width_px.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: label beside the number input for the definition popup’s width in pixels; shown only when definitions open in a popup.

popup_px.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window → Preview: caption under the to-scale monitor preview; {label} is the monitor name, {width} and {height} are the popup size in pixels after clamping.

definition_contents.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: section header above the options that control what is included in generated definitions, such as PostgreSQL privilege statements.

popup_window.value: ポップアップウィンドウ
popup_window.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: section header above the popup size, position, and monitor options; appears only when “show definitions” is set to the popup choice.

preview.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window: section header above the to-scale drawing of the chosen monitor with the definition popup’s rectangle placed on it; shown only in popup mode.

show_definitions.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation: section header above the radio buttons choosing whether a modifier-clicked definition opens in a new tab, a side panel, or a popup window.

could_not_build_schedule_grid.value: スケジュールグリッドを作成できませんでした。
could_not_build_schedule_grid.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled Dumps → Schedule grid: error shown when the schedule grid cannot be constructed.

no_scheduled_tasks_yet.value: まだスケジュールされたタスクはありません。
no_scheduled_tasks_yet.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled Dumps → Schedule grid: empty state shown before any scheduled tasks exist.

cadence.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for how often each scheduled task runs (Hourly, Daily, or Weekly).

connection.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for the saved connection name each scheduled task runs against.

database.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for the database each scheduled dump, backup, or export targets.

enabled.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for the yes/no checkbox column showing whether each schedule is currently active.

keep.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: narrow column header for the retention count, the number of most recent output files kept for each schedule before older ones are deleted.

last_result.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for the outcome message of each schedule’s most recent run (or a dash if it never ran).

missing.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled Dumps → Schedule grid → Task: missing-tool status for a scheduled task.

missing_2.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled Dumps → Schedule grid → Last result: missing-tool status for a scheduled task.

next_run.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for the date and time (UTC) each schedule is next due to run.

task.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid: column header for the kind of task each schedule performs (SQL dump, native backup, or saved-query export).

scheduled_dumps.value: スケジュールされたダンプ
scheduled_dumps.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps: large heading at the top of the pane listing recurring SQL dumps, native backups, and saved-query exports the app runs automatically.

intro.value: SQLLYが開いている間、組み込みのSQLダンプ、ネイティブのpg_dump/mysqldumpバックアップ、および保存されたクエリCSV/JSON行エクスポートをカディエンスで実行します。スキップされたスロットは、起動後の次のタイクで実行されます。CLIコマンドのコピーは、cronの場合の同等のsqlly-cli行（POSIXシェル構文）またはWindowsのGit Bash/WSLを提供します。
intro.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps: introductory paragraph under the heading explaining the three task types, that tasks run only while the app is open, catch-up of missed runs, and the Copy CLI command button for cron.

add.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps: button above the schedule grid that opens the schedule editor to create a new scheduled task; the ellipsis signals a dialog follows.

copy_cli_command.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule action row: button on each schedule’s row that copies an equivalent sqlly-cli command line for use in cron; disabled in the browser version.

edit.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule action row: button on each schedule’s row that reopens that schedule in the schedule editor dialog for changes.

remove.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule action row: button on each schedule’s row that deletes that schedule immediately (existing output files are not touched).

run_now.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule action row: button on each schedule’s row that starts that scheduled task immediately instead of waiting for its next due time.

connection.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule action row: label at the start of each row identifying the schedule; {connection} is the connection name, {database} the database, {value_2} the task description.

export_query_name.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid → Task column: task description for a saved-query export; {query_name} is the saved query’s name and {value} the file format such as CSV or JSON Lines.

load_scheduled_tasks_failed.value: スケジュールされたタスクを読み込めませんでした：{error}
load_scheduled_tasks_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps: error shown in place of the schedule grid when the saved schedules file cannot be read; {error} is the technical reason. The app will not overwrite the file until it is fixed.

daily.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid → Cadence column: cell value for a schedule that runs once a day; adverb/adjective, keep short.

hourly.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid → Cadence column: cell value for a schedule that runs once an hour; adverb/adjective, keep short.

native_backup.value: ネイティブバックアップ
native_backup.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid → Task column: cell value for a schedule that runs the database’s own backup tool (pg_dump or mysqldump).

sql_dump.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid → Task column: cell value for a schedule that runs SQLLY’s built-in SQL script dump of the database.

weekly.location: Settings → Workspace → Scheduled dumps → Schedule grid → Cadence column: cell value for a schedule that runs once a week; adverb/adjective, keep short.

alias_as_keyword.value: ASキーワードを含める（Orders AS o、Orders oではない）
alias_as_keyword.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → When you accept a table or view: checkbox that writes the SQL keyword AS between table and alias; AS and the examples stay unchanged.

alias_include_schema.value: スキーマを含める（Shared.PaymentMethod = spm）
alias_include_schema.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Alias names: indented checkbox under the capital-letters option that also adds the schema's initial to the alias (Shared.PaymentMethod gets spm).

auto_insert_connectors.value: WHERE / JOIN ON コネクタ（欠落しているANDを挿入）
auto_insert_connectors.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that inserts a missing AND between conditions in WHERE and JOIN … ON clauses; SQL keywords stay in English.

auto_spacing.location: Settings → Editor → General → Spacing: the only checkbox under the Spacing heading, turning automatic spacing of typed SQL on or off; on by default.

built_function_names.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, names of the database's built-in functions (such as COUNT or GETDATE) are drawn in bold.

camel_hump_word_movement.value: カメの背中の文字の動き
camel_hump_word_movement.location: Settings → Editor → General → Navigation: checkbox that makes word-by-word caret movement stop at each capital letter inside a CamelCase name (for example Order|Date).

date_like_column_names.value: 日付のように名前を付けた列を日付として扱う
date_like_column_names.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that treats columns whose names look like dates as date columns when their type is unknown, so plain-word dates work after them.

feedback_full_model_default.value: デフォルトでは、IntelliSenseフィードバックに完全なデータモデルを含める
feedback_full_model_default.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense feedback dialog start with “Include all” ticked, sending the whole data model's object names with each report.

frame_current_statement.value: 現在のステートメントをフレームにする
frame_current_statement.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that draws a thin frame around the SQL statement the caret is currently in; “frame” is a verb meaning outline.

functions.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list functions by default.

group_by_lists.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that enables automatic comma insertion between items of a GROUP BY list; GROUP BY is a SQL keyword and stays in English.

highlight_selection_occurrences.value: 選択の発生をハイライトする
highlight_selection_occurrences.location: Settings → Editor → General → Selection: checkbox that softly highlights every other occurrence of the currently selected word or phrase in the script.

detect_query_placeholders.value: :name、?、$1の欄の値を入力してください。
detect_query_placeholders.location: Settings → Editor → General → Query parameters: checkbox that makes :name, ? and $1 placeholders in a query ask for values in the Parameters strip before Run.

hover_info.value: テーブル、列、およびルーチンのオーバーレイ情報を表示する
hover_info.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that turns on the info cards shown when the mouse hovers over table, column, procedure or function names in the editor.

include_schema_name_searching.value: 検索にスキーマ名を含める
include_schema_name_searching.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Matching: checkbox that makes completion search the schema name together with the object name (so typing dboM finds dbo.Make).

individual_columns.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list columns as separate pickable items by default.

insert_column_hints.value: INSERT値の列ヒントを表示する
insert_column_hints.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that paints dim column-name labels before each value in an INSERT … VALUES list so you can see which column each value fills.

keep_typed_date_comment.value: 私が入力したものを--sqlly日付で保存します：コメント
keep_typed_date_comment.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that keeps the typed words in a “--sqlly date:” comment next to the inserted date; the comment marker stays unchanged.

keywords.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, SQL keywords such as SELECT and FROM are drawn in bold.

literals_strings_numbers_null.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, literal values (quoted strings, numbers and NULL) are drawn in bold.

match_camel_humps_initials.value: カメルのヒンクとイニシャルを合わせる
match_camel_humps_initials.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Matching: checkbox that lets completion match typed capitals or initials against CamelCase name parts (e.g. ST finds SomeTable).

order_by_lists.value: リストによるオーダー
order_by_lists.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that enables automatic comma insertion between items of an ORDER BY list; ORDER BY is a SQL keyword and stays in English.

procedures.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, names of stored procedures from the connected database are drawn in bold.

procedures_2.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list stored procedures by default (not the Bold text option of the same name).

read_dates_typed_plain_words.value: 平易な言葉で入力された日付を読み取る
read_dates_typed_plain_words.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: main checkbox that turns on reading plain-word dates such as “today” or “last wed at 3” after a date comparison.

refresh_dates_on_run.value: クエリを実行するたびに日付を更新します
refresh_dates_on_run.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that re-evaluates every “--sqlly date:” comment automatically just before the query runs.

schemas.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, schema names (such as dbo) from the connected database are drawn in bold.

select_lists.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that enables automatic comma insertion between items of a SELECT column list; SELECT is a SQL keyword and stays in English.

show_ai_query_summary_bar.value: AIクエリの概要バーを表示する
show_ai_query_summary_bar.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that turns on the bar above the results showing an AI-generated plain-language summary of the query tab's SQL; off by default.

show_line_numbers.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that shows or hides the line-number gutter on the left of every query editor.

show_refresh_buttons.value: 更新ボタンを表示する
show_refresh_buttons.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that shows refresh buttons in the editor next to “--sqlly date:” comments and on the statement's first line for re-evaluating dates.

signature_help.value: 関数呼び出し内のシグネチャヘルプを表示する
