time_zone_id.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: label of the text input for the zone name (e.g. Europe/Paris), shown only when a specific zone is chosen.

true.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Custom values: label of the input for the text shown for true values; appears only when the style is Custom.

type_color_fill.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color row: short label before the cell background color picker.

type_color_text.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color row: short label before the text color picker.

visible_prefix.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the dropdown under a Mask-kind override choosing how many leading characters stay visible in masked values.

visible_suffix.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the dropdown under a Mask-kind override choosing how many trailing characters stay visible in masked values.

labels_k_m_g_t_p.value: ラベル：K={kilo} M={mega} G={giga} T={tera} P={peta}
labels_k_m_g_t_p.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Metric: hint under the threshold input listing the suffix letters in use; {kilo}…{peta} are the configured labels. Keep “K=”, “M=” etc.

column_zone_falling_back_utc.value: {message} — この列はUTCに復元されます。
column_zone_falling_back_utc.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → a Date or Epoch override → Time zone: red error under the named-zone picker when the typed IANA zone name cannot be resolved, so that column renders in UTC; {message} is the resolver's reason. Shown only for that one override.

message_falling_back_utc.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: red error under the zone picker when the entered zone id is invalid; {message} explains why, and times are shown in UTC instead.

override_id_already_exists.value: {id}のオーバーライドはすでに存在しています。
override_id_already_exists.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override: inline warning under the column identifier input after clicking Add override for a column already overridden; {id} is the identifier.

override_s_configured.value: {value}が構成されたオーバーライドを適用します。
override_s_configured.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Overrides: count line above the list of existing overrides; {value} is the number configured (may be 0, 1 or more).

time_zone_empty.value: タイムゾーンが入力されていません
time_zone_empty.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: reason inserted as {message} into the red “— falling back to UTC” error under the zone picker, shown when “Always in time zone” is chosen but no zone id is entered.

time_zone_unknown.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: reason inserted as {message} into the red “— falling back to UTC” error under the zone picker, shown when the entered zone id is not an IANA time zone name; {time_zone} is the id as typed, e.g. “Europe/Paris”.

column_name.location: Settings → Results → Column Overrides → Scope: Column name option for an override scoped by column identifier.

column_name_2.location: Settings → Results → Column Overrides → Add override: Column name option identifying the override target.

custom.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: “NULL cells” dropdown option that writes the user's own text (from Custom NULL text) for NULL values.

empty.value: 空いている
empty.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: “NULL cells” dropdown option that writes nothing (an empty field) for NULL values.

escape.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: “Embedded line breaks” dropdown option that writes line breaks inside values as escape sequences.

format_default.value: フォーマットデフォルト
format_default.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: “NULL cells” dropdown option (default) that uses each export format's own NULL convention.

keep.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: “Embedded line breaks” dropdown option (default) that leaves line breaks inside values unchanged.

replace_space.value: スペースで置き換える
replace_space.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: “Embedded line breaks” dropdown option that turns line breaks inside values into spaces.

customer_name.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: example placeholder in a JSON-path override's path input showing JSON path syntax; usually kept as is.

empty.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: placeholder in a JSON-path override's “If missing” input, meaning nothing is shown when the path is not found.

value_upper.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: example placeholder in a Template override's input showing the value token with the upper helper; keep the braces and names literal.

add.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns → Patterns: button below the scope dropdown that adds the typed pattern to the masking list.

add_override.value: オーバーライドを追加する
add_override.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override: button below the column identifier input that creates an override of the chosen kind for that column.

remove.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Overrides: button beside each existing override's column name that deletes that override.

remove_2.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns → Patterns: button at the end of each pattern row that deletes that masking pattern.

reset_to_theme.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color row: button that clears the custom colors for that kind and goes back to the theme's tint.

restore_defaults.value: デフォルトを復元する
restore_defaults.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns → Patterns: button beside Add that resets the masking pattern list and switch to the built-in defaults.

search_time_zones.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: placeholder in the search box of the “Pick a zone” list, used to filter time zone names.

add_override.value: オーバーライドを追加する
add_override.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: section heading below the existing overrides, above the Kind dropdown and column identifier input used to create a new override.

alignment.location: Settings → Results → Date: section heading above the dropdown for date cell alignment.

alignment_2.location: Settings → Results → Boolean: section heading above the dropdown for true/false cell alignment.

alignment_3.location: Settings → Results → Unique ID: section heading above the dropdown for GUID/UUID cell alignment.

alignment_4.location: Settings → Results → Integer: section heading above the dropdown for whole-number cell alignment.

alignment_5.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above the dropdown for decimal-number cell alignment.

batch_export_pattern.value: バッチエクスポートパターン
batch_export_pattern.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: section heading above the default file-name pattern used when exporting several tables at once.

copy.location: Settings → Results → Export: section heading above the default clipboard copy format dropdown; noun meaning clipboard copying.

custom_values.location: Settings → Results → Boolean: section heading above the True and False text inputs, shown only when the style is Custom.

decimal_places.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above the Places stepper that sets how many digits after the decimal point are shown for decimal values in the results grid.

decimal_separator.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above the dropdown choosing the character used as the decimal point (for example period or comma) when decimal values are shown in the results grid.

format_pattern.value: フォーマットパターン
format_pattern.location: Settings → Results → Date: first section heading on the pane, above the text field where the user types the date/time display pattern (such as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss) for date values in the results grid.

formats.location: Settings → Results → Export: section heading above the list of checkboxes (CSV, JSON, Excel, etc.) that choose which standard export formats appear in the results grid’s Export menu.

integer_timestamps.location: Settings → Results → Date: section heading above the Show integer timestamps as dates dropdown.

line_breaks.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: section heading above the dropdown choosing whether line breaks inside cell values are kept, replaced with spaces, or escaped in exported files.

metric.location: Settings → Results → Integer: section heading above the Metric threshold field, controlling when large whole numbers are shortened to K / M / G / T / P units; “metric” means SI unit prefixes.

metric_2.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above the Metric threshold field, controlling when large decimal numbers are shortened to K / M / G / T / P units; “metric” means SI unit prefixes.

negative_format.value: ネガティブフォーマット
negative_format.location: Settings → Results → Integer: section heading above the dropdown choosing how negative whole numbers are displayed in the results grid (for example with a minus sign or in parentheses).

negative_format_2.value: ネガティブフォーマット
negative_format_2.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above the dropdown choosing how negative decimal numbers are displayed in the results grid (for example with a minus sign or in parentheses).

null_text.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: section heading above the NULL cells dropdown and Custom NULL text field that decide what is written for NULL values in exported files.

overrides.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: section heading above the count of configured per-column formatting overrides and the list of them, each with a Remove button.

patterns.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns: section heading above the list of column-name patterns whose matching columns are masked automatically in results.

programming.location: Settings → Results → Export: section heading above the switch and per-language checkboxes for exporting result rows as source code (record type plus data) in programming languages.

sample_preview.location: Settings → Results → Date: section heading above a read-only sample showing how a date value will look with the current pattern and time-zone settings.

sample_preview_2.location: Settings → Results → Boolean: section heading above a read-only sample showing how true and false values will look with the chosen boolean style.

sample_preview_3.location: Settings → Results → Unique ID: section heading above a read-only sample UUID showing how unique identifiers will look with the current Show dashes setting.

sample_preview_4.location: Settings → Results → Integer: section heading above a read-only sample (the number 1234567) showing how whole numbers will look with the current separator, metric, and negative settings.

sample_preview_5.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above a read-only sample (the value of pi) showing how decimal numbers will look with the current places, separator, and metric settings.

spreadsheet_safety.value: スプレッドシートセキュリティ
spreadsheet_safety.location: Settings → Results → Export: section heading above the checkbox that protects copied and exported text against spreadsheet formula injection by prefixing risky values with an apostrophe.

style.location: Settings → Results → Boolean: first section heading on the pane, above the dropdown choosing how true/false values are displayed in the results grid (Y/N, Yes/No, 0/1, T/F, True/False, or custom values).

thousands_separator.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: section heading above the dropdown choosing the digit-grouping character (for example comma, period, or space) used between thousands in decimal values.

time_zone.location: Settings → Results → Date: section heading above the dropdown choosing which time zone date/time values are shown in (UTC, as stored, local, or a specific named zone).

mcp.value: MCPモデルコンテキストプロトコルサーバーツールリソースアクティビティ監査
mcp.location: Settings → AI → MCP: additional search keywords used to find the separate MCP settings view.

playground_keywords.value: プレイグラウンドのプロンプト応答テストモデルのリクエスト
playground_keywords.location: Settings → Search box: hidden search keywords (never displayed) that let a settings search find the AI → Playground pane; translate as space-separated lowercase search terms, not a sentence.

export_button.value: VSコード用にエクスポートする…
export_button.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: button below the snippet list that saves every snippet as a VS Code .code-snippets file that VS Code and Azure Data Studio load; keep “VS Code” unchanged.

exported.value: {count}のスニペットを{path}にエクスポートしました。
exported.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Export for VS Code: message under the export buttons after the snippets were written; {count} is the number of snippets, {path} the file written.

import_button.value: VSコードからインポートする…
import_button.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: button below the snippet list that opens a file chooser to read snippets from a VS Code or Azure Data Studio snippet file (sql.json or .code-snippets); keep “VS Code” unchanged.

import_prompt.value: スニペットをインポートする
import_prompt.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Import from VS Code → System open panel: confirm-button label (and prompt) of the native file chooser used to pick a VS Code or Azure Data Studio snippet file.

imported.value: {added}のスニペットを追加し、すでに前綴が存在している{skipped}はスキップしました。保存をクリックして保存します。
imported.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Import from VS Code: message under the import buttons after a snippet file was read; {added} is how many snippets were added to the list, {skipped} how many were left out because their prefix already exists; the new snippets are kept only after Save.

read_failed.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Import from VS Code: error shown under the import buttons when the chosen snippet file cannot be read; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

write_failed.value: スニペットファイルを保存できませんでした：{error}
write_failed.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Export for VS Code: error shown under the export buttons when the snippet file cannot be written; {error} is the system error.

no_quick_actions_yet.value: まだクイックアクションはありません
no_quick_actions_yet.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: empty list shown before any quick actions exist.

no_snippets_yet.value: まだスニペットはありません
no_snippets_yet.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: empty list shown before any snippets exist.

placeholder_syntax.value: プレースホルダー: `${1:default}` `$2` `$0`。クイックアクション: `${selection}` `${table}` `${database}`。選択、変数、変換はサポートされていません。
placeholder_syntax.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions: help text near the bottom of the pane listing the supported tab-stop placeholder syntax and quick-action variables; keep the backtick-quoted code tokens unchanged.

description.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: label for the optional description text field of the selected snippet, shown only while a snippet is selected in the list.

prefix.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: label for the text field holding the selected snippet’s trigger word, which is typed in the editor to expand the snippet.

title.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: label for the text field naming the selected quick action; the name shows in the Command Palette and Keyboard Shortcuts.

pane_intro.value: スニペットは、タブ停止のプレースホルダーを使用して、接頭辞をSQLに拡張します。クイックアクションは、ショートカットに結合された名前付きテンプレートです。
pane_intro.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions: introductory paragraph at the top of the pane explaining what snippets (prefix-triggered SQL templates) and quick actions (shortcut-bound templates) are.

save.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions: primary button at the bottom of the pane that validates and saves all snippet and quick-action edits; nothing is stored until it is clicked.

body.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: label for the text field holding the selected snippet’s SQL template, which may contain tab-stop placeholders; shown while a snippet is selected.

body_2.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: label for the text field holding the selected quick action’s SQL template, which may use variables like the current selection or table.

slot.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: label for the dropdown choosing which numbered slot (1–9) the selected quick action occupies; each slot maps to one shortcut.

target.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: label for the dropdown choosing where the selected quick action’s output goes (replace selection, new tab, or run in new tab).

untitled.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets list: placeholder row label shown for a snippet whose prefix has not been filled in yet, e.g. right after clicking Add.

quick_action.location: Command Palette and Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts: command title for a user-defined quick action in slots 2–9; {title} is the name the user gave the quick action. Also used to search the shortcut list after Assign shortcut….

quick_action_slot.value: クイックアクション：スロット{slot}
quick_action_slot.location: Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts: search text filled in after clicking Assign shortcut… for a quick action that has no title yet; {slot} is its slot number 1–9. Must match the shortcut list’s command title.

slot.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions → Slot summary: unnamed quick action shown by slot number.

slot_2.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions → Slot summary: named quick action shown with slot number and title.

slot_slot.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick action editor: option label for one user-defined quick-action shortcut slot.

new_tab.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions → Target dropdown: option that opens the quick action’s SQL in a new editor tab without running it.

replace_selection.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions → Target dropdown: default option that replaces the current editor selection with the quick action’s SQL.

run_new_tab.value: 新しいタブで実行する
run_new_tab.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions → Target dropdown: option that opens the quick action’s SQL in a new editor tab and executes it immediately.

add.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: button below the snippets list that adds a new empty snippet and selects it for editing.

add_2.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: button below the quick-actions list that adds a new quick action in the first free slot (1–9); does nothing when all nine slots are used.

assign_shortcut.value: ショートカットを割り当てる...
assign_shortcut.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: button under the selected quick action that jumps to Keyboard Shortcuts, filtered to that quick action, so a key can be bound.

delete.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: button beside Add below the snippets list that removes the currently selected snippet.

delete_2.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: button beside Add below the quick-actions list that removes the currently selected quick action.

quick_actions.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions: section heading above the list of quick actions, numbered templates (slots 1–9) that run from a keyboard shortcut.

snippets.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions: section heading above the list of snippets, SQL templates expanded in the editor by typing their prefix.

duplicate_slot.value: 各スロットは一度だけ使用できます。
duplicate_slot.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: inline error under the Slot dropdown (and on Save) when another quick action already uses the chosen slot number.

empty_quick_action_title.value: クイックアクションのタイトルは空になれません。
empty_quick_action_title.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions: error shown above the Save button when Save is clicked while any quick action has a blank title; nothing is saved.

prefix_cannot_be_empty.value: 前置詞は空になれません。
prefix_cannot_be_empty.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: inline error under the Prefix field (and on Save) when the selected snippet’s prefix is blank.

prefix_cannot_contain_spaces.value: 前綴にはスペースは含まれてはいけません。
prefix_cannot_contain_spaces.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: inline error under the Prefix field (and on Save) when the snippet prefix contains a space or other whitespace.

prefix_must_be_unique.value: 前綴はユニークでなければなりません。
prefix_must_be_unique.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: inline error under the Prefix field (and on Save) when another snippet already uses the same prefix, ignoring letter case.

slot_must_be_1_through_9.value: スロットは1から9まででなければなりません。
slot_must_be_1_through_9.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: inline error under the Slot dropdown (and on Save) when a quick action’s stored slot number is outside the range 1 to 9.

sql_formatting.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: title at the top of the SQL formatting settings pane, which controls how the editor's Format Document and Format Selection commands lay out SQL.

format_as_you_go_help.value: Enterキーを押すたびに入力しているステートメントをフォーマットします。オフになっている場合は、デフォルトではFormat Document（ドキュメントフォーマット）でオンデマンドでフォーマットし、キーボードショートカットで再結合できます。
format_as_you_go_help.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: help text under the “Format as you go” checkbox near the top of the pane, explaining it reformats the current statement on every Enter press and naming the Format Document command and its default shortcut for manual use.

inline_column_threshold_range.value: このカウント以下の列は、1行を共有できます。0〜20。
inline_column_threshold_range.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → SELECT list: help text under the “Inline column threshold” stepper explaining that SELECT lists with this many columns or fewer may stay on one line; allowed range 0 to 20.

max_blank_lines_range.value: 文間の空白行は、このカウントまで保持されます。0〜5。
max_blank_lines_range.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Statements: help text under the “Max consecutive blank lines” stepper explaining that blank lines between statements are kept up to the chosen number; the allowed range is 0 to 5.

max_line_length_range.value: 0は完全にラップを無効にします。他の値は40〜500にクリップされます。
max_line_length_range.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: help text under the “Max line length” input, shown while the value is valid, explaining that 0 turns line wrapping off and other values are limited to 40–500 characters.

new_line_indented_placement.value: 新しい行、インデントされた行は、最初のテーブル（そのJOINを含む）または最初の条件をキーワードの下に独自の行に配置します。AND/OR行はそれに沿って配置されます。
new_line_indented_placement.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: help text under the “Table after FROM” and “First condition after WHERE / HAVING” dropdowns explaining what their “New line, indented” option does; the option name should match its translated dropdown label.

preset_overrides_settings.value: プリセットは、以下のすべての設定を書き直します。 それらを個別に変更すると、プリセットがカスタムに変更されます。
preset_overrides_settings.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Preset: help text under the Preset dropdown warning that choosing a preset overwrites all formatting options on the pane, and that changing any single option switches the preset to “Custom”.

preview_sample.value: 以下のSQLを編集（または独自のSQLを貼り付ける）して、それがどのようにフォーマットされるかを確認してください。
preview_sample.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it: instruction under the Sample dropdown inviting the user to edit the sample SQL in the input box below, or paste their own, to preview the formatted result.

semicolon_move_only.value: フォーマッタはセミコロンを追加したり削除したりすることはありません。これは単にそれらを移動させるだけです。
semicolon_move_only.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Statements: help text under the “Semicolon placement” dropdown reassuring that formatting only repositions existing statement-ending semicolons and never inserts or deletes them.

max_line_length.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: label beside the numeric input setting the maximum number of characters per formatted line before the formatter wraps it.

short_query_max_length.value: 短いクエリの最大長さ
short_query_max_length.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: label beside the numeric input, shown only when “Keep short queries on one line” is checked, setting how many characters a query may have to stay on one line.

pane_intro.value: SQLのフォーマット方法。クエリ全体を「ドキュメントのフォーマット」（デフォルトはAlt+Shift+F）または選択部分のみを「選択のフォーマット」（Cmd+K Cmd+F; WindowsおよびLinuxではCtrl+K Ctrl+F）でフォーマットします。クエリメニューおよびコマンドパレットでも、または以下のトリガーを介して自動的にフォーマットできます。設定を変更すると、プレビューがライブで更新されます。
pane_intro.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining the Format Document and Format Selection commands with their default shortcuts per platform, where to find them, the automatic triggers, and the live preview.

argument_style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Functions: label beside the dropdown choosing how function-call arguments are laid out, for example kept inline or one argument per line.

case.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Keyword casing: label beside the dropdown choosing the letter case applied to SQL keywords such as SELECT and FROM (for example upper or lower case).

case_2.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Functions: label beside the dropdown choosing the letter case applied to function names such as COUNT or GETDATE; distinct from the keyword casing setting.

clause_placement.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → JOINs: label beside the dropdown choosing where the ON clause of a JOIN is placed, such as on the same line as the joined table or on its own line.

column_layout.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → SELECT list: label beside the dropdown choosing how the columns of a SELECT list are arranged, such as one per line or several on a line.

continuation_indent.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: label beside the stepper, shown only when “Use editor indentation settings” is off, setting the extra indent width for wrapped continuation lines.

cte_style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Subqueries / CTEs: label beside the dropdown choosing how common table expressions (WITH … AS blocks) are laid out.

first_condition_placement.value: WHERE / HAVING の後の最初の条件
first_condition_placement.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: label beside the dropdown choosing whether the first condition after WHERE or HAVING stays on the keyword's line or moves to its own indented line.

group_by_order_by_layout.value: グループ化/並び替えレイアウト
group_by_order_by_layout.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → SELECT list: label beside the dropdown choosing how the column lists of GROUP BY and ORDER BY clauses are arranged.

identifier_case.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Identifier formatting: label beside the dropdown choosing the letter case applied to table and column names, or leaving them as typed.

indent_style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: label beside the dropdown, shown only when “Use editor indentation settings” is off, choosing whether the formatter indents with spaces or tabs.

indent_width.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: label beside the stepper, shown only when “Use editor indentation settings” is off, setting how many spaces make one indentation level.

inline_column_threshold.value: インライン列のしきい値
inline_column_threshold.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → SELECT list: label beside the numeric stepper setting the largest number of SELECT columns that may share a single line.

layout.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → CASE expressions: label beside the dropdown choosing how CASE … WHEN … THEN … END expressions are laid out across lines.

layout_2.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → JOINs: label beside the dropdown choosing how JOIN clauses are laid out: JOIN keywords aligned, each JOIN stacked on a new line, or compacted onto one line.

list_layout.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Boolean conditions: label beside the dropdown choosing how the values inside an IN (…) list are arranged, such as on one line or one per line.

major_clause_placement.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: label beside the dropdown choosing whether major clauses such as FROM, WHERE and GROUP BY each start a new line, keep their existing placement, or stay compact when short.

max_consecutive_blank_lines.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Statements: label beside the numeric stepper setting how many blank lines in a row the formatter keeps between statements.

placement.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Boolean conditions: label beside the dropdown choosing whether AND / OR operators go at the start of each condition line or at the end of the previous one.

preset.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Preset: label beside the dropdown that picks a named formatting style preset and applies all of its settings at once.

quoting.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Identifier formatting: label beside the dropdown choosing whether the formatter keeps, adds or removes the quoting (brackets, double quotes or backticks) around table and column names.

sample.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it: label beside the dropdown that loads one of several built-in example queries into the preview input box.

semicolon_placement.value: セミコロンの位置付け
semicolon_placement.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Statements: label beside the dropdown choosing where a statement's existing closing semicolon is placed, such as at the end of the last line or on its own line.

sql_dialect.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Dialect: label beside the dropdown choosing which database's SQL syntax (for example T-SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL) the formatter parses and formats for.

style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comma style: label beside the dropdown choosing whether list commas go at the end of a line (trailing) or at the start of the next line (leading).

style_2.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: label beside the dropdown choosing the overall layout of INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE statements: each clause on a new line, compact on one line, or each column/value on its own line.

style_3.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: label beside the dropdown choosing the overall layout of CREATE TABLE style statements: one column definition per line, compact on one line, or expanded with each constraint on its own line.

style_4.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: label beside the dropdown choosing how the formatter treats SQL comments: keep them as written, or align end-of-line comments.

subquery_style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Subqueries / CTEs: label beside the dropdown choosing how nested subqueries in parentheses are laid out and indented.

table_after_from.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: label beside the dropdown choosing whether the first table after FROM stays on the FROM line or moves to its own indented line.

values_style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: label beside the dropdown choosing how the row tuples of an INSERT … VALUES list are laid out.

formatted_output.value: フォーマットされた出力
formatted_output.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it: small caption above the read-only, syntax-highlighted box that shows the preview SQL after it is run through the formatter with the current settings.

max_line_length_out_of_range.value: 範囲外の場合、{value}が使用されます。0はラップを無効にします。それ以外の場合は40〜500です。
max_line_length_out_of_range.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: warning under the “Max line length” input, shown instead of the help text when the typed value is outside the allowed range; {value} is the clamped length actually used.

short_query_length_range.value: 範囲外 — {value} が使用されます。許可されている範囲：0–500。
short_query_length_range.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: warning under the “Short query max length” input, shown when the typed value is outside 0–500; {value} is the clamped length the formatter will actually use.

case_in_list.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it → Sample dropdown: option that loads an example query using a CASE expression and an IN (…) list into the preview input.

create_table.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it → Sample dropdown: option that loads an example CREATE TABLE statement into the preview input to show DDL formatting.

cte_subquery.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it → Sample dropdown: option that loads an example query with a common table expression (WITH) and a nested subquery into the preview input.

custom.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it → Sample dropdown: fallback text shown on the dropdown when no built-in example is selected, meaning the preview holds user-supplied SQL.

insert_update.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it → Sample dropdown: option that loads example INSERT and UPDATE statements into the preview input to show DML formatting.

select_joins.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Try it → Sample dropdown: default option that loads an example SELECT query with several JOINs into the preview input.

boolean_conditions.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for AND / OR placement, parenthesizing mixed logic and IN (…) list layout.

case_expressions.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping the layout option for CASE … WHEN … END expressions.

clause_layout.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for how FROM, WHERE and other major clauses are positioned and spaced.

comma_style.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping the option for leading versus trailing commas in lists.

comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for how SQL comments are kept, moved or reformatted.

ddl.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header (Data Definition Language) grouping options for CREATE / ALTER statements such as aligning column data types; usually kept as the acronym.

dialect.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping the choice of SQL dialect the formatter targets.

dml.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header (Data Manipulation Language) grouping options for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE statements; usually kept as the acronym.

format_triggers.value: フォーマットトリガー
format_triggers.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping checkboxes that format SQL automatically on save or on paste.

functions.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for function-name case, argument layout and spacing before parentheses.

identifier_formatting.value: 識別子のフォーマット
identifier_formatting.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for the case and quoting of table and column names.

indentation.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping indent style, width and nested-query indentation options.

joins.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for JOIN layout and ON clause placement; JOIN is the SQL keyword.

keyword_casing.value: キーワードのキャッシング
keyword_casing.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for the letter case of SQL keywords.

line_length.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping the maximum line length, line wrapping and short-query options.

operators.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for spaces around and alignment of operators such as = and <>.

preset.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header above the dropdown that applies a named bundle of formatting settings.

select_list.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for how the column list after SELECT is laid out.

statements.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping semicolon placement and blank-line limits between statements.

subqueries_ctes.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping layout options for nested subqueries and common table expressions (WITH clauses).

try_it.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header above the live preview area where users pick or type sample SQL and see it formatted.

align_column_aliases.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → SELECT list: checkbox label for the option that lines up the AS aliases of SELECT columns in one vertical column.

align_comparison_operators.value: 比較演算子の並べ替え
align_comparison_operators.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Operators: checkbox label for the option that vertically lines up comparison operators such as = across consecutive condition lines.

align_data_types.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that lines up column data types in a column within CREATE TABLE definitions.

align_nullability.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that lines up the NULL / NOT NULL markers in a column within CREATE TABLE definitions.

align_set_operators.value: SETオペレーターを並べる
align_set_operators.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that lines up the = signs of the column assignments in an UPDATE … SET list.

align_values_rows.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that lines up the values of each row tuple in an INSERT … VALUES list so they form columns.

blank_line_before_clauses.value: 主要な文節の前には空白行がある
blank_line_before_clauses.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: checkbox label for the option that inserts an empty line before major clauses such as FROM, WHERE and GROUP BY.

break_after_select.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: checkbox label for the option that puts a line break right after the SELECT keyword so the first column starts on the next line.

constraints_after_columns.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that places table constraints after all column definitions in CREATE TABLE statements.

format_as_you_go.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: checkbox label for the option near the top of the pane that reformats the current statement each time Enter is pressed in the editor.

format_inside_block_comments.value: ブロックコメント内のフォーマット
format_inside_block_comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that lets the formatter also reformat SQL text found inside /* … */ block comments.

format_on_paste.value: 貼り付け後のフォーマット
format_on_paste.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Format triggers: checkbox label for the option that automatically formats SQL pasted into the editor.

format_on_save.value: 保存時のフォーマット
format_on_save.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Format triggers: checkbox label for the option that automatically formats the query file whenever it is saved.

indent_join_on_conditions.value: JOIN ON条件をインデントする
indent_join_on_conditions.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: checkbox label for the option that indents the ON conditions of a JOIN one level deeper than the JOIN line.

indent_nested_queries.value: ネストされたクエリをインデントする
indent_nested_queries.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: checkbox label for the option that indents the body of nested subqueries one level inside their parentheses.

insert_one_column_per_line.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that puts each column of an INSERT statement's column list on its own line; “INSERT” is the SQL keyword.

keep_inline_comments_inline.value: インラインコメントをインラインに保つ
keep_inline_comments_inline.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that keeps end-of-line -- comments on the same line as the code they follow.

merge_section_separation.value: 統合セクションの分離
merge_section_separation.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that separates the WHEN MATCHED / WHEN NOT MATCHED sections of a MERGE statement onto distinct blocks.

move_trailing_comments.value: 表現付きの末尾コメントを移動する
move_trailing_comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that keeps a trailing comment attached to its expression when the formatter moves that expression to another line.

multi_condition_on.value: マルチコンディションON（各コンディションは独自の行で）
multi_condition_on.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → JOINs: checkbox label for the option that, when a JOIN's ON clause has several AND/OR conditions, puts each condition on its own line.

multiline_index_columns.value: マルチラインインデックス列
multiline_index_columns.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that puts each column of a CREATE INDEX column list on its own line.

new_line_after_with.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Subqueries / CTEs: checkbox label for the option that starts the first common table expression on a new line after the WITH keyword.

parenthesize_mixed_boolean.value: 混合ボoleanロジックを囲 brackets
parenthesize_mixed_boolean.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Boolean conditions: checkbox label for the option that adds clarifying parentheses where AND and OR are mixed in one condition.

per_category_casing.value: キーワードカテゴリごとに別々のキャッシングを有効にする
per_category_casing.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Keyword casing: checkbox label that, when checked, reveals ten extra dropdowns so each keyword category (such as data types or functions) gets its own letter case.

respect_control_comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that makes the formatter obey special comments that switch formatting off and on for a region of SQL.

short_queries_one_line.value: 短いクエリは1行にまとめてください。
short_queries_one_line.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: checkbox label for the option that leaves queries shorter than the short query length on a single line; checking it reveals the “Short query max length” input.

space_before_function_parens.value: 関数括弧の前にあるスペース
space_before_function_parens.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Functions: checkbox label for the option that inserts a space between a function name and its opening parenthesis, as in “COUNT (*)”.

spaces_around_operators_etc.value: 演算子（=、<、+など）の周りにあるスペース
spaces_around_operators_etc.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Operators: checkbox label for the option that puts a space on both sides of operators such as =, <> and +.

use_editor_indentation.value: エディタのインデント設定を使用する
use_editor_indentation.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: checkbox label for the option that makes the formatter use the editor's own tab and indent width settings; unchecking it reveals separate indent style, width and continuation indent controls.

wrap_long_lines.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: checkbox label for the option that breaks lines longer than the maximum line length onto further lines.

enter_a_number_e_g_0_25.value: 数字を入力してください。例えば、0.25です。
enter_a_number_e_g_0_25.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Decimal places: inline validation error shown when the decimal-place value is not numeric.

enter_a_whole_number.value: 整数を入力してください。
enter_a_whole_number.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Decimal places: inline validation error shown when the integer-place value is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_2.value: 整数を入力してください。
enter_a_whole_number_2.location: Settings → Results → General → Auto-size columns: inline validation error shown when the column-width limit is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_3.value: 整数を入力してください。
enter_a_whole_number_3.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Result paging: inline validation error shown when a paging size is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_4.value: 整数を入力してください。
enter_a_whole_number_4.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Retention: inline validation error shown when a retention value is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_5.value: 整数を入力してください。
enter_a_whole_number_5.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation: inline validation error shown when a generation parameter is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_6.value: 整数を入力してください。
enter_a_whole_number_6.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Limits: inline validation error shown when a numeric limit is not a whole number.

corrupt_store.value: {error}。スケジュールされたタスクが保存されませんでした。まずそのファイルを修正または移動してください。
corrupt_store.location: Main window → Status bar: error shown when saving scheduled database dump tasks is refused because the existing schedule file on disk is unreadable; {error} is the parse error and the sentence continues after it.

save_failed.location: Main window → Status bar: error shown when writing the scheduled database dump task list to disk fails; {path} is the schedule file's full path and {error} is the system error.

building_catalog.value: AIキャッシュとエンベディングを構築する...（これはしばらく時間がかかる場合があります）
building_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: progress message shown after the user runs “Build AI Cache and Embeddings” on a connected server, while SQLLY precomputes AI descriptions and vector embeddings for its schema.

capture_plan_first.value: まず実行計画を記録します (説明 / 実際の計画)。
capture_plan_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI plan explanation: hint shown when “Explain Execution Plan (AI)” is run but the active query tab has no captured execution plan; tells the user to capture a plan first.

catalog_build_failed.value: AIカタログの構築に失敗しました：{error}
catalog_build_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: error shown when building the AI cache and embeddings for the connected server fails; {error} is the underlying error text.

catalog_built.value: AIカタログ構築：{processed}オブジェクトの{embedded}を埋め込み（{failed}失敗、{stale}はまだ期限切れ）。
catalog_built.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: success message after “Build AI Cache and Embeddings” finishes; {embedded} embedded objects, {processed} processed objects, {failed} failures, {stale} entries still out of date.

clear_failed.value: AIデータをクリアできなかった：{error}
clear_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: error shown when “Clear AI Catalog Data” fails to wipe the AI descriptions and embeddings for the connected server; {error} is the underlying error text.

clearing_catalog.value: AIカタログデータをクリアしています...
clearing_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: progress message shown while “Clear AI Catalog Data” deletes the AI-generated descriptions and embeddings for the connected server.

connect_build_catalog.value: まずデータベースに接続して、そのAIカタログを構築します。
connect_build_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: hint shown when “Build AI Cache and Embeddings” is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a server before building the AI catalog.

connect_clear_data.value: まずデータベースに接続して、そのAIデータをクリアします。
connect_clear_data.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: hint shown when “Clear AI Catalog Data” is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a server before clearing its AI data.

data_cleared.value: AIデータがクリアされました：{cards}カードが無効になり、{embeddings}エンベディングが削除されました。
data_cleared.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: success message after “Clear AI Catalog Data” finishes; {cards} is the number of AI description cards invalidated, {embeddings} the number of vector embeddings deleted.

explain_selection_prompt.value:
このSQLを説明し、問題点を指摘してください。

{sql}
explain_selection_prompt.location: AI panel → Ask → Prompt box: prefilled question inserted by “Send Selection to AI”, asking the AI to explain the selected SQL and point out problems; {sql} is the selected SQL placed on the next line.

fix_changed_statement.value: エラー発生後、不合格ステートメントのテキストが変更されました。代わりにカーテンで修正を挿入しました。
fix_changed_statement.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice after applying an AI fix when the failing statement was edited since the error, so the fixed SQL was inserted at the cursor instead of replacing the statement.

fix_empty_sql.value: AIの回答には使用可能なSQLが含まれていませんでした。
fix_empty_sql.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when the user applies an AI error-fix answer that contains no usable SQL, so nothing is changed in the query editor.

fix_missing_position.value: エラーにはどのステートメントが失敗したかが書かれていませんでした。代わりにカーテンで修正を挿入しました。
fix_missing_position.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice after applying an AI fix when the error had no known statement position, so the fixed SQL was inserted at the cursor instead of replacing the failing statement.

fix_not_editable.value: 失敗したタブには、編集可能なスクリプトが保持されなくなりました。
fix_not_editable.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when an AI fix targets a tab that cannot be edited (a result snapshot, DDL view or notebook tab), so the fix is not applied.

fix_replaced_statement.value: 不具合のあるステートメントを変更しました。⌘Zを押すと古いテキストが戻ってきます。
fix_replaced_statement.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: success message after the AI-suggested SQL replaced the single failing statement in its query tab as one undoable edit.

fix_replaced_whole_run.value: AIの回答は全体のスクリプトを書き直したため、全体の実行が置き換えられました。⌘Zで古いテキストが戻ります。
fix_replaced_whole_run.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: success message after the AI-suggested SQL replaced the entire SQL that was run (not just one statement) in its query tab as one undoable edit.

fix_stale_run.value: エラー以降、そのタブは再び実行されましたので、この修正はもはやそれに一致していません。新しい結果を説明して新しい修正を取得するか、挿入を使用してください。
fix_stale_run.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when the query tab was run again after the error the AI fix was written for, so the outdated fix is not applied.

fix_tab_closed.value: 失敗したタブは閉じられています。インサートを使用して、修正を現在のエディタに配置してください。
fix_tab_closed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when the user applies an AI fix but the query tab where the original error happened has since been closed.

no_active_query.value: 分析するアクティブなクエリタブはありません。
no_active_query.location: Workbench → Status bar → Analyze Last Run with AI: hint shown when the command is run with no query tab open, so there is no query run to analyze.

no_recent_error.value: 説明すべき最近のクエリエラーはありません。
no_recent_error.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explain Last Error (AI): hint shown when the command is run but no query has failed recently, so there is no error to explain.

object_not_loaded.value: {name}はまだExplorerにロードされていません。スキーマを更新してもう一度試してください。
object_not_loaded.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel object link: notice shown when the user clicks a schema object named in an AI answer but it is not loaded in the Explorer tree; {name} is the object name.

object_revealed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel object link: confirmation after clicking a schema object named in an AI answer opens the Explorer and selects that object; {name} is the object name.

run_query_first.value: まずクエリを実行してから、AIで分析します。
run_query_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → Analyze Last Run with AI: hint shown when the active query tab has never been run, asking the user to run the query before asking the AI to analyze it.

select_sql_first.value: まずいくつかのSQLを選択してください
select_sql_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → Send Selection to AI: hint shown when the command is run with no text selected in the query editor; asks the user to select some SQL first.

sql_inserted.value: エディタにSQLが挿入されました。
sql_inserted.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel: confirmation after the user clicks Insert on SQL in an AI answer and it is inserted at the cursor of the active query editor.

sql_opened_flagged_offset.value: フラグ付きの場所にカーテンマークを付けてSQLを開いた
sql_opened_flagged_offset.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel validation issue: confirmation after clicking a flagged issue under AI-generated SQL opens that SQL in a new query tab with the cursor on the problem position.

sql_opened_new_query.value: 新しいクエリでSQLを開いた
sql_opened_new_query.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel: confirmation after the user chooses to open SQL from an AI answer in a new query tab.

truncated_sql_comment.location: AI panel → Ask → Prompt box: SQL comment appended to the selected SQL sent by “Send Selection to AI” when the selection exceeds 4,000 characters, marking that the SQL was cut off.

empty.value: まだ要約はありません
empty.location: Query tab → AI summary strip: placeholder text in the one-line summary band above the results when AI summaries are enabled but no summary of the query has been generated yet.

update_button.location: Query tab → AI summary strip: small button at the end of the summary band that regenerates the short and long AI summaries of the current query text.

account_not_signed_in.value: {name}は、このデバイスでサインインしていないAzureアカウントを使用しています。Entraアカウントを管理を開き、「ユーザーを追加」をクリックします。
account_not_signed_in.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL connect: error shown when the Microsoft Entra account linked to a connection is not registered in SQLLY; {name} is the connection name.

browser_unavailable.value: Azure SQL接続はブラウザプレビューでは使用できません。これはタブ内のデモです。デスクトップアプリを使用してください。
browser_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Azure SQL Connection: notice shown when the command is used in the browser build, where Azure (Microsoft Entra) sign-in is not available.

connecting.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: progress message while connecting to an Azure SQL database chosen from discovered servers; {name} is “server/database”.

discovered.value: {count} Azure SQLデータベースが検出されました。
discovered.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: success message after scanning the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts; {count} is the number of Azure SQL databases found.

discovering.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: progress message while SQLLY searches the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts for Azure SQL servers and databases.

discovery_failed.value: Azure SQLサーバーを取得できませんでした。
discovery_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: error shown when searching the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts for Azure SQL servers failed and nothing was found.

discovery_permission_error.value: SQLLYはあなたのAzure SQLサーバーをリストアップできませんでした。アカウントにそれらを列挙する権限がない可能性があります。それでも、サーバー名を入力して接続できます。
discovery_permission_error.location: Connection management dialog and connection editor → Azure SQL servers list: inline error shown when Azure SQL discovery fails, typically because the signed-in account lacks permission to list servers.

firewall_connect_first.value:
まずAzure SQLサーバーに接続してから、このコマンドをもう一度実行してください。

接続バーでサーバー名を確認し、末尾に`.database.windows.net`（Azure SQLデータベース）または`.database.azure.com`（Azure SQLマネージドインスタンス）が付いていることを確認します。
firewall_connect_first.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → No connection message: message shown when the Tools menu command is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to the Azure SQL server first.

firewall_contacting.value:
Azureに連絡して、{server}のサーバーファイアウォールにあなたのパブリッククライアントIPを追加します。

これには、アクティブなプロファイルに結合されているMicrosoft Entra（Azure）アカウントとリフレッシュ可能なアクセストークンが必要です。いずれかが欠落している場合は、結果が次の手順に進むようにガイドします。
firewall_contacting.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Pending message: pending message shown while SQLLY contacts Azure to add the current IP address to the server firewall; {server} is the server host name.

firewall_not_azure.value:
アクティブなサーバー{server}はAzure SQLエンドポイントではありません。

ファイアウォールルールフローは、Azure（例：*.database.windows.net）でホストされているサーバーにのみ適用されます。SQL Server/オンプレミスは、クライアントのIPルールがファイアウォール製品自体またはサーバーのネットワーク構成に存在します。
firewall_not_azure.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Not Azure SQL message: message shown when the active connection is not an Azure SQL server, so no firewall rule can be added; {server} is the server host name.

firewall_preview_unavailable.value: 説明のみです。ウェブプレビューはAzureにアクセスしてファイアウォールルールを追加することはできません。デスクトップアプリを使用して、Azure SQLサーバーのファイアウォールをIPアドレスに開きます。
firewall_preview_unavailable.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Browser preview unavailable message: message shown in the standalone browser preview, where changing Azure firewall rules is not possible.

firewall_served_unavailable.value: ブラウザのSQLLYでは、Azureファイアウォールルールを追加できません。管理者にサーバーが接続できることを許可するよう依頼してください。
firewall_served_unavailable.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Served browser unavailable message: message shown in the browser version served by a relay proxy or SQLLY Embedded, where changing Azure firewall rules is not possible.

firewall_title.value: ファイアウォールに私のIPを追加する
firewall_title.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Title bar: window title shared by every result of the Tools menu command that adds the user's current IP address to an Azure SQL server firewall.

firewall_web_unavailable.value: ウェブプレビューは、ファイアウォールルールを追加するためにAzureにアクセスできません。
firewall_web_unavailable.location: Server Firewall Is Blocking Your IP dialog → Result: message shown after clicking Add Firewall Rule in the browser version, where the rule cannot be created.

minting_cloud_token.value: {name}用の雲サインイントークンを発行する...
minting_cloud_token.location: Workbench → Status bar → Cloud IAM connect: progress message while SQLLY obtains a cloud IAM access token before connecting; {name} is the connection name.

no_servers.value: Azure SQLサーバーが見つかりません。
no_servers.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: notice shown when discovery finished without errors but the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts have no Azure SQL servers.

password_load_failed.value: SQL アカウントのパスワードを読み込めませんでした: {error}
password_load_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Connect: error shown when the saved password for a connection cannot be read from the system credential store before connecting; {error} is the underlying error text.

session_expired.value: {name}のAzureセッションが期限切れになりました。Entraアカウントを管理を開き、ユーザーを追加をクリックして再度サインインしてください。
session_expired.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL connect: error shown when the Microsoft Entra sign-in for a connection has expired and the user must sign in again; {name} is the connection name.

sign_in_before_discovery.value: Azure SQLサーバーを選択する前に、Microsoft Entraアカウントにサインインしてください。
sign_in_before_discovery.location: Connection management dialog and connection editor → Azure SQL servers list: message shown when no Microsoft Entra account is signed in, so Azure SQL servers cannot be discovered.

signing_in.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL connect: progress message while SQLLY obtains a fresh Microsoft Entra access token for a connection; {name} is the connection name.

batch_insert_unavailable.value: このビルドではバッチ挿入は使用できません。
batch_insert_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Results grid context menu → Batch Insert: notice shown when Batch Insert is chosen in the browser build, where the batch insert dialog is not available.

manual_close_hint.value: ブラウザでは、このタブを自分で閉じることができます。⌘W（Mac）またはCtrl+Wを使用してください。
manual_close_hint.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → close-tab notification: message shown after the browser refuses a scripted tab close and the user must use the browser keyboard shortcut.

result_snapshots_unavailable.value: 結果のスナップショットは利用できません。
result_snapshots_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Result Snapshots: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase naming the feature.

connected_plural.value: レプリケーションプロキシ「{relay}」に接続されています。{count}接続が利用可能です（読み取り専用）。
connected_plural.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page first connects to the relay proxy, plural form; {relay} is the relay name, {count} the number of read-only connections offered.

connected_singular.value: レプリケーションプロキシ「{relay}」に接続されています。{count}接続が利用可能（読み取り専用）。
connected_singular.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page first connects to the relay proxy, singular form used when exactly one read-only connection is offered; {relay} is the relay name.

connecting.value: リレープロキシに接続中...
connecting.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: progress message shown at page load while the browser version opens its session with the configured relay proxy.

license_confirmed.value: {message}ライセンスが確認されました。
license_confirmed.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: success message after the proxy confirms its license; {message} is the preceding “Connected to relay proxy …” sentence.

license_paused.value: {relay}：{message} ライセンスが確認されるまで、クエリは一時停止されます。
license_paused.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy license: error when the proxy's license cannot be confirmed and queries are blocked; {relay} is the relay name, {message} the license problem.

license_warning.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy license: warning shown when the proxy reports a license problem but still serves queries; {relay} is the relay name, {message} the license problem.

reconnect_failed.value: リレープロキシ（{reason}）に再接続できませんでした。ページを再読み込みして再接続してください。
reconnect_failed.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: error shown after all automatic reconnect attempts to the relay proxy failed; {reason} is the last failure reason. Tells the user to reload the page.

reconnected_plural.value: リレープロキシ「{relay}」に再接続しました。{count}接続が利用可能（読み取り専用）。
reconnected_plural.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page reconnects to the relay proxy following a dropped session, plural form; {relay} is the relay name, {count} the number of connections.

reconnected_singular.value: リレープロキシ「{relay}」に再接続しました。{count}接続が利用可能（読み取り専用）。
reconnected_singular.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page reconnects to the relay proxy following a dropped session, singular form for exactly one read-only connection; {relay} is the relay name.

reconnecting.value: レレープロキシに接続できません（{reason}）。再接続中...
reconnecting.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: warning shown when the relay proxy cannot be reached or the session dropped, as automatic reconnect attempts begin; {reason} is why it failed.

refusal_status.value: {message}ページを再読み込みしてもう一度試してください。
refusal_status.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: error shown when the proxy refuses the session (token, seat or license problem); {message} is the proxy's reason, followed by advice to reload the page.

session_closed.value: プロキシがセッションを終了しました。
session_closed.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: default reason shown in the reconnect messages when an established proxy session ends and the proxy gave no reason of its own.

still_unreachable_plural.value: レレープロキシはまだアクセスできません（{reason}）。{count}のさらなる試行...
still_unreachable_plural.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: warning after a failed reconnect attempt, plural form; {reason} is the failure reason and {count} the number of attempts remaining.

still_unreachable_singular.value: レレープロキシはまだアクセスできません（{reason}）。{count} もう一度試します...
still_unreachable_singular.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: warning after a failed reconnect attempt, singular form used when exactly one attempt remains; {reason} is the failure reason.

connect_script.value: データベースに接続して選択をスクリプト化します。
connect_script.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection actions: hint shown when a bulk script, export or maintenance action has no connection to run against; asks the user to connect first.

connection_missing.value: 選択したオブジェクトの接続はもう存在しません。
connection_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection actions: error shown when the selected objects belong to a saved connection that no longer exists (for example it was deleted), so the bulk action is cancelled.

export_databases_skipped.value: データのエクスポートは一度に1つのデータベースを処理します。選択中の{count}の他のデータベースは省略されました。
export_databases_skipped.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Export data: warning that the export dialog handles one database, so only the first was used; {count} is the number of other databases skipped.

export_unavailable.value: テーブルをファイルにエクスポートすることはできません。
export_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Export data: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase.

maintenance_scripted.value: メンテナンスが新しいタブにスクリプト化されています。実行する前にレビューしてください。
maintenance_scripted.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Maintenance: confirmation after the maintenance script for all selected objects is opened in a new query tab for review.

maintenance_scripted_skipped.value: メンテナンスは新しいタブにスクリプト化されました。{objects}はスキップされました。
maintenance_scripted_skipped.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Maintenance: confirmation after the maintenance script opens in a new tab, listing objects left out because the operation does not apply to them; {objects} is a comma-separated list.

no_tables_to_export.value: ビューからエクスポートする行はありません。少なくとも1つのテーブルを選択してください。
no_tables_to_export.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Export data: notice shown when the selection contains no tables or views whose data could be exported.

script_failed.value: {verb}：{error}のスクリプトを作成できませんでした。
script_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: error when generating the scripts fails; {verb} is the SQL keyword CREATE or DROP, {error} the error text.

script_opened.value: {verb}スクリプトは新しいタブで開かれました。実行する前にレビューしてください。
script_opened.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: confirmation that the generated script opened in a new query tab with no warnings; {verb} is the keyword CREATE or DROP.

script_opened_one_warning.value: {verb}スクリプトは新しいタブで開かれました。実行する前にレビューしてください（警告1：{warning}）
script_opened_one_warning.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: script opened in a new tab with exactly one warning; {verb} is CREATE or DROP, {warning} the warning text.

script_opened_warnings.value: {verb}スクリプトは新しいタブで開かれました。実行する前にレビューしてください（{count}警告 - スクリプトヘッダーを参照してください）。
script_opened_warnings.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: script opened in a new tab with several warnings; {verb} is CREATE or DROP, {count} the number of warnings.

scripting.value: {count}オブジェクトの{verb}スクリプト化...
scripting.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: progress message while scripts are generated; {verb} is the SQL keyword CREATE or DROP, {count} the number of selected objects.

action_unsupported.value: {column}はそのアクションを使用できません
action_unsupported.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: generic notice shown when the chosen cell action (such as a server SQL function) does not apply to the clicked column; {column} is the column name.

connect_to_view.value: データベースに接続して、フル値を表示します。
connect_to_view.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: hint shown when the user asks to view or copy the full value of a truncated cell with no active connection, which is needed to re-read it.

copied_full_value.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: confirmation after the full, untruncated cell value was fetched from the server and copied to the clipboard; {size} is its size, such as “2.4 MiB”.

expression_not_editable.value: {column}は編集可能な表の列ではありません（式または計算値）。代わりに行を編集してください。
expression_not_editable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: notice shown when a cell action targets a result column computed by an expression, not a real table column; {column} is the result column name.

load_file_failed.value: ファイルを読み込めませんでした：{error}
load_file_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Load from file: error shown when the chosen file cannot be read into the binary cell; {error} is the system error text.

load_file_unavailable.value: このビルドでは、ファイルからの読み込みは使用できません。
load_file_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Load from file: notice shown because loading a cell value from a local file is not supported in the browser build.

no_default.value: {column}にはデフォルトはありません
no_default.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set DEFAULT: notice shown when the clicked column has no default value defined; {column} is the column name.

no_key_column.value: この結果はキー列がありません。代わりに行を編集してください。
no_key_column.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: notice shown when a cell action cannot stage an edit because the result has no primary or unique key column to identify the row; suggests the row editor.

not_binary.value: {column}はバイナリ列ではありません
not_binary.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Load from file: notice shown when the clicked column is not a binary column that can take file contents; {column} is the column name.

not_binary_or_text.value: そのセルはバイナリまたはテキストではありません。
not_binary_or_text.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: reason inserted into the save-failed message when the cell holds neither binary data nor text, so it cannot be written to a file.

not_editable_text.value: {column}は編集可能なテキスト列ではありません
not_editable_text.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → text transforms (uppercase, trim and so on): notice shown when the column is not an editable text column; {column} is the column name.

not_nullable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set NULL: notice shown when the clicked column does not allow NULL values; {column} is the column name.

not_temporal.value: {column}は日付または時間列ではありません。
not_temporal.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set to server time or Set to current timestamp: notice shown when the clicked column is not a date or time column; {column} is the column name.

not_uuid.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set to new UUID: notice shown when the clicked column cannot store a UUID value; {column} is the column name.

nothing_to_transform.value: {transform}：{column}で変更する必要はありません
nothing_to_transform.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → text transform: notice that applying the transform would not change the cell; {transform} is the transform name (e.g. “Trim whitespace”), {column} the column name.

original_unreadable.value: 元のセルを読み込めませんでした
original_unreadable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: reason inserted into the save-failed message when the cell's original value could not be read back from the row.

read_failed.value: 全セル値を読み込めませんでした。
read_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: notice shown when SQLLY re-reads the row to fetch a truncated cell's full value but the column is missing from the re-read row.

results_changed_before_staging.value: 編集をステージングする前に結果が変更されました。更新してもう一度お試しください。
results_changed_before_staging.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: notice shown when the query was re-run while a cell action was being prepared, so the edit was not staged; asks the user to refresh and retry.

save_file_failed.value: セルをファイルに保存できませんでした：{error}
save_file_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: error shown when writing the cell value to the chosen file fails; {error} is the reason.

save_file_unavailable.value: ファイルに保存することは、このビルドでは使用できません。
save_file_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: notice shown because saving a cell value to a local file is not supported in the browser build.

staged_expression.value: {column}のためのステージングされた表現
staged_expression.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → text transform: notice that the cell already has a staged SQL expression (for example a server function), so a text transform cannot be applied; {column} is the column name.

text_rejected.value: ステージ{column}はできません：{error}
text_rejected.location: Workbench → Status bar: shown when text applied in the Cell Details panel is not valid for the column; {column} is the column name and {error} the reason, such as “Enter a whole number.”

viewer_limit_exceeded.value: この値は{limit}ビューア制限を超えています。
viewer_limit_exceeded.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: notice shown when the full value is larger than the size the cell viewer can load, so it is not fetched; a {limit} size value is available to this message.

connect_before_save.value: 図表をライブラリに保存する前に、データベースに接続してください。
connect_before_save.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results Chart tab → Save chart to library: hint shown when the user saves a chart with no active connection; a saved chart must be tied to a connection.

connection_missing.value: チャート「{name}」の接続「{connection}」はもう存在しません
connection_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar → Tools menu → Saved Charts: error when a saved chart cannot be opened because its connection no longer exists; {connection} is the connection name, {name} the chart name.

dashboard_unavailable.value: チャートダッシュボードは使用できません。
dashboard_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Chart Dashboard: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase naming the dashboard.

save_prompt_unavailable.value: チャートの保存は利用できません。
save_prompt_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Results → Save Chart to Library: message shown because the saved-chart library is unavailable.

saved_status.value: 「{name}」チャートをライブラリに保存しました。ツール>保存済みチャートから開きます。
saved_status.location: Workbench → Status bar → Save Chart dialog: confirmation after a chart is saved to the chart library, telling the user where to find it; {name} is the chart name. Keep the menu path matching the translated Tools menu.

saved_unavailable.value: 保存したチャートは使用できません。
saved_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Saved Charts: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase naming the saved charts library.

ai_catalog_unavailable.value: AIカタログのメンテナンスは利用できません。
ai_catalog_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown in the browser preview when the Build AI Cache and Embeddings or Clear AI Catalog Data command is run; names the feature that the browser build does not support.

ai_quit_description.value: 今すぐ終了すると、実行が停止し、未完成の回答が破棄されます。作業を続けるには「待機」を選択するか、とにかく「終了」を選択して終了します。
ai_quit_description.location: Quit confirmation dialog → AI run in progress: body text shown when the user quits SQLLY while the AI Assistant is still answering; explains that quitting discards the partial answer and names the Wait and Quit anyway buttons.

ai_quit_title.value: AIの実行はまだ進行中です。
ai_quit_title.location: Quit confirmation dialog → AI run in progress: dialog title shown when the user quits SQLLY (Cmd+Q or the Quit menu item) while an AI Assistant request is still running.

already_detached.value: 結果はすでに切り離されています。
already_detached.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Detach Results to Window is run on a query tab whose results are already open in a separate results window; nothing else happens.

cleanup_start_failed.value: データクリーニングを開始できませんでした：{error}
cleanup_start_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown after the user confirms deleting all app data but the cleanup job could not be scheduled; {error} is the system error text.

cleanup_task_failed.value: データクリーニングが予期せず停止しました：{error}
cleanup_task_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when the background step that removes stored Microsoft Entra sign-in tokens crashed before finishing; {error} is the internal failure text.

clear_entra_credentials_failed.value: 保存された認証情報をクリアできませんでした。ファイルは削除されませんでした。{error}
clear_entra_credentials_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when stored Microsoft Entra (Azure) sign-in tokens could not be removed, so the reset was abandoned before any files were deleted; {error} is the keychain error.

clear_sql_credentials_failed.value: 保存されたSQL認証情報をクリアできませんでした。ファイルは削除されませんでした。{error}
clear_sql_credentials_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when saved SQL login passwords could not be removed from the keychain, so the reset was abandoned before any files were deleted; {error} is the keychain error.

connect_before_catalog_refresh.value: カタログを更新する前にサーバーに接続してください。
connect_before_catalog_refresh.location: Workbench → Status bar: hint shown when Refresh IntelliSense Catalog is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a server first.

date_refreshed.location: Workbench → Status bar: result of the Refresh Natural-Language Dates command when exactly one natural-language date comment in the editor was recalculated (singular form).

dates_current.value: 自然言語の日付はすでに最新です
dates_current.location: Workbench → Status bar: result of the Refresh Natural-Language Dates command when no natural-language date comment in the editor needed recalculating.

dates_refreshed.location: Workbench → Status bar: result of the Refresh Natural-Language Dates command when several natural-language date comments were recalculated; {count} is the number of dates updated (two or more).

delete_all_cancel.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Cancel button: default cancel button that closes the alert and keeps all data; answers the question “Delete all SQLLY data?”.

delete_all_confirm.value: はい、すべてのデータを削除します。
delete_all_confirm.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Confirm button: destructive confirm button that wipes every SQLLY setting, connection, credential and unsaved query and then closes the app.

delete_all_description.value: このアプリに関連するすべてのデータを永久に削除し、その後SQLLYを終了します。未保存のクエリはすべて削除されます。次にSQLLYを開くと、まったく出箱状態になります。これは元に戻すことができません。
delete_all_description.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Message body: explanatory body text opened from Settings → Advanced → Clear all data, warning that the reset is permanent, deletes unsaved queries and quits the app.

delete_all_failed.value: すべてのアプリデータを削除できませんでした：{error}
